<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X917a6"></A>fudge Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX525" REL="I1" TITLE="fudge subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX526" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX527" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX528" REL="I3" TITLE="fudge"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX529" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX530" REL="I2" TITLE="window sizes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX531" REL="I3" TITLE="specifying added pixel values"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A142X917a8"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0BF4171ceb"></A>Specifies pixel values that are added to a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12c1"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0BF4320ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF4428ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X917ac"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912af9"></A><B>void fudge(Int32 </B><A HREF="fudge.html#gr13180marj"><I>xfudge</I></A><B>,</B> <B>Int32 </B><A HREF="fudge.html#As1360marj"><I>yfudge</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c4d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c4e"></A><B>SUBROUTINE FUDGE(</B><I>xfudge</I><B>, </B><I>yfudge</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>xfudge</I><B>, </B><I>yfudge</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X917ae"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0BF4794ceb"></A>The <B>fudge </B>subroutine specifies pixel values that are added to the dimensions of a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A> when it is sized. Typically, this subroutine is used to create interior window borders. Call the <B>fudge</B> subroutine before calling the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF4901ceb"></A>The <B>fudge </B>subroutine is useful in conjunction with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> and <A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> subroutines. With the <B>stepunit </B>subroutine, the window size for integers <I>m </I>and <I>n </I>is: </P>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912afe"></A><I>width</I> = <I>xunit</I> * <I>m</I> + <A HREF="fudge.html#gr13180marj"><I>xfudge</I></A>
<I>height</I> = <I>yunit</I> * <I>n</I> + <A HREF="fudge.html#As1360marj"><I>yfudge</I></A></PRE>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF5063ceb"></A>With the <B>keepaspect </B>subroutine the window size is (<I>width</I>, <I>height</I>), where:</P>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b00"></A>(<I>width</I> - <I>xfudge</I>) * <I>yaspect</I> = (<I>height</I> - <I>yfudge</I>) * <I>xaspect</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A319C92611"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X917b0"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="gr13180marj"></A><I>xfudge</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of pixels added in the <I>x</I> direction.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="As1360marj"></A><I>yfudge</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of pixels added in the <I>y</I> direction.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C015a00"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0BF5514ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12c4"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12c5"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12c6"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X917c6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0BF5834ceb"></A>Obtaining the size of the window with the <A HREF="getsize.html#X513200marj"><B>getsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF5941ceb"></A>Removing the border from a window with the <A HREF="noborder.html#A142X91d7a"><B>noborder</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF6047ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF6156ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0BF6262ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Qga140marj"></A>fullscrn Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX532" REL="I1" TITLE="fullscrn subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX533" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX534" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX535" REL="I3" TITLE="fullscrn"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX536" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX537" REL="I2" TITLE="fullcreen mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX538" REL="I3" TITLE="beginning"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A318C9ea1"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C13998ceb"></A>Enables drawing outside current window boundaries.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12c8"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C14147ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C14250ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A318C9ea4"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A318C9ea5"></A><B>void fullscrn(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c51"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c52"></A><B>SUBROUTINE FULLSC</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A318C9ea8"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C14604ceb"></A>The <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine allows drawing outside of the current window boundaries. It does so by disabling window clipping.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C12cb"></A><B>Note: </B>When full-screen drawing is enabled, the user can draw all over other windows and other clients; therefore, this subroutine should be used with caution.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<P><A NAME="E1B0C14780ceb"></A>Normally, the <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine is used to draw user interface graphics into the overlay planes by calling <SAMP>drawmode(OVERDRAW)</SAMP>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C14888ceb"></A>This subroutine calls <SAMP>viewport(0,XMAXSCREEN,0,YMAXSCREEN)</SAMP>. To draw outside the window boundaries, but in an area smaller than the full screen, use the <A HREF="viewport.html#qrY270marj"><B>viewport</B></A> subroutine and/or the <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C14996ceb"></A>In addition to enabling drawing into the overlays, the fullscreen mode enables drawing into the main frame buffer--but this is strongly discouraged. It is recommended that you use the fullscreen mode only for rendering into the overlays--not for drawing into the principal frame buffer. The reason for this is that when fullscreen mode is exited, no GL REDRAW or X Exposure events are generated.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C15105ceb"></A>When fullscreen mode is exited, the overlay planes are not cleared. Therefore, if the overlay planes have been rendered into, they should be cleared as a matter of courtesy before the call to the <B>endfullscrn</B> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C15264ceb"></A>If a window belonging to a process has overlays that have been explicitly disabled with the <B>overlay</B> and <B>gconfig</B> subroutines, the <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine call canot reenable overlays for that window. Therefore, when rendering into overlay planes while in fullscreen mode, the results of the rendering may not be visible if the drawing occurred over a window that has disabled overlays.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C15373ceb"></A>In the current implementation, all mouse motion and mouse button press events are redirected to the process that called the <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine. The redirection continues until the <B>endfullscrn</B> subroutine call is made. This redirection of input overrides the window manager focus policy.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C15480ceb"></A>If a second process enters fullscreen mode when another process is already in this mode, pointer motion and mouse button press events will not be grabbed for the second process.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C15588ceb"></A>If keyboard events are needed, use the <B>XGrabKey</B> and <B>XGrabKeyboard</B> subroutines.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="BD45BF3156vbia"></A>Using the <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine in an application makes that application not compliant with the <I>Inter-Client Communication Conventions Manual</I> (ICCCM). Compliance to ICCCM, although encouraged, is optional. For more information on ICCCM, refer to the AIXwindows documentation.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A318C9ead"></A>The <B>fullscrn</B> subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A3CFC6AC953janb"></A>When the GLC_FB_FULLSCREEN mode is enabled, and <B>fullscrn</B> is used,  the colors in the main frame buffer will be temporarily become completely black. The colors are restored when <B>endfullscrn</B> is called.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A61C015a04"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C15908ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12ce"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12cf"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12d0"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A318C9eb6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C16228ceb"></A>Initializing the graphics system without changing the color map with the <A HREF="gbegin.html#JS4380nita"><B>gbegin</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C16335ceb"></A>Ending fullscreen mode with the <A HREF="endfullscrn.html#laa350marj"><B>endfullscrn</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C16442ceb"></A>Reconfiguring the system with the <A HREF="gconfig.html#hS4260nita"><B>gconfig</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C16560ceb"></A>Setting the number of user-defined bitplanes used for overlay drawing with the <A HREF="overlay.html#A143X950a"><B>overlay</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C16668ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C16775ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>
[  <a href="fudge.html">Previous</a>  |

<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 3.2//EN">
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=iso-8859-1">

<TITLE>gamma.c Example C Language Program for GL
</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>
[  <a href="font3_c.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="iobounce_c.html">Next</a>  |
<A HREF="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A101C12370"></A>gamma.c Example C Language Program for GL</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2308" REL="I1" TITLE="gamma.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2309" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2310" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2311" REL="I3" TITLE="gamma ramps"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2312" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2313" REL="I2" TITLE="gamma ramps"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2314" REL="I3" TITLE="color maps"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2315" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2316" REL="I2" TITLE="antialiasing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2317" REL="I3" TITLE="gamma ramps"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA1082ttay"></A>#include &lt;stdio.h>
#include &lt;math.h>
#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA1237ttay"></A>/* Example:  gammaramp.c */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA1526ttay"></A>/*
 * This example program shows the use of gamma ramps.  Gamma ramps
 * are useful for correcting the appeareance of photographs
 * (images) and antialiased lines (to correct for monitor
 * phosphors), and for implementing color-map tricks.
 *
 * Pressing PF7 or PF8 changes the gamma correction factor and 
 * loads the new gamma ramp.  A window shows the current gamma 
 * factor and a black-to-white scale.
 */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA1690ttay"></A>/* ----------------------------------------------------------- */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA1875ttay"></A>/*
 * This routine prints out the current value of gamma in a window.
 * At the bottom of the window is a color bar.  
 */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA2026ttay"></A>void show_val (float gam)
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA2358ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;char gamstr[32];   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack (0x0);         /* black */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;clear();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack (0xff);        /* red */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cmov2 (10, 80);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;charstr ("Currently, the gamma correction factor is ");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sprintf (gamstr, "%3.2f", gam);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;charstr (gamstr);   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cmov2 (10, 60);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;charstr ("To lower gamma, press PF7");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cmov2 (10, 40);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;charstr ("To raise gamma, press PF8");   /* draw a sample color bar */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack (0x0);         /* black */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pmv2 (10, 10);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr2 (10, 25);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack (0xffffff);    /* white */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr2 (390, 25);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr2 (390, 10);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pclos ();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA2501ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA2665ttay"></A>/* ----------------------------------------------------------- */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA4246ttay"></A>/* 
 * The following routine updates the adapter gamma ramps 
 * based on the value of gamma passed to it.  Note that the 
 * entire screen is affected (because there is only one set 
 * of ramps for the entire screen).
 */
void update_ramps (float gam) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;short rramp[256], gramp[256], bramp[256];
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int i;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;double corr, og;   /* compute the new gamma ramp */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;og = 1.0 / (gam + 0.00001);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;corr = 255.0 * pow ((double) (1.0 / 255.0), og);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for (i=0; i&lt;256; i++) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rramp[i] = gramp[i] = bramp[i] = (short) (corr * pow((float) (i), og));
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/* load the new gamma ramp */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gammaramp (rramp, gramp, bramp);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA4410ttay"></A>/* ----------------------------------------------------------- */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA4964ttay"></A>main() {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;float gamma = 1.0;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;float delta = 0.05;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;short dev, val;   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;prefsize (400, 100);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;minsize (400, 100);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;maxsize (400, 100);         /* disable resizing of window */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;winopen ("gamma-ramp demo");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RGBmode ();                 /* gamma ramps work in color map mode too! */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gconfig ();   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;update_ramps (gamma);       /* initialize the gamma ramps */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;show_val (gamma);           /* print current value of gamma */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice (RIGHTMOUSE);       /* queue up desired devices */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice (ESCKEY);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice (F7KEY);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice (F8KEY);   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;while (TRUE) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dev = qread (&amp;val);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;switch (dev) {         
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;case ESCKEY:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;case RIGHTMOUSE:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;exit(0);         
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;case F7KEY:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (val == FALSE) break;  /* do nothing for key release */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gamma += delta;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;update_ramps (gamma);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;show_val (gamma);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;         
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;case F8KEY:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (val == FALSE) break;  /* do nothing for key release */
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gamma -= delta;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;update_ramps (gamma);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;show_val (gamma);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;         
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;case REDRAW:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;show_val (gamma);         
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;default:
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAA5107ttay"></A>}</PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A200C1177"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7837848ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/smjaglines.html#A4rO1220nita">Pixel Coverage</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I> describes aspects of antialiasing (smoothing lines for screen display) related to color variation in the pixels.</P>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Kz4nita"></A>gammaramp Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX539" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX540" REL="I2" TITLE="color map and RGB mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX541" REL="I3" TITLE="gammaramp"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX542" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX543" REL="I2" TITLE="color correction"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX544" REL="I3" TITLE="defining a color map ramp for"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX545" REL="I1" TITLE="gammaramp subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A237X944f6"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C35473ceb"></A>Defines a color map ramp for gamma correction.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C131"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C35620ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C35723ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A237X944f9"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A237X944fa"></A><B>void gammaramp</B>
<B>(Int16</B> <A HREF="gammaramp.html#Io4270nita"><I>red</I></A><B>[256], Int16</B> <A HREF="gammaramp.html#Vo4210nita"><I>green</I></A><B>[256], Int16</B> <A HREF="gammaramp.html#jo470nita"><I>blue</I></A><B>[256])</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A237X944d6"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A237X944d9"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GAMMAR(</B><I>red</I><B>,</B> <I>green</I><B>,</B> <I>blue</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>red</I><B>(256),</B> <I>green</I><B>(256),</B> <I>blue</I><B>(256)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A237X944fd"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C36093ceb"></A>The <B>gammaramp</B> subroutine supplies a level of indirection for all color map and RGB values. It can provide 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P060f">gamma correction</A>, equalize monitors with different color characteristics, or modify the color warmth of the monitor. The default setting has red[<I>i</I>]=green[<I>i</I>]=blue[<I>i</I>]=<I>i</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C36202ceb"></A>When the system draws an object in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0743">RGB mode</A>, it writes the actual red, green, and blue values to the bitplanes. However, the values displayed on the screen are the indirect values: <I>red</I>, <I>green</I>, <I>blue</I> (where <I>red</I>, <I>green</I>, <I>blue</I> are the arrays last specified by the <B>gammaramp</B> subroutine).</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C36309ceb"></A>In <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e3">color map mode</A>, objects written in color <I>i</I> are displayed as <I>red</I>, <I>green</I>, <I>blue</I>.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="A258C01c413"></A>The operation of this subroutine for the Supergraphics Processor Subsystem is modified. 
(See "<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/powerstation730.html#NITAXIO">Hardware Considerations</A>".) </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A258C01c414"></A>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A237X94502"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Io4270nita"></A><I>red</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array of 256 elements, each containing a setting for the red electron gun.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Vo4210nita"></A><I>green</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array of 256 elements, each containing a setting for the green electron gun.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="jo470nita"></A><I>blue</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array of 256 elements, each containing a setting for the blue electron gun.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016562"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C36892ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFC6BD544janb"></A>The POWERgraphics GXT1000 supports entire-screen gammaramps. Setting the gammaramp on the GXT1000 will affect all windows on the screen, including X11 windows.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C134"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C135"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C136"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A237X94507"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C37215ceb"></A>Setting color map mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C37323ceb"></A>Setting the current color in color map mode with the <A HREF="color.html#A146X9429"><B>color</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C37429ceb"></A>Changing a color map entry to an RGB value with the <A HREF="mapcolor.html#A146X9535"><B>mapcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C37537ceb"></A>Setting the current color in RGB mode with the <A HREF="RGBcolor.html#A143X9394"><B>RGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C37643ceb"></A>Working in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="JS4380nita"></A>gbegin Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX546" REL="I1" TITLE="gbegin subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX547" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX548" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX549" REL="I3" TITLE="gbegin"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX550" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX551" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX552" REL="I3" TITLE="graphics system without color map change"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91241e"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C54432ceb"></A>Initializes the graphics system without changing the color map.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11bf"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C54580ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C54686ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912421"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912422"></A><B>void gbegin(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010b95"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010b96"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GBEGIN</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912425"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C55042ceb"></A>The <B>gbegin</B> subroutine initializes the graphics environment to its default values for global state attributes and creates a window that covers the screen. The <B>gbegin</B> subroutine queues the REDRAW window manager device, but does not change the color map or interfere with other programs that use the current color map.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C55151ceb"></A>This subroutine is not recommended for new application development. The <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine, together with related window management subroutines, provides a more flexible interface for graphics display initialization.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9e87"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a display list.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A64C0165ef"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C55367ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11c2"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11c3"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11c4"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="C7BD30C542bett"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C55690ceb"></A>Enabling drawing outside the current window boundaries with the <A HREF="fullscrn.html#Qga140marj"><B>fullscrn</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C55798ceb"></A>Initializing the graphics system with the <A HREF="ginit.html#LDg21c0marj"><B>ginit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C55906ceb"></A>Resetting all global state attributes to their initial values with the <A HREF="greset.html#xW42e0nita"><B>greset</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C56017ceb"></A>Creating a new window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C56126ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Understanding the Hardware</A> Used by GL and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/setglattrib.html#setglattrib.html">Setting Drawing Attributes</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C56234ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/clrrstintgl.html#clrrstintgl.html">Clearing, Resetting, and Initializing GL</A> and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/underwininput.html#underwininput.html">Windows</A> and Input Control Overview.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="hS4260nita"></A>gconfig Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX553" REL="I1" TITLE="gconfig subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX554" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX555" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX556" REL="I3" TITLE="gconfig"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX557" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX558" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX559" REL="I3" TITLE="reconfiguring the system"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A213X9124fc"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C73441ceb"></A>Reconfigures the system.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11c6"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C73590ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C73694ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9124ff"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912500"></A><B>void gconfig(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010bcd"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010bce"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GCONFI</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912503"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C74047ceb"></A>The <B>gconfig</B> subroutine reconfigures the system by setting the requested modes. This subroutine must be called after any call to the <A HREF="overlay.html#A143X950a"><B>overlay</B></A>, <A HREF="underlay.html#Az5O370nita"><B>underlay</B></A>, <A HREF="doublebuffer.html#A145X91a7"><B>doublebuffer</B></A>, <A HREF="multimap.html#A146X9593"><B>multimap</B></A>, <A HREF="onemap.html#A146X95ef"><B>onemap</B></A>, <A HREF="RGBmode.html#A143X93b6"><B>RGBmode</B></A>, <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A>, or <A HREF="singlebuffer.html#A145X9259"><B>singlebuffer</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C74156ceb"></A>After a call to the <B>gconfig</B> subroutine, the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A3C0F2A4599mhay">writemask</A> and color are reset to their default values. The contents of the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A31996bc">color map</A> do not change.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="A258C01c821"></A>The operation of this subroutine for the Supergraphics Processor Subsystem is modified. (See "<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/undergraphadapt.html#undergraphadapt.html"> Understanding the Adapter</A>".)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A258C01c822"></A>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A30C011046"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C74470ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="overlay_c.html#A11C0b47c"><B>overlay.c</B></A> uses the <B>qconfig</B> subroutine to configure the system after calling the <B>overlay</B> subroutine and the <B>doublebuffer</B> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016604"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C74629ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFC6DE806janb"></A>The POWERgraphics GXT1000 supports RGB and color index modes by creating separate separate and distinct X11 windows--one window is permanently in RGB mode, and the other is permanently in color index mode. The <B>gconfig</B> subroutine on this adapter merely redirects drawing into one of these two windows. This requires a round-trip to the X11 server causing <B>gconfig</B> to run more slowly than on earlier adapters.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFC6DE817janb"></A>The <B>gconfig</B> subroutine cannot be used to change the rendering mode (RGB mode versus colorindex mode) of windows created with the <B>winX</B> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11c9"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11ca"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>

<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91250d"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C74951ceb"></A>Setting color map mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C75058ceb"></A>Setting the display mode to double buffer mode with the <A HREF="doublebuffer.html#A145X91a7"><B>doublebuffer</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C75271ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as one large map with the <A HREF="onemap.html#A146X95ef"><B>onemap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C75594ceb"></A>Setting the display mode to single buffer mode with the <A HREF="singlebuffer.html#A145X9259"><B>singlebuffer</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91ea"></A>genobj Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX560" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX561" REL="I2" TITLE="object (display list)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX562" REL="I3" TITLE="genobj"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX563" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX564" REL="I2" TITLE="object (display list)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX565" REL="I3" TITLE="returning a unique integer for use as identifier"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX566" REL="I1" TITLE="genobj subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91ec"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C94542ceb"></A>Returns a unique integer for use as an object identifier. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C131"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C94690ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C94793ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91f0"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A142X91f1"></A><B>Int32 genobj(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010a6d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010a6e"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GENOBJ</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91f2"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C95150ceb"></A>The <B>genobj</B> subroutine generates unique 31-bit integer numbers for use as 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A255B9bc">object</A> identifiers.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C95267ceb"></A>When using a combination of user-defined and <B>genobj</B>-defined numbers to generate object numbers, ensure that each combination is unique because the <B>genobj</B> subroutine will not generate an object name that is currently in use. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C95374ceb"></A>The <A HREF="isobj.html#A142X920c"><B>isobj</B></A> subroutine can affirm the uniqueness of an object number.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d7e"></A><B>Note: </B>This editing subroutine itself cannot be added to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91f8"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C95595ceb"></A>A unique 31-bit integer for use as an object identifier.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015cf4"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C95755ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C134"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C135"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C136"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X920a"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0C96074ceb"></A>Drawing an instance of an object with the <A HREF="callobj.html#A142X91c8"><B>callobj</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C96183ceb"></A>Opening an object for editing with the <A HREF="editobj.html#A142X9360"><B>editobj</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C96290ceb"></A>Returning a unique integer for use as a tag with the <A HREF="gentag.html#A48x2120marj"><B>gentag</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C96397ceb"></A>Establishing the uniqueness of an object number with the <A HREF="isobj.html#A142X920c"><B>isobj</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C96505ceb"></A>Creating an object with the <A HREF="makeobj.html#A142X912d"><B>makeobj</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0C96614ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Creating <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workobjects.html#workobjects.html">Objects (Display Lists)</A>.</P><hr><center>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A48x2120marj"></A>gentag Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX567" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX568" REL="I2" TITLE="object (display list)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX569" REL="I3" TITLE="gentag"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX570" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX571" REL="I2" TITLE="object (display list)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX572" REL="I3" TITLE="returning a unique integer for use as tag"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX573" REL="I1" TITLE="gentag subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911f8d"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB5581ceb"></A>Returns a unique integer for use as a tag.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C137"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB5729ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB5832ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911f90"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911f91"></A><B>Int32 gentag(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010a8d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010a8e"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GENTAG</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911f94"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB6189ceb"></A>The <B>gentag</B> subroutine generates a unique 31-bit integer number for use as a tag. Tags must be unique within an 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A255B9bc">object</A>. Although the <B>gentag </B>subroutine generates unique tags, if a tag is defined later with the same value, the first tag is lost. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB6297ceb"></A>The <A HREF="istag.html#JXw220marj"><B>istag</B></A> subroutine can affirm the uniqueness of a tag number.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d93"></A><B>Note: </B>This editing subroutine itself cannot be added to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911f97"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB6801ceb"></A>A unique 31-bit integer for use as a tag.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d02"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB6961ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C13a"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C13b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C13c"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911fa4"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CB7282ceb"></A>Deleting tags from a display list with the <A HREF="deltag.html#A1N61210marj"><B>deltag</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB7391ceb"></A>Returning a unique integer for use as an object identifier with the <A HREF="genobj.html#A142X91ea"><B>genobj</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB7498ceb"></A>Establishing the uniqueness of a tag with the <A HREF="istag.html#JXw220marj"><B>istag</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB7605ceb"></A>Marking a location in a display list with the <A HREF="maketag.html#A142X942c"><B>maketag</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CB7712ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Creating <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workobjects.html#workobjects.html">Objects (Display Lists)</A>.</P><hr><center>

</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X976d"></A>getbackface Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX574" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX575" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX576" REL="I3" TITLE="getbackface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX577" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX578" REL="I2" TITLE="backfacing polygons"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX579" REL="I3" TITLE="display"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX580" REL="I1" TITLE="getbackface subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X976f"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CD4639ceb"></A>Returns the state of backfacing filled polygon removal. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C121c"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CD4786ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CD4890ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9773"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9774"></A><B>Int32 getbackface(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C01078c"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01078d"></A><B>INTEGER*4  GETBAC</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9775"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CD5247ceb"></A>The <B>getbackface</B> subroutine returns the state of 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03bd">backfacing filled polygon</A> removal. If backface removal is on, the system draws only those polygons that face the viewer.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9e6d"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X977b"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X977c"></A>0</TD>
<TD>  Removal enabled.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X96c2"></A>1 </TD>
<TD>  Removal disabled.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165ec"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CD5612ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C121f"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1220"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1221"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X978d"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CD5965ceb"></A>Allowing or suppressing the display of backfacing polygons with the <A HREF="backface.html#A143X974b"><B>backface</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H2><A NAME="A145X9f6"></A>getbuffer Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX581" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX582" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX583" REL="I3" TITLE="getbuffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX584" REL="I1" TITLE="getbuffer subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX585" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX586" REL="I2" TITLE="buffers"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX587" REL="I3" TITLE="enabled for drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX588" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX589" REL="I2" TITLE="animation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX590" REL="I3" TITLE="getbuffer"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A145X9f8"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CF5319ceb"></A>Indicates which buffers are enabled for writing.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C120"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CF5468ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0CF5571ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A145X91ce"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A145X91cf"></A><B>Int32 getbuffer(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A145X9e7"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A145X9e8"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETBUF</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A145X9fe"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0CF5926ceb"></A>The <B>getbuffer</B> subroutine indicates which buffers are enabled for writing in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0474">double buffer</A> mode.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9c6c"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A145X9104"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Symbolic Name</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Buffer Enabled</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>NOBUFFER</TD>

<TD>NOBUFF</TD>

<TD>None</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>BCKBUFFER</TD>

<TD>BCKBUF</TD>

<TD>Back buffer (default)</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>FRNTBUFFER</TD>

<TD>FRNTBU</TD>

<TD>Front buffer</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>BOTHBUFFERS</TD>

<TD>BOTHBU</TD>

<TD>Both buffers</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>DRAWZBUFFER</TD>

<TD>DRAWZB</TD>

<TD>Z-buffer drawing</TD></TR></TABLE>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X91"></A>getbutton Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX591" REL="I1" TITLE="getbutton subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX592" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX593" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX594" REL="I3" TITLE="getbutton"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX595" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX596" REL="I2" TITLE="device"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX597" REL="I3" TITLE="returning button state"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX598" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX599" REL="I2" TITLE="queue and device"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX600" REL="I3" TITLE="getbutton"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X93"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D16177ceb"></A>Returns the state (up or down) of a button.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C113f"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D16327ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D16431ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X98"></A><B>Int32 getbutton(Device </B><A HREF="getbutton.html#A143X9c"><I>number</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c53"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c54"></A><B>LOGICAL FUNCTION GETBUT(</B><I>number</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>number</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C1142"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this function accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when invoked from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when invoked from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X99"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D16854ceb"></A>The <B>getbutton</B> subroutine returns the state of the button specified in the <A HREF="getbutton.html#A143X9c"><I>number</I></A> parameter. A complete list of buttons can be found in the file <B>/usr/include/gl/device.h</B>.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f71"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X9b"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X9c"></A><I>number</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of the button to test.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9f"></A>Return Values</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D17171ceb"></A>The return values and their corresponding states are as follows:</P>

<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Value</B></TD>

<TD><B> State</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>  0</TD>

<TD>Up</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>  1</TD>

<TD>Down</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>-1</TD>

<TD>Invalid device number</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01105e"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D17380ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="scrn_rotate_c.html#A16C0c92f"><B>scrn_rotate.c</B></A> uses the <B>getbutton</B> subroutine to check the state of various buttons. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C01660d"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D17541ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91d"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1143"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1144"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1145"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/device.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1146"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fdevice.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A318C9f72"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D17972ceb"></A>Returning the current state of a valuator with the <A HREF="getvaluator.html#A143X945"><B>getvaluator</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<A NAME="INDEX601" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>

<A NAME="INDEX603" REL="I3" TITLE="getcmmode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX604" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX605" REL="I2" TITLE="color map"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX606" REL="I3" TITLE="returning the organization of"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX607" REL="I1" TITLE="getcmmode subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A146X9490"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D38119ceb"></A>Returns the organization of the color map.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C144c"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D38269ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D38374ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9493"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X9494"></A><B>Int32 getcmmode(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X946b"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X946e"></A><B>LOGICAL FUNCTION GETCMM</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9497"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D38731ceb"></A>The <B>getcmmode</B> subroutine returns the organization of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A31996bc">color map</A>.  </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9cb4"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A146X949c"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Description</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>TRUE</TD>

<TD>CMAPMU</TD>

<TD>multimap mode</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>FALSE</TD>

<TD>CMAPON</TD>

<TD>onemap mode</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C01655a"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D39037ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C144f"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1450"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1451"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X94ae"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D39360ceb"></A>Returning the current display mode with the <A HREF="getdisplaymode.html#A145X9206"><B>getdisplaymode</B></A> subroutine</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D39573ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as 16 small maps with the <A HREF="multimap.html#A146X9593"><B>multimap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H2><A NAME="A146X924b"></A>getcolor Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX608" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX609" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX610" REL="I3" TITLE="getcolor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX611" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX612" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX613" REL="I3" TITLE="getcolor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX614" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX615" REL="I2" TITLE="colors"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX616" REL="I3" TITLE="current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX617" REL="I1" TITLE="getcolor subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A146X924d"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5B120ceb"></A>Returns the current color.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1a7"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5B269ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D5B373ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9250"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X9251"></A><B>Int32 getcolor(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9229"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X922c"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETCOL</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9254"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5B729ceb"></A>The <B>getcolor</B> subroutine returns the current index into the color map for the current drawing mode. In <A HREF="drawmode.html#A10C0abdc">NORMALDRAW</A>, an index from 0 to 4095 is returned. In <A HREF="drawmode.html#A10C0abdd">OVERDRAW</A> and <A HREF="drawmode.html#A10C0abd9">UNDERDRAW</A>, an index from 0 to 15 is returned. The under/over planes have a color map that is separate from the main color map.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d1d"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A146X9257"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5B941ceb"></A>An index into the color map for the current color.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015c75"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C101ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9245"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1aa"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1ab"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9269"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C423ceb"></A>Setting the color index in the current mode with the <A HREF="color.html#A146X9429"><B>color</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C530ceb"></A>Specifying the target framebuffer of the drawing subroutines with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C638ceb"></A>Returning a color map entry with the <A HREF="getmcolor.html#nXI1100marj"><B>getmcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C744ceb"></A>Returning the current RGB value with the <A HREF="gRGBcolor.html#ESL13a0marj"><B>gRGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D5C853ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/animatescene.html#animatescene.html">Creating Animated Scenes</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying the System</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/setglattrib.html#setglattrib.html">Setting Drawing Attributes</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Understanding the Hardware Used by GL</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawpoly.html#drawpoly.html">Drawing Rectangles, Circles, Arcs, and Polygons</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Working in Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<A NAME="INDEX618" REL="I1" TITLE="getcpos subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX619" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9366"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D7C157ceb"></A>Returns the current character position.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C122a"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D7C307ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D7C411ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X936a"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912636"></A><B>void getcpos(Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getcpos.html#A213X91263a"><I>ix</I></A><B>, Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getcpos.html#A213X91263b"><I>iy</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010bf8"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010bf9"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETCPO(</B><I>ix</I><B>, </B><I>iy</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>ix</I><B>, </B><I>iy</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X936c"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D7C782ceb"></A>The <B>getcpos</B> subroutine gets the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e9">current character position</A>, in screen coordinates relative to the lower left corner of the window, and writes it into the parameters.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f19"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X936e"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X91263a"></A><I>ix</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location in which to write the <I>x</I> coordinate of the current character position. </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X91263b"></A><I>iy</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location in which to write the <I>y</I> coordinate of the current character position. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d8a"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D7D163ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C122d"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C122e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C122f"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9384"></A>Related Information</H3>

<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="sP1160nita"></A>getcursor Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX628" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX629" REL="I2" TITLE="cursor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX630" REL="I3" TITLE="getcursor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX631" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX632" REL="I2" TITLE="cursor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX633" REL="I3" TITLE="returning characteristics"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX634" REL="I1" TITLE="getcursor subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910e52"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D9D727ceb"></A>Returns the cursor characteristics.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1df"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D9D876ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D9D980ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910e55"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X910e56"></A><B>void getcursor</B>
<B>(Int16 *</B><A HREF="getcursor.html#JD3120nita"><I>index</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>Colorindex *</B><A HREF="getcursor.html#dD3240nita"><I>color</I></A><B>, Colorindex *</B><A HREF="getcursor.html#AD31a0nita"><I>writemask</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>Int32 *</B><A HREF="getcursor.html#KE32a0nita"><I>bool</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910e31"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X910e34"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETCUR(</B><I>index</I><B>,</B><I> color</I><B>, </B><I>writemask</I><B>,</B><I> bool</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>index</I><B>,</B><I> color</I><B>,</B><I> writemask</I>
<B>LOGICAL</B><I> bool</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910e59"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D9E352ceb"></A>The <B>getcursor</B> subroutine finds the index of the current
 <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A263A93ae">cursor</A> and returns it in the <A HREF="getcursor.html#JD3120nita"><I>index</I></A> parameter. The cursor index is an index into a table of cursor bitmaps set by the <A HREF="defcursor.html#A150X9444"><B>defcursor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D9E460ceb"></A>The default is the cursor at index 0 (zero) in the cursor bitmaps. This cursor is displayed in red and is automatically updated on each vertical retrace.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9cd1"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X910e5d"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="JD3120nita"></A><I>index</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an index that was previously associated with a bitmap by the <A HREF="defcursor.html#A150X9444"><B>defcursor</B></A> subroutine.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="dD3240nita"></A><I>color</I></TD>
<TD>  Retained for compatibility, but disregarded.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="AD31a0nita"></A><I>writemask</I></TD>
<TD>  Retained for compatibility, but disregarded.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="KE32a0nita"></A><I>bool</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which the system returns a boolean indicating if the cursor is visible in the current window.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016570"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D9E955ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1e2"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1e3"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1e4"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910e69"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0D9F321ceb"></A>Defining a cursor with the <A HREF="defcursor.html#A150X9444"><B>defcursor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D9F428ceb"></A>Setting the cursor characteristics with the <A HREF="setcursor.html#ZR1nita"><B>setcursor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0D9F536ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/cursorgl.html#cursorgl.html">Creating a Cursor</A>, and Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A5OK230marj"></A>getdcm Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX635" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX636" REL="I2" TITLE="depth-cue"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX637" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX638" REL="I2" TITLE="depth-cueing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX639" REL="I3" TITLE="indicating whether on or off"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX640" REL="I1" TITLE="getdcm subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91115e"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DC5584ceb"></A>Indicates whether depth-cue mode is on or off.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C114d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DC5732ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DC5835ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911161"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911162"></A><B>Int32 getdcm(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91113d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911140"></A><B>LOGICAL FUNCTION GETDCM</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911165"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DC6195ceb"></A>The <B>getdcm</B> subroutine returns True if the system is in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A150P19d9">depth-cue mode</A> and False if it is not.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9cea"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911168"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911169"></A>False</TD>
<TD>  System not in depth-cue mode.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X91116a"></A>True</TD>
<TD>  System in depth-cue mode.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165ac"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DC6585ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1150"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1151"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1152"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911176"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DC6913ceb"></A>Turning depth-cueing on and off with the <A HREF="depthcue.html#PNK22d0marj"><B>depthcue</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X9386"></A>getdescender Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX641" REL="I1" TITLE="getdescender subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX642" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX643" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX644" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX645" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX646" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX647" REL="I3" TITLE="getdescender"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX648" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX649" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX650" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9388"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE7382ceb"></A>Returns the baseline extent of the longest character descender.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1230"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE7530ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE7634ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X938c"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A144X938d"></A><B>Int32 getdescender(&nbsp;);</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010bfd"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010bfe"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETDES</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X938e"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE7991ceb"></A>The <B>getdescender </B>subroutine returns the maximum distance (in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06fd">pixels</A>) between the baseline of a character and the bottom of the bitmap for that character. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE8099ceb"></A>Each character in a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A270A983b">font</A> is defined using a bitmap that is displayed relative to the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e9">current character position</A>. Vertical placement of each character is done using the current character position as the baseline or the line on the page. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE8209ceb"></A>The portion of a character that extends below the baseline is called a descender. The lowercase characters g and p typically have descenders. The returned value of this function is the length (in pixels) of the longest descender in the current font.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f1c"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X9394"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE8423ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d8d"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE8583ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows environment.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1233"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1234"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1235"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93a6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0DE8905ceb"></A>Returning the current raster font number with the <A HREF="getfont.html#A144X93a8"><B>getfont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE9012ceb"></A>Returning the maximum character height in the current raster font with the <A HREF="getheight.html#A144X93ca"><B>getheight</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE9120ceb"></A>Returning the width of the specified text string with the <A HREF="strwidth.html#A144X93ec"><B>strwidth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0DE9229ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, Creating <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/textchars.html#textchars.html">Text Characters</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P><hr><center>

<H2><A NAME="A143X923"></A>getdev Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX651" REL="I1" TITLE="getdev (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX652" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX653" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX654" REL="I3" TITLE="getdev"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X925"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E08114ceb"></A>Reads a list of valuators.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1148"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E08263ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E08367ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X929"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X92a"></A><B>void getdev</B>
<B>(Int32</B> <A HREF="getdev.html#A143X92e"><I>number</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>Device *</B><A HREF="getdev.html#A143X92f"><I>devices</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>Int16 *</B><A HREF="getdev.html#A143X930"><I>values</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c59"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c5a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETDEV(</B><I>number</I><B>, </B><I>devices</I><B>, </B><I>values</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>number</I>
<B>INTEGER*2</B> <I>devices</I><B>(</B><I>number</I><B>), </B><I>values</I><B>(</B><I>number</I><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X92b"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E08735ceb"></A>The <B>getdev</B> subroutine allows you to read as many as 128 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A79P07a">valuators</A> and 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A1819349">buttons</A> (input devices) at one time. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A81C11f3"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X92d"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X92e"></A><I>number</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of devices pointed to by the <I>devices </I>parameter (no more than 128).</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X92f"></A><I>devices</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing the identifiers (device number constants, such as MOUSEX, BPADX, and LEFTMOUSE) of the devices to read. The array pointed to by the <A HREF="getdev.html#A143X92f"><I>devices</I></A> parameter can contain up to 128 devices.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X930"></A><I>values</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the array into which the system is to write the values read from the devices listed in the <I>devices </I>array. Each member in the <A HREF="getdev.html#A143X930"><I>values</I></A> array corresponds to a member of the <I>devices </I>array and returns the state of each device in the corresponding location.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016610"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E09170ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X93f"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C114b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C114c"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C114d"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/device.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C114e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fdevice.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X943"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E09601ceb"></A>Returning the current state of a valuator with the <A HREF="getvaluator.html#A143X945"><B>getvaluator</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<A NAME="INDEX661" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>

<A NAME="INDEX663" REL="I3" TITLE="getdisplaymode"></A>

<A NAME="INDEX667" REL="I3" TITLE="returning current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX668" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX669" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX670" REL="I3" TITLE="doublebuffer"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A145X9208"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E29003ceb"></A>Returns the current display mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C125"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E29152ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E29256ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A145X920b"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A145X920c"></A><B>Int32 getdisplaymode(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A145X91e4"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A145X91e7"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETDIS</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A145X920f"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E29611ceb"></A>The <B>getdisplaymode</B> subroutine returns the current configuration of the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A270A984a">frame buffer</A> bitplanes and 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A31996bc">color map</A>. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9c72"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A145X9212"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>Symbolic Name</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Display Mode</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>DMRGB</TD>

<TD>DMRGB</TD>

<TD>RGB single buffer mode</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>DMSINGLE</TD>

<TD>DMSING</TD>

<TD>Color map single buffer mode</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>DMDOUBLE</TD>

<TD>DMDOUB</TD>

<TD>Color map double buffer mode</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>DMRGBDOUBLE</TD>

<TD>DMRGBD</TD>

<TD>RGB double buffermode</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015ca3"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E29957ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A145X9220"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C128"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C129"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A258C01c347"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A276ceb"></A>Setting color mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A383ceb"></A>Setting the display mode to double buffer mode with the <A HREF="doublebuffer.html#A145X91a7"><B>doublebuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A490ceb"></A>Returning the organization of the current color map with the <A HREF="getcmmode.html#A146X948e"><B>getcmmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A596ceb"></A>Returning the current drawing mode with the <A HREF="getdrawmode.html#A143X9482"><B>getdrawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A707ceb"></A>Setting a display mode that bypasses the color map with the <A HREF="RGBmode.html#A143X93b6"><B>RGBmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E2A813ceb"></A>Setting the display to single buffer mode with the <A HREF="singlebuffer.html#A145X9259"><B>singlebuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

 for GL.</P><hr><center>

<H2><A NAME="A143X9482"></A>getdrawmode Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX671" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX672" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer configuration"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX673" REL="I3" TITLE="getdrawmode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX674" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX675" REL="I2" TITLE="drawing mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX676" REL="I3" TITLE="returning the current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX677" REL="I1" TITLE="getdrawmode subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9484"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E49357ceb"></A>Returns the current drawing mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11be"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E49506ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E49611ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9488"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9489"></A><B>Int32 getdrawmode(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C01070b"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01070c"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETDRA</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X948a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E49967ceb"></A>The <B>getdrawmode</B> subroutine returns the current drawing mode specified by the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.  </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9c93"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X9490"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>Symbolic Name</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Draw mode</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>UNDERDRAW</TD>

<TD>UNDRDR</TD>

<TD>Underlay (background) bitplanes</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>NORMALDRAW</TD>

<TD>NORMDR</TD>

<TD>Main frame buffer bitplanes</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>OVERDRAW</TD>

<TD>OVRDRW</TD>

<TD>Overlay (foreground) bitplanes</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>PUPDRAW</TD>

<TD>PUPDRW</TD>

<TD>Pop-up menus</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>CURSORDRAW</TD>

<TD>CURSDR</TD>

<TD>Cursor mode</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C010fca"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E4A322ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="prompt_c.html#A16C0c8de"><B>prompt.c</B></A> uses the <B>getdrawmode</B> subroutine to get the current drawing mode so that it can be restored later.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016550"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E4A484ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11c1"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11c2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11c3"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X94a2"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E4A801ceb"></A>Choosing a set of bitplanes for drawing with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E4A908ceb"></A>Returning the current display mode with the <A HREF="getdisplaymode.html#A145X9206"><B>getdisplaymode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E4B015ceb"></A>Popping the viewport stack with the <A HREF="popviewport.html#A213X911d3c"><B>popviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E4B232ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operation</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P><hr><center>
