<H2><A NAME="A144X93a8"></A>getfont Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX678" REL="I1" TITLE="getfont subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX679" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX680" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX681" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX682" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX683" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX684" REL="I3" TITLE="getfont"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX685" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX686" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX687" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93aa"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E68860ceb"></A>Returns the index of the current raster font.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1240"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E69010ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E69115ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93ae"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X91264e"></A><B>Int32 getfont(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c02"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c03"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETFON</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93b0"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E69473ceb"></A>The <B>getfont </B>subroutine returns the index of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P073b">raster font</A>. The returned value is an index into the raster font table.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f1f"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X93b6"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E69684ceb"></A>The index of the current raster font.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d8f"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E69846ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1243"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1244"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1245"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93c8"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E6A168ceb"></A>Writing a text string with the <A HREF="charstr.html#A143X9cfb"><B>charstr</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E6A274ceb"></A>Defining bitmaps for a raster font with the <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Az7960nita"></A>getfontencoding Subroutine</H2>
<H3><A NAME="A140C17c8"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E89709ceb"></A>Indicates the font encoding.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17ca"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E89858ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E89962ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17cd"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A140C17ce"></A><B>void getfontencoding (char *</B><A HREF="getfontencoding.html#A140C17d9"><I>enc</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17cf"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A140C17d0"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETFONTENCODING (</B><I>enc</I><B>)</B>
<B>CHARACTER *(*)</B> <A HREF="getfontencoding.html#A140C17d9"><I>enc</I></A></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17d1"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E8A327ceb"></A>The <B>getfontencoding</B> subroutine returns an ASCII string that indicates the registry and encoding of the currently bound font.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8A436ceb"></A>The returned string is always NULL for user-defined fonts (defined with the <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A> subroutine). The returned string may or may not be NULL for fonts loaded with the <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A> subroutine. Typically, newer fonts indicate their encoding, older fonts do not.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8A543ceb"></A>The encoding is determined with the Enhanced X-Windows Logical Font Description (XLFD) mechanism. The actual string returned is a concatenation of the contents of the CharSetRegistry and CharSetEncoding fields of logical font description.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8A652ceb"></A>Examples of font set registries and encodings are ISO8859-5 or JISX.1983-0. In the first example, ISO8859 is the registry (in this case, the International Standard ISO 8859, Information Processing - 8-bit Single Byte Coded Graphics Character Sets), and 5 is the encoding (in this case, ISO 8859/5, a Russian/Cyrillic encoding).</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8A762ceb"></A>More information about font encodings can be found in 
"<!--:genprogc:--><A HREF="../genprogc/nls.html#A2919f7">National Language Support Overview</A>". </P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17d8"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C17d9"></A><I>enc</I></TD>
<TD>  Indicates a pointer to a memory location. The user passes a pointer to a memory area that point to <I>at least</I> 24 bytes that can be overwritten. Upon return, their memory area contains a ASCII string identifying the registry and encoding of the currently bound font.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17de"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B030ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17e0"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C17e1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C17e2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17e7"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B355ceb"></A>Determining the font format with the <A HREF="getfonttype.html#Y89340nita"><B>getfonttype</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B464ceb"></A>Defining bitmaps for a raster font with the <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B570ceb"></A>Selecting a raster font with the <A HREF="font.html#A143X9d61"><B>font</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B686ceb"></A>Loading an Enhanced X-Windows font into the font table with the <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B> </A>subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8B794ceb"></A><!--:genprogc:--><A HREF="../genprogc/nls.html#A2919f7">National Language Support Overview</A> in<I> AIX General Programming Concepts: Writing and Debugging Programs</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0E8C008ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Y89340nita"></A>getfonttype Subroutine</H2>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17ec"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EA9736ceb"></A>Indicates whether the current font is a double-byte character set (DBCS) font.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17ee"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EA9884ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EA9988ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17f1"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A140C17f2"></A><B>int getfonttype()</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17f3"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A140C17f4"></A><B>INTEGER *4 FUNCTION GETFONT</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C17f5"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EAA346ceb"></A>The <B>getfonttype</B> subroutine indicates whether the currently bound font is a single-byte or double-byte font.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EAA455ceb"></A>The behavior of the <A HREF="charstr.html#A143X9cfb"><B>charstr</B></A> subroutine depends on the font type of the currently loaded font. Use the <B>getfonttype</B> subroutine to determine whether to pass single-byte or double-byte character strings to the <B>charstr</B> subroutine.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A140C17f8"></A><B>Note: </B>Most European fonts, including all ISO8859 code sets, are single-byte fonts. Most Asian font sets, including the JIS (Japanese Kanji) fonts, are double-byte fonts.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A140C17f9"></A>Return Values</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C17fa"></A><B>FT_SBCS</B></TD>
<TD>  Indicates that the current font is a single-byte font.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C17fb"></A><B>FT_DBCS</B></TD>
<TD>  Indicates that the current font is a double-byte font.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C1800"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EAA834ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A140C1802"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C1803"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C1804"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A140C1809"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EAB155ceb"></A>Determining the font name with the <A HREF="getfontencoding.html#Az7960nita"><B>getfontencoding</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EAB262ceb"></A>Defining bitmaps for a raster font with the <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EAB370ceb"></A>Selecting a raster font with the <A HREF="font.html#A143X9d61"><B>font</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EAB478ceb"></A><!--:genprogc:--><A HREF="../genprogc/nls.html#A2919f7">National Language Support Overview for Programming</A> in<I> AIX General Programming Concepts: Writing and Debugging Programs</I>.</P>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="t9311e0marj"></A>getgdesc Subroutine</H2>
<H3><A NAME="A335C95993"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED0143ceb"></A>Returns information about the currently installed graphics hardware
.
</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1d8"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED0295ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0ED0400ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A335C95996"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A335C95997"></A><B>Int32 getgdesc(Int32 </B><A HREF="getgdesc.html#QH41a0marj"><I>inquiry</I></A><B>);</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1db"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A77C1dc"></A><B>INTEGER *4 FUNCTION GETGDE(</B><I>inquiry</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4</B> <I>inquiry</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A335C9599a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED0773ceb"></A>The <B>getgdesc </B>subroutine allows you to inquire about characteristics of the graphics system. The characteristics are all hardware characteristics; that is, the values returned do not change as the adapter is software reconfigured.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0ED0882ceb"></A>It is not necessary to open a GL window or call the <B>ginit</B> subroutine before using the <B>getgdesc </B>subroutine.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A335C959a0"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A335C959a1"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="QH41a0marj"></A><I>inquiry</I></TD>
<TD>  Represents the characteristics about which you want to inquire. Inquiries are submitted using <A HREF="Tokens.html#QP3a0nita">tokens</A>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A335C959a2"></A>Return Values</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED1208ceb"></A>The value of the requested characteristic, or -1 if the request is not valid or cannot be determined. For a listing of return values for adapters, see the <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/descrtable.html#descrtable.html">"Adapter Description Table for GL"</A>, Appendix B.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1dd"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED1370ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1df"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1e0"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1e1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A258C01c844"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0ED1696ceb"></A>Getting the library version number with the <A HREF="gversion.html#A237X9480e"><B>gversion</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0ED1804ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Understanding the Hardware</A> Used by GL and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/clrrstintgl.html#clrrstintgl.html">Clearing, Setting, and Initializing GL</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P><hr><center>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="CZf60marj"></A>getgpos Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX688" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX689" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX690" REL="I3" TITLE="getgpos"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX691" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX692" REL="I2" TITLE="moveraw style"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX693" REL="I3" TITLE="getgpos"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX694" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX695" REL="I2" TITLE="graphics position"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX696" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX697" REL="I1" TITLE="getgpos subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912c91"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EF2530ceb"></A>Returns the current graphics position. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C12eb"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EF2679ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0EF2788ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912c94"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912c95"></A><B>void getgpos</B>
<B>(Coord</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getgpos.html#A213X912c9c"><I>fx</I></A><B>, Coord</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getgpos.html#A213X912c9d"><I>fy</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>Coord</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getgpos.html#A213X912c9e"><I>fz</I></A><B>, Coord</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getgpos.html#A213X912c9f"><I>fw</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010aad"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010aae"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETGPO(</B><I>fx</I><B>, </B><I>fy</I><B>, </B><I>fz</I><B>, </B><I>fw</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL</B> <I>fx</I><B>,</B><I> fy</I><B>,</B><I> fz</I><B>,</B><I> fw</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912c98"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EF3163ceb"></A>The <B>getgpos </B>subroutine returns the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03eb">current graphics position</A> after 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03ed">transformation by the current matrix</A>. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9da7"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X912c9b"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X912c9c"></A><I>fx</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the pointer to the location into which to write the <I>x</I> coordinate of the current graphics position.  </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X912c9d"></A><I>fy</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the pointer to the location into which to write the <I>y</I> coordinate of the current graphics position.  </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X912c9e"></A><I>fz</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the pointer to the location into which to write the <I>z</I> coordinate of the current graphics position.  </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X912c9f"></A><I>fw</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the pointer to the location into which to write the <I>w</I> coordinate of the current graphics position. The <I>w</I> value is used when defining a 3-D point in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0623">homogeneous coordinates</A>.  </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d12"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0EF3662ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C12ee"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C12ef"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C12f0"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912cad"></A>Related Information</H3>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X93ca"></A>getheight Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX698" REL="I1" TITLE="getheight subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX699" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX700" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX701" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX702" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX703" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX704" REL="I3" TITLE="getheight"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX705" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX706" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX707" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93cc"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F13440ceb"></A>Returns the maximum character height in the current raster font.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1246"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F13591ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F13696ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93d0"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912657"></A><B>Int32 getheight(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c07"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c08"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETHEI</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93d2"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F14061ceb"></A>The <B>getheight </B>subroutine returns the maximum height of the characters, in the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P073b">raster font</A>. The height is defined as the number of 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06fd">pixels</A> between the top of the tallest ascender (in characters such as f and h) and the bottom of the lowest descender (in characters such as y and p). </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f22"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X93d8"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F14278ceb"></A>The maximum height (in pixels) of a character in the current font.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A5C0a357"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F14441ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1249"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C124a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C124b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X93ea"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F14767ceb"></A>Returning the baseline extent of the longest character descender with the <A HREF="getdescender.html#A144X9386"><B>getdescender</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F14874ceb"></A>Returning the current raster font number with the <A HREF="getfont.html#A144X93a8"><B>getfont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F14995ceb"></A>Returning the width of the specified text string with the <A HREF="strwidth.html#A144X93ec"><B>strwidth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<A NAME="INDEX716" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX717" REL="I1" TITLE="getlsrepeat subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9ba9"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F32542ceb"></A>Returns the linestyle repeat count.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1f9"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F32692ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F32797ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9bad"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9bae"></A><B>Int32 getlsrepeat(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0f3"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0f4"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETLSR</B> </PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9baf"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F33157ceb"></A>The <B>getlsrepeat</B> subroutine returns the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A172P1436">linestyle</A> repeat factor, which is set by the <A HREF="lsrepeat.html#DmN1110marj"><B>lsrepeat</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d34"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X9bb5"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F33370ceb"></A>The repeat factor for the current linestyle.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015c87"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F33531ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A11C0b4df"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1fc"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1fd"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A258C01c39f"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F33851ceb"></A>Setting the repeat factor for the current linestyle with the <A HREF="lsrepeat.html#DmN1110marj"><B>lsrepeat</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9bcb"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F52978ceb"></A>Returns the current linestyle.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1fe"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F53127ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F53232ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9bcf"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9bd0"></A><B>Int32 getlstyle(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0f5"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0f6"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETLST</B> </PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9bd1"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F53592ceb"></A>The <B>getlstyle</B> subroutine returns the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A172P1436">linestyle</A>. The returned value is an index into the linestyle table.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d37"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X9bd7"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F53805ceb"></A>An index into the linestyle table for the current linestyle.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015c89"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F53967ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1102"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A146X94e2"></A>getmap Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX738" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX739" REL="I2" TITLE="color map and RGB mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX740" REL="I3" TITLE="getmap"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX741" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX742" REL="I2" TITLE="color map"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX743" REL="I3" TITLE="returning number of current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX744" REL="I1" TITLE="getmap (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A146X94e4"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F91210ceb"></A>Returns the number of the current color map.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C137"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F91360ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F91465ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A146X94e7"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X94e8"></A><B>Int32 getmap(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X94c0"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A146X94c3"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETMAP</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X94eb"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F91823ceb"></A>The <B>getmap</B> subroutine returns the identification number of the current color map. In <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#a3P1390marj">multimap mode</A>, there are 16 small, independent color maps; therefore, the <B>getmap</B> subroutine returns a value in the range 0 to 15. In <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#a3P1390marj">onemap mode</A>, the <B>getmap</B> subroutine returns 0 (zero).</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9cba"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A146X94ee"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F92036ceb"></A>The number of the current color map, a value from 0 to 15.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C01655e"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F92200ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C13a"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C13b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C13c"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A146X9500"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0F92520ceb"></A>Returning the organization of the current color map with the <A HREF="getcmmode.html#A146X948e"><B>getcmmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F92627ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as 16 small maps with the <A HREF="multimap.html#A146X9593"><B>multimap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F92741ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as one large map with the <A HREF="onemap.html#A146X95ef"><B>onemap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F92852ceb"></A>Selecting one of 16 small color maps with the <A HREF="setmap.html#A146X9646"><B>setmap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F92960ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0F93068ceb"></A>Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X940e"></A>getmatrix Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX745" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX746" REL="I2" TITLE="coordinate transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX747" REL="I3" TITLE="getmatrix"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX748" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX749" REL="I2" TITLE="matrix"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX750" REL="I3" TITLE="transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX751" REL="I1" TITLE="getmatrix subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9410"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB2429ceb"></A>Returns the current transformation matrix. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C16d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB2577ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB2682ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9414"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X9126c1"></A><B>void getmatrix(Matrix </B><A HREF="getmatrix.html#Lyi1f0marj"><I>matrix</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A13C0bdc3"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A13C0bdc4"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETMAT(</B><I>matrix</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>matrix</I><B>(4,4)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9416"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB3047ceb"></A>The <B>getmatrix </B>subroutine copies the matrix from the top of the stack to a user-specified array. This routine does not alter the matrix stack. When the system is in projection matrix mode, the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06dd">matrix stack</A> is not accessible. In projection mode, the <A HREF="getmatrix.html#Lyi1f0marj"><I>matrix</I></A> array receives a copy of the projection matrix instead.  </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9df1"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X9418"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Lyi1f0marj"></A><I>matrix</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array into which to copy a matrix.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X941e"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB3364ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="scrn_rotate_c.html#A16C0c92f"><B>scrn_rotate.c</B></A> uses the <B>getmatrix</B> subroutine to get the current transformation matrix after manipulating it.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d30"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB3526ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C170"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C171"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C172"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X942e"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FB3846ceb"></A>Loading a transformation matrix with the <A HREF="loadmatrix.html#A144X9430"><B>loadmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB3952ceb"></A>Setting the current matrix mode with the <A HREF="mmode.html#XhZ2370marj"><B>mmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB4060ceb"></A>Premultiplying the current transformation matrix with the <A HREF="multmatrix.html#A144X9474"><B>multmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB4169ceb"></A>Popping the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="popmatrix.html#A144X951e"><B>popmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB4278ceb"></A>Pushing down the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="pushmatrix.html#A144X9540"><B>pushmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FB4386ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System, and Working with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcoords.html#workcoords.html">Coordinate Systems</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="nXI1100marj"></A>getmcolor Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX752" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX753" REL="I2" TITLE="color map and RGB mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX754" REL="I3" TITLE="getmcolor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX755" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX756" REL="I2" TITLE="color map entry"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX757" REL="I3" TITLE="getting a copy of RGB values for"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX758" REL="I1" TITLE="getmcolor subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910dac"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD5562ceb"></A>Gets a copy of the RGB values for a color map entry.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C13e"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD5712ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD5816ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910daf"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X910db0"></A><B>void getmcolor</B>
<B>(Colorindex </B><A HREF="getmcolor.html#liG2200marj"><I>index</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Int16</B> *<A HREF="getmcolor.html#yiG21c0marj"><I>red</I></A><B>,</B> <B>Int16</B> *<A HREF="getmcolor.html#A8jG2320marj"><I>green</I></A><B>, Int16</B> *<A HREF="getmcolor.html#IjG22c0marj"><I>blue</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A18C0dcf4"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A18C0dcf5"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETMCO(</B><I>index</I><B>,</B> <I>red</I><B>,</B> <I>green</I><B>,</B> <I>blue</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4</B> <I>index</I>
<B>INTEGER*2</B> <I>red</I><B>,</B> <I>green</I><B>,</B> <I>blue</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910db3"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD6190ceb"></A>The <B>getmcolor </B>subroutine gets the red, green, and blue components of a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A31996bc">color map</A> entry and copies them to the specified locations. This subroutine returns only the values associated with a slot in the current color table. It does not return, nor does it set, the current drawing color. For the current drawing color, use the <A HREF="getcolor.html#A146X924b"><B>getcolor</B></A> subroutine in color map mode, and the <A HREF="gRGBcolor.html#ESL13a0marj"><B>gRGBcolor</B></A> subroutine in RGB mode.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9cb7"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X910db6"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="liG2200marj"></A><I>index</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the index into the color map.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="yiG21c0marj"></A><I>red</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which to copy the red value of the color specified by <I>index</I>.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A8jG2320marj"></A><I>green</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which to copy the green value of the color specified by <I>index</I>.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="IjG22c0marj"></A><I>blue</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which to copy the blue value of the color specified by <I>index</I>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010a02"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD6677ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="overlay_c.html#A11C0b47c"><B>overlay.c</B></A> uses the <B>getmcolor</B> subroutine to save the values in the color map before changing them with the <A HREF="mapcolor.html#A146X9535"><B>mapcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C01655c"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD6838ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C141"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C142"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C143"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X910dc1"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7159ceb"></A>Choosing a set of bitplanes for drawing with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7267ceb"></A>Returning the current color with the <A HREF="getcolor.html#A146X924b"><B>getcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7374ceb"></A>Returning the number of the current color map with the <A HREF="getmap.html#A146X94e2"><B>getmap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7482ceb"></A>Returning the current RGB color with the <A HREF="gRGBcolor.html#ESL13a0marj"><B>gRGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7588ceb"></A>Changing a color map entry to an RGB value with the <A HREF="mapcolor.html#A146X9535"><B>mapcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7695ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FD7803ceb"></A>Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="UI2f0marj"></A>getmcolors Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX759" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX760" REL="I2" TITLE="color map and RGB mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX761" REL="I3" TITLE="getmcolors"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX762" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX763" REL="I2" TITLE="color map"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX764" REL="I3" TITLE="returning range of RGB values"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX765" REL="I1" TITLE="getmcolors subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A58C0153f9"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFC285ceb"></A>Returns a range of color map RGB values.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C145"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFC434ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFC538ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A58C0153fd"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFC694ceb"></A><B>void getmcolors(Int16 </B><A HREF="getmcolors.html#lq21f0marj"><I>start_idx</I></A><B>, Int16</B> <A HREF="getmcolors.html#Vr23b0marj"><I>end_idx</I></A><B>,&nbsp;Int16</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getmcolors.html#hr21d0marj"><I>r</I></A><B>, Int16</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getmcolors.html#yr230marj"><I>g</I></A><B>, Int16</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getmcolors.html#Ys2390marj"><I>b</I></A><B>)</B></P>

<H3><A NAME="A58C0153ff"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A58C015400"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETMCOLORS (</B><I>start_idx</I><B>,</B> <I>end_idx</I><B>,</B> <I>r</I><B>,</B> <I>g</I><B>,</B> <I>b</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>start_idx</I><B>, </B><I>end_idx</I><B>,</B>
<B>INTEGER*2</B><I> r(1)</I><B>, </B><I>g(1)</I><B>, </B><I>b(1)</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A78C148"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this subroutine accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when started from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when started from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A58C015401"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFD019ceb"></A>The <B>getmcolors</B> subroutine returns a range of color map table entries. The range that is returned begins with the <A HREF="getmcolors.html#lq21f0marj"><I>start_idx</I></A> parameter and ends with the <A HREF="getmcolors.html#Vr23b0marj"><I>end_idx</I></A> parameter, inclusive. The length of the array must be equal to <I>end_idx</I> - <I>start_idx</I> + 1. For instance, to return only one color map entry, set <I>start_idx</I> and <I>end_idx</I> to the same number. To return two entries, set <I>end_idx</I> to <I>start_idx&nbsp;</I>+&nbsp;1.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFD127ceb"></A>The <B>getmcolors</B> subroutine is functionally equivalent to the C code shown in the following fragment, although it executes considerably faster.</P>
<PRE><A NAME="A58C015404"></A>&nbsp;{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int&nbsp;i;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for&nbsp;(&nbsp;i=0;&nbsp;i&nbsp;&lt;&nbsp;(end_idx&nbsp;-&nbsp;start_idx&nbsp;+&nbsp;1);&nbsp;i++&nbsp;)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;getmcolors&nbsp;(start_idx+i,&amp;r[i],&amp;g[i],&amp;b[i]);
&nbsp;}</PRE>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFD292ceb"></A>The <B>getmcolors</B> subroutine can be used to read the underlay, overlay, cursor, pop-up, or main frame buffer color map. Which map is read depends on the current drawing mode (as set by the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine).</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A58C015406"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A58C015407"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="lq21f0marj"></A><I>start_idx</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the starting index in the color map to be returned.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Vr23b0marj"></A><I>end_idx</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the ending index in the color map to be returned.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="hr21d0marj"></A><I>r</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing the intensity of the red component.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="yr230marj"></A><I>g</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing the intensity of the green component.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Ys2390marj"></A><I>b</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing the intensity of the blue component.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016566"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFD837ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C149"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C14a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C14b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A58C01540a"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B0FFE153ceb"></A>Choosing a set of bitplanes for drawing with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFE260ceb"></A>Returning the current RGB color with the <A HREF="gRGBcolor.html#ESL13a0marj"><B>gRGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFE367ceb"></A>Loading a range of color map entries with the <A HREF="mapcolors.html#cv2170marj"><B>mapcolors</B></A> subroutine</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B0FFE475ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P>

<A NAME="INDEX772" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>

<A NAME="INDEX774" REL="I3" TITLE="returning current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX775" REL="I1" TITLE="getmmode subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ecf"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B101D352ceb"></A>Returns the current matrix mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C12c3"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B101D501ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B101D604ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ed2"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911ed3"></A><B>Int32 getmmode( )</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911eaf"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911eb2"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETMMO</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ed6"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B101D957ceb"></A>The <B>getmmode</B> subroutine returns the current matrix mode.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d6e"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911ed9"></A>Return Values</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B101E169ceb"></A>There are three possible return values for this function:</P>

<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Mode</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>MSINGLE</TD>

<TD>MSINGL</TD>

<TD>Single matrix</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>MPROJECTION</TD>

<TD>MPROJE</TD>

<TD>Projection matrix</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>MVIEWING</TD>

<TD>MVIEWI</TD>

<TD>Viewing matrix</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015ce8"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B101E385ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C12c6"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C12c7"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C12c8"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ee4"></A>Related Information</H3>

<H2><A NAME="A252X986e"></A>getnurbsproperty Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX776" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX777" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX778" REL="I3" TITLE="getnurbsproperty"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX779" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX780" REL="I2" TITLE="NURBS curves and surfaces"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX781" REL="I3" TITLE="getnurbsproperty"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX782" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX783" REL="I2" TITLE="surface (NURBS)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX784" REL="I3" TITLE="returning value of display property"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX785" REL="I1" TITLE="getnurbsproperty subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A252X9870"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1050684ceb"></A>Returns the current value of a trimmed NURBS surfaces display property</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C133c"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1050832ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1050937ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A252X9873"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A252X9874"></A><B>void getnurbsproperty(Int32</B> <A HREF="getnurbsproperty.html#A252X987d"><I>property</I></A><B>, Float32</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="getnurbsproperty.html#A252X987e"><I>value</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A252X984c"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A252X984f"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETNUR(</B><I>property</I><B>,</B><I> value</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4</B> <I>property</I>
<B>REAL</B> <I>value</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A252X9877"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1051318ceb"></A>The <B>getnurbsproperty</B> subroutine returns the current value of a trimmed Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) surfaces display property. The display of NURBS surfaces can be controlled in different ways, as explained in the description of the <A HREF="getnurbsproperty.html#A252X987e"><I>value</I></A> parameter.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f29"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A252X987c"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A252X987d"></A><I>property</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the name of the property to be queried.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A252X987e"></A><I>value</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which the system is to write the value of the named property. The display properties that can be affected and their possible values are as follows:


<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Description</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>N_ERRORCHECKING</TD>

<TD>NERROR</TD>

<TD>If value is 1.0, some error checking is enabled. If error checking is disabled, the system runs slightly faster. The default value is 0.0.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>N_PIXEL_TOLERANCE</TD>

<TD>NPIXEL</TD>

<TD>The value is the maximum length, in pixels, of edges of polygons on the screen used to render trimmed NURBS surfaces. The default value is 50.0 pixels.</TD></TR></TABLE></TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d9e"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1051736ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C133f"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1340"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1341"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A252X9883"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1052060ceb"></A>Marking the beginning and end of a NURBS surface definition with the <A HREF="bgnsurface.html#A251X9d7"><B>bgnsurface </B>and <B>endsurface</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052167ceb"></A>Marking the beginning and end of a NURBS surface trimming loop with the <A HREF="bgntrim.html#A251X98d"><B>bgntrim</B> and <B>endtrim</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052277ceb"></A>Controlling the shape of a NURBS trimming curve with the <A HREF="nurbscurve.html#A255X93ca"><B>nurbscurve</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052385ceb"></A>Controlling the shape of a NURBS surface with the <A HREF="nurbssurface.html#A252X98b9"><B>nurbssurface</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052494ceb"></A>Describing a piecewise linear trimming curve for NURBS surfaces with the <A HREF="pwlcurve.html#A257X9fc"><B>pwlcurve</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052600ceb"></A>Setting a property for the display of trimmed NURBS with the <A HREF="setnurbsproperty.html#A257X911b"><B>setnurbsproperty</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1052708ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, Drawing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawnurbs.html#drawnurbs.html">NURBS Curves and Surfaces</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P><hr><center>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9384"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1074657ceb"></A>Returns the current open object.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C13d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1074805ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1074912ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9388"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A142X9389"></A><B>Int32 getopenobj(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010a80"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010a81"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETOPE</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X938a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1075272ceb"></A>The <B>getopenobj</B> subroutine returns the identifier of the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A255B9bc">object</A> that is currently open for editing. If no object is open, the subroutine returns -1.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d8a"></A><B>Note: </B>This editing subroutine itself cannot be added to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X9390"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1075486ceb"></A>The number of the object currently open for editing.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015cfc"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1075647ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C142"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91f76"></A>getorigin Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX793" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX794" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX795" REL="I3" TITLE="getorigin"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX796" REL="I1" TITLE="getorigin subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX797" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX798" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX799" REL="I3" TITLE="returning position of"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX800" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX801" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX802" REL="I3" TITLE="getorigin"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A142X91f78"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1096893ceb"></A>Returns the position of a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12d2"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1097043ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1097147ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91f7c"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b19"></A><B>void getorigin(Int32 *</B><A HREF="getorigin.html#SA23220marj"><I>x</I></A><B>, Int32 *</B><A HREF="getorigin.html#kA23marj"><I>y</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c33"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c34"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETORI(</B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91f7e"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1097512ceb"></A>The <B>getorigin</B> subroutine returns the position (in pixels) of the lower-left corner of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. A window must be open for this subroutine to work.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1097619ceb"></A>Call the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine to open a window, or the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine to choose the current window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f4c"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91f80"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="SA23220marj"></A><I>x</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location in which to return the <I>x</I> position (in pixels) of the lower left corner of the window. </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="kA23marj"></A><I>y</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location in which to return the <I>y</I> position (in pixels) of the lower left corner of the window. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01105a"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1097991ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="paint_c.html#A13C0bd84"><B>paint.c</B></A> uses the <B>getorigin</B> subroutine to determine the origin of the window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159e6"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1098154ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12d5"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12d6"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12d7"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91f96"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1098471ceb"></A>Obtaining the size of the window with the <A HREF="getsize.html#X513200marj"><B>getsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1098578ceb"></A>Constraining the window position and size with the <A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1098686ceb"></A>Moving the current <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#A44C012b72">window</A> by its lower left corner with the <A HREF="winmove.html#A142X91527"><B>winmove</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1098793ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1098901ceb"></A>Changing the current location and size of a <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#A44C012b72">window</A> with the <A HREF="winposition.html#A142X9158d"><B>winposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1099009ceb"></A>Setting the current window with the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1099116ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X9b63"></A>getpattern Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX803" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX804" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX805" REL="I3" TITLE="getpattern"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX806" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX807" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX808" REL="I3" TITLE="getpattern"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX809" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX810" REL="I2" TITLE="fill pattern"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX811" REL="I3" TITLE="current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX812" REL="I1" TITLE="getpattern subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9b65"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10B9528ceb"></A>Returns the index of the current fill pattern.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1e9"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10B9676ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10B9780ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9b69"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9b6a"></A><B>long getpattern(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0f1"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0f2"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION GETPAT</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9b6b"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10BA138ceb"></A>The <B>getpattern </B>subroutine returns the index of the current fill 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791abd">pattern</A>. The returned value is an index into the pattern table.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9d31"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A62C015c85"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10BA357ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A11C0b4dc"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1ec"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1ed"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9b83"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10BA674ceb"></A>Defining a pattern with the <A HREF="defpattern.html#A143X9b41"><B>defpattern</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10BA783ceb"></A>Selecting a fill pattern for polygons, rectangles, and curves with the <A HREF="setpattern.html#WeM11c0marj"><B>setpattern</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X94a4"></A>getplanes Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX813" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX814" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer configuration"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX815" REL="I3" TITLE="getplanes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX816" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX817" REL="I2" TITLE="bitplanes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX818" REL="I3" TITLE="returning the number of available"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX819" REL="I1" TITLE="getplanes subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A143X94a6"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DB622ceb"></A>Returns the number of available bitplanes.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11c6"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DB770ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DB874ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X94aa"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X94ab"></A><B>Int32 getplanes(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C010713"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C010714"></A><B>INTEGER*4 GETPLA</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X94ac"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DC230ceb"></A>The <B>getplanes</B> subroutine returns the number of active bitplanes that are currently being used for drawing. The number returned depends on how the frame buffer has been configured. In particular, the returned value depends on the most recent setting of the  <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine, whether the system is in single or double buffer mode, whether it is in color map or RGB mode, and finally, on the capabilities of the installed adapter.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9c97"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X94b2"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DC442ceb"></A>The number of bitplanes available under the current drawmode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A30C010fcc"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DC597ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="scrn_rotate_c.html#A16C0c92f"><B>scrn_rotate.c</B></A> uses the <B>getplanes</B> subroutine to get the number of bitplanes available. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016552"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DC761ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11c9"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11ca"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11cb"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X94c4"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10DD080ceb"></A>Setting color map mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD187ceb"></A>Setting the display mode to double buffer mode with the <A HREF="doublebuffer.html#A145X91a7"><B>doublebuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD294ceb"></A>Choosing a set of bitplanes for drawing with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD401ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as 16 small maps with the <A HREF="multimap.html#A146X9593"><B>multimap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD508ceb"></A>Organizing the color map as one large map with the <A HREF="onemap.html#A146X95ef"><B>onemap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD617ceb"></A>Setting a display mode that bypasses the color map with the <A HREF="RGBmode.html#A143X93b6"><B>RGBmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD723ceb"></A>Setting the display mode to single buffer mode with the <A HREF="singlebuffer.html#A145X9259"><B>singlebuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10DD831ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operations</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/querysys.html#querysys.html">Querying</A> the System.</P><hr><center>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A213X911c47"></A>getscrmask Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX820" REL="I1" TITLE="getscrmask subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX821" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX822" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX823" REL="I3" TITLE="getscrmask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX824" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX825" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX826" REL="I3" TITLE="getscrmask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX827" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX828" REL="I2" TITLE="screenmask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX829" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c49"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FC936ceb"></A>Returns the current screenmask.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1264"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FD086ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10FD190ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c4c"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911c4d"></A><B>void getscrmask</B>
<B>(Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c54"><I>left</I></A><B>, Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c55"><I>right</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c56"><I>bottom</I></A><B>, Screencoord *</B><A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c57"><I>top</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c25"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911c28"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETSCR(</B><I>left</I><B>,</B> <I>right</I><B>,</B> <I>bottom</I><B>,</B> <I>top</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>left</I><B>,</B> <I>right</I><B>,</B> <I>bottom</I><B>,</B> <I>top</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c50"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FD562ceb"></A>The <B>getscrmask</B> subroutine returns the dimensions of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A> (the top of the screenmask stack) and copies these dimensions to the location variables specified as parameters. The <A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c54"><I>left</I></A>, <A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c55"><I>right</I></A>, <A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c56"><I>bottom</I></A>, <A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c57"><I>top</I></A> parameters are the addresses of four memory locations assigned the left, right bottom, and top coordinates of the screenmask.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9e1d"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911c53"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911c54"></A><I>left</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the memory location into which the system copies the <I>x</I> coordinate (in pixels) of the left side of the screenmask.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911c55"></A><I>right</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the memory location into which the system copies the <I>x </I>coordinate (in pixels) of the right side of the screenmask.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911c56"></A><I>bottom</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the memory location into which the system copies the <I>y </I>coordinate (in pixels) of the bottom side of the screenmask.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911c57"></A> <I>top</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the memory location into which the system copies the <I>y </I>coordinate (in pixels) of the top side of the screenmask.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C011017"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FE050ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="prompt_c.html#A16C0c8de"><B>prompt.c</B></A> uses the <B>getscrmask</B> subroutine to get the current screenmask so that it can be restored later. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d48"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FE212ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1267"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1268"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1269"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c6a"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B10FE536ceb"></A>Pushing the viewport onto the viewport stack with the <A HREF="pushviewport.html#A213X911bee"><B>pushviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10FE644ceb"></A>Popping the viewport stack with the <A HREF="popviewport.html#A213X911d3c"><B>popviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B10FE761ceb"></A>Defining a rectangular 2-D clipping mask with the <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="X513200marj"></A>getsize Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX830" REL="I1" TITLE="getsize subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX831" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX832" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX833" REL="I3" TITLE="getsize"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX834" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX835" REL="I2" TITLE="window sizes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX836" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX837" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX838" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX839" REL="I3" TITLE="getsize"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b27"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1122226ceb"></A>Returns the size of a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12d8"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1122376ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1122479ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b2a"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b2b"></A><B>void getsize(Int32 *</B><A HREF="getsize.html#eO23270marj"><I>x</I></A><B>, Int32 *</B><A HREF="getsize.html#qO231d0marj"><I>y</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c37"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c38"></A><B>SUBROUTINE GETSIZ(</B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b2e"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1122847ceb"></A>The <B>getsize</B> subroutine returns the size of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. A window must be open for this subroutine to work.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1122958ceb"></A>Call the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine to open a window, or the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine to choose the current window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f52"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X912b31"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="eO23270marj"></A><I>x</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which to copy the width (in pixels) of the window. </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="qO231d0marj"></A><I>y</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a pointer to the location into which to copy the height (in pixels) of the window. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01105c"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1123333ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="paint_c.html#A13C0bd84"><B>paint.c</B></A> uses the <B>getsize</B> subroutine to determine the size of a window. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159ea"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1123495ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12db"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12dc"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12dd"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b37"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1123817ceb"></A>Specifying pixel values to be added to a window with the <A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1123924ceb"></A>Obtaining the position of a window with the <A HREF="getorigin.html#A142X91f76"><B>getorigin</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124032ceb"></A>Specifying the maximum size of a window with the <A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124139ceb"></A>Specifying the minimum size of a window with the <A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124247ceb"></A>Constraining the size of a window with the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124356ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124464ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124573ceb"></A>Setting the current window with the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1124680ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>. </P><hr><center>

<H2><A NAME="A143X9a53"></A>getsm Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX840" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX841" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX842" REL="I3" TITLE="getsm"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX843" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX844" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX845" REL="I3" TITLE="getsm"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX846" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX847" REL="I2" TITLE="shading model"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX848" REL="I3" TITLE="returning"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX849" REL="I1" TITLE="getsm subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9a55"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1147377ceb"></A>Returns the shading model the system uses to draw filled polygons.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1ee"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1147524ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1147629ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9a59"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9a5a"></A><B>Int32 getsm(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0ed"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0ee"></A><B>INTEGER*4 GETSM</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9a5b"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1147981ceb"></A>The <B>getsm</B> subroutine returns the shading model that the system uses to draw filled polygons. The returned value of this function indicates which shading model is now active.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A81C11f0"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X9a61"></A>Return Values</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1148195ceb"></A>There are two possible return values:</P>

<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Description</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>FLAT</TD>

<TD>FLAT</TD>

<TD>The system draws a filled polygon with a constant color across the entire surface of the polygon.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>GOURAUD</TD>

<TD>GOURAU</TD>

<TD>The system draws a filled polygon with a color that varies as a linear interpolation of the colors at the polygon's vertices.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015c81"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1148396ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A11C0b4da"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1f1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1f2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9a73"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1B1148717ceb"></A>Selecting the shading model used to draw polygons with the <A HREF="shademodel.html#A143X9ab9"><B>shademodel</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1B1148825ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawbeg-end.html">Drawing with Begin-End Style Subroutines</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/move-draw.html">Drawing with Move-Draw Style Subroutines</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/setglattrib.html#setglattrib.html">Setting Drawing Attributes</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Understanding the Hardware Used by GL</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawpoly.html#drawpoly.html">Drawing Rectangles, Circles, Arcs, and Polygons</A>.</P><hr><center>
