## File: gl32tref/polygonlist.html
```html
<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 3.2//EN">
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=iso-8859-1">

<TITLE>polygonlist or polylinelist Subroutine
</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>
[  <a href="poly.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="popattributes.html">Next</a>  |
<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Xto2d0nita"></A>polygonlist or polylinelist Subroutine</H2>

<H3><A NAME="A38F156c"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71A2066ceb"></A>Draws multiple, disjointed polygons or polylines.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A38F156e"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71A2105ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A2130ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A38F1571"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A38F1572"></A><B>void polygonlist(Int32 </B><I>num_polygons</I><B>, Int32 </B><I>type</I><B>, void *</B><I>se</I><B>)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A38F1573"></A><B>void polylinelist(Int32 </B><I>num_polylines</I><B>, Int32 </B><I>type</I><B>, void *</B><I>se</I><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A38F1574"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A38F1575"></A><B>SUBROUTINE POLYLI(</B><I>num_polygons</I><B>, </B><I>type</I><B>, </B><I>se</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>num_polygons</I><B>, </B><I>type</I><B>, </B><I>se</I><B>(</B><I>1</I><B>)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A38F1576"></A><B>SUBROUTINE  LINELI(</B><I>num_polylines</I><B>, </B><I>type</I><B>, </B><I>se</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>num_polylines</I><B>, </B><I>type</I><B>, </B><I>se</I><B>(</B><I>1</I><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A38F1577"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71A2281ceb"></A>The <B>polygonlist</B> subroutine draws multiple, disjoint polygons.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A2307ceb"></A>The <B>polylinelist</B> subroutine draws multiple, disjoint polylines. Polylines can be lit and/or shaded; therefore, polylines may be specified with color and/or normal data.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A2333ceb"></A>If lighting is not enabled, all normal data is ignored. If no color data is supplied, the polygons or polylines are rendered with the current color. If lighting is enabled, color data is interpreted according to the current setting of the <B>lmcolor</B> attribute.</P>

<OL><LI><A NAME="A38F157c"></A>The Supergraphics Processor Subsystem does not support lit and/or smooth-shaded polylines. It does support flat-shaded polylines.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A38F157d"></A>The Supergraphics Processor Subsystem does not support 4-dimensional data. It does support 2- and 3-dimensional data.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A3CFD0D0122janb"></A>These subroutines may not buy a performance improvement over begin-end style rendering on the POWERgraphics GXT1000. Begin-end style rendering has been highly optimized on the GXT1000.</LI></OL>

<H3><A NAME="A38F157e"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F157f"></A><I>num_polygons</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of polygons to be defined in the array pointed to by the <I>se</I> parameter in the <B>polygonlist</B> subroutine.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1580"></A><I>num_polylines</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of polylines to be defined in the array pointed to by the <I>se</I> parameter in the <B>polylinelist</B> subroutine.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1581"></A><I>type</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a bitflag indicating whether normals and/or colors are present in the data and whether the vertex data is 2-, 3-, or 4-dimensional. This bitflag is formed by using the bitwise OR operator to combine the following tokens:


<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1582"></A>SE_2D</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that the vertex coordinates are 2-dimensional.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1583"></A>SE_3D</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that the vertex coordinates are 3-dimensional.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1584"></A>SE_4D</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that the vertex coordinates are 4-dimensional.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1585"></A>SE_NORM</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that normal data is present.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1586"></A>SE_COLOR</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that color index data is present.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1587"></A>SE_RGB</TD>
<TD>  Indicates that RGB data is present.</TD></TR></TABLE></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1588"></A><I>se</I></TD>
<TD>  Points to an array of mixed integer, binary, and floating point data. The array is a concatenation of a number of separate, disjoint polygons (polylines) as follows:


<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="3"><B>Polygons Data Structure</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>0</TD>

<TD>polygon (1)</TD>

<TD>polygon format</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>.</TD>

<TD>polygon (2)</TD>

<TD>polygon format</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><BR></TD>

<TD>...</TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>.</TD>

<TD>polygon (n)</TD>

<TD>polygon format</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F1589"></A>Each polygon consists of an integer indicating the number of vertices in that polygon, followed by vertex, normal, and color information. If the array is considered as a linear array of 32-bit words, the structure of the polygon data must be as follows:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="3"><B>Individual Polygon Data Structure</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+0</TD>

<TD>num verts</TD>

<TD>signed 32-bit integer</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+1</TD>

<TD>vertex (1)</TD>

<TD>vertex data</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>.</TD>

<TD>vertex (2)</TD>

<TD>vertex data</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><BR></TD>

<TD>...</TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>.</TD>

<TD>vertex (n)</TD>

<TD>vertex data</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F158a"></A>Each vertex has one of a number of formats, depending on the setting of the flag word. The flag bits indicate whether a normal vector is or is not present, whether a color is or is not present, and whether the point data is 2-, 3-, or 4-dimensional. Therefore, the potential data for a vertex data structure is as follows:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>Potential Vertex Data Structure</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+
0</TD>

<TD>x</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+1</TD>

<TD>y</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+2 if 3D</TD>

<TD>z</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>+3 if 4D</TD>

<TD>w</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2/3/4+0 if NORM</TD>

<TD>nx</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2/3/4+1 if NORM</TD>

<TD>ny</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2/3/4+2 if NORM</TD>

<TD>nz</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2...7+0 if CI</TD>

<TD>color index</TD>

<TD>IEEE integer</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2...7+0 if RGB</TD>

<TD>color r</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2...7+1 if RGB</TD>

<TD>color g</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2...7+2 if RGB</TD>

<TD>color b</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F158b"></A>More specifically, if there is no normal or color data, and the point contains only 2-dimensional data, a vertex data structure is no more than a pair of floating point numbers as follows:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>type = SE_2D</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>0</TD>

<TD>x</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>1</TD>

<TD>y</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F158c"></A>If  a normal vector is to be specified with 3-dimensional data, the vertex data structure would be as follows:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>type = SE_3D | SE_NORM</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>0</TD>

<TD>x</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>1</TD>

<TD>y</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2</TD>

<TD>z</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>3</TD>

<TD>nx</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>4</TD>

<TD>ny</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>5</TD>

<TD>nz</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F158d"></A>A 4-dimensional vertex with color index data would have the following data structure:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>type = SE_4D | SE_COLOR</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>0</TD>

<TD>x</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>1</TD>

<TD>y</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2</TD>

<TD>z</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>3</TD>

<TD>w</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>4</TD>

<TD>color index</TD>

<TD>32-bit integer</TD></TR></TABLE>




<P><A NAME="A38F158e"></A>A 3-dimensional vertex with both normal and color data would have the following data structure:</P>




<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD COLSPAN="2"><B>type = SE_3D | SE_NORM | SE_RGB</B></TD>

<TD><BR></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>Word</B></TD>

<TD><B>Parameter</B></TD>

<TD><B>Type</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>0</TD>

<TD>x</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>1</TD>

<TD>y</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>2</TD>

<TD>z</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>3</TD>

<TD>nx</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>4</TD>

<TD>ny</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>5</TD>

<TD>nz</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>6</TD>

<TD>R</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>7</TD>

<TD>G</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>8</TD>

<TD>B</TD>

<TD>IEEE short Floating Point</TD></TR></TABLE></TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A38F158f"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71A2994ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A38F1591"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1592"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A38F1593"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A38F1598"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71A3090ceb"></A>Allowing the system to draw concave polygons with the <A HREF="concave.html#HXf320marj"><B>concave</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3116ceb"></A>Specifying the next point in a polygon with the <A HREF="pdr.html#bqf1c0marj"><B>pdr</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3141ceb"></A>Specifying the starting point for a polygon with the <A HREF="pmv.html#A139X91eed"><B>pmv</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3167ceb"></A>Drawing a relative polygon with the <A HREF="rpdr.html#hrfa0marj"><B>rpdr</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3192ceb"></A>Moving the current graphics position to a starting point for a filled polygon relative to the current point with the <A HREF="rpmv.html#lXf370marj"><B>rpmv</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3218ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/setglattrib.html#setglattrib.html">Setting Drawing Attributes</A>, Creating <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/crlighteff.html#crlighteff.html">Lighting Effects</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71A3243ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawpoly.html#drawpoly.html">Drawing Rectangles, Circles, Arcs, and Polygons</A>.</P><hr><center>
[  <a href="poly.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="popattributes.html">Next</a>  |

 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>
```

## File: gl32tref/popattributes.html
```html
<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 3.2//EN">
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=iso-8859-1">

<TITLE>popattributes Subroutine
</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>
[  <a href="polygonlist.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="popmatrix.html">Next</a>  |
<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Vmx2140marj"></A>popattributes Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1421" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1422" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1423" REL="I3" TITLE="popattributes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1424" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1425" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1426" REL="I3" TITLE="popping"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1427" REL="I1" TITLE="popattributes subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912733"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71B0776ceb"></A>Pops the attribute stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1115"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71B0815ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B0840ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912736"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912737"></A><B>void popattributes(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0fd"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0fe"></A><B>SUBROUTINE POPATT</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91273a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71B0948ceb"></A>The <B>popattributes </B>subroutine pops the attributes stack, restoring the values of the global state attributes most recently saved with the <A HREF="pushattributes.html#Thx220marj"><B>pushattributes</B></A> subroutine:  </P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A48C013780"></A>backbuffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013781"></A>color map number (one of 16 <I>small</I> maps)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013782"></A>colormode (Colormap or RGB)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013783"></A>current color</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013784"></A>current font</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013785"></A>current linestyle</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013786"></A>current linestyle repeat factor</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013787"></A>current linewidth</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013788"></A>current pattern</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C013789"></A>current writemask</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C01378a"></A>drawmode (overlay, underlay, or main buffers)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C01378b"></A>draw_to_z_buffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C01378c"></A>frontbuffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C01378d"></A>logicop function</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A48C01378e"></A>shademodel (Flat or Gouraud)</LI></UL>


<H3><A NAME="A62C015c91"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71B1253ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1118"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1119"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C111a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A318C9d49"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71B1350ceb"></A>Enabling drawing in the back buffer with the <A HREF="backbuffer.html#A145X94a"><B>backbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1375ceb"></A>Setting color map mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1401ceb"></A>Setting the color index in the current mode with the <A HREF="color.html#A146X9429"><B>color</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1426ceb"></A>Specifying the target framebuffer of the drawing subroutines with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1452ceb"></A>Enabling drawing in the front buffer with the <A HREF="frontbuffer.html#A145X9a0"><B>frontbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1477ceb"></A>Specifying the line width with the <A HREF="linewidth.html#A3mM11b0marj"><B>linewidth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1503ceb"></A>Setting the repeat factor for the current linestyle with the <A HREF="lsrepeat.html#DmN1110marj"><B>lsrepeat</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1528ceb"></A>Pushing down the attribute stack with the <A HREF="pushattributes.html#Thx220marj"><B>pushattributes</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1554ceb"></A>Setting the current color in RGB mode with the <A HREF="RGBcolor.html#A143X9394"><B>RGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1579ceb"></A>Granting write access to a subset of available bitplanes in RGB mode with the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1605ceb"></A>Selecting a linestyle pattern with the <A HREF="setlinestyle.html#XFM1310marj"><B>setlinestyle</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1630ceb"></A>Selecting a pattern for filling polygons and rectangles with the <A HREF="setpattern.html#WeM11c0marj"><B>setpattern</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1656ceb"></A>Selecting the shading model used to draw a polygon with the <A HREF="shademodel.html#A143X9ab9"><B>shademodel</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71B1681ceb"></A>Granting write permission to a subset of available bitplanes in color map mode with the <A HREF="writemask.html#A143X9592"><B>writemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>
```

```html
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X951e"></A>popmatrix Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1428" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1429" REL="I2" TITLE="coordinate transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1430" REL="I3" TITLE="popmatrix"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1431" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1432" REL="I2" TITLE="transformation matrix stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1433" REL="I3" TITLE="popping"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1434" REL="I1" TITLE="popmatrix subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9520"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1345ceb"></A>Pops the transformation matrix stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C19e"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1384ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1409ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9524"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X9126db"></A><B>void popmatrix(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A15C0c6f4"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A15C0c6f5"></A><B>SUBROUTINE POPMAT</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9526"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1516ceb"></A>The <B>popmatrix </B>subroutine pops the <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/coordtransfrms.html#A264X915f">viewing transformation</A> matrix stack.  </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1542ceb"></A>This subroutine is not valid when the system is in projection matrix mode (<SAMP>mmode(MPROJ);),</SAMP> because the matrix stack is not accessible in this mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X952e"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1584ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="backface_c.html#A16C0c7a2"><B>backface.c</B></A> uses the <B>popmatrix</B> subroutine, to restore the previous transformation matrix after altering it with the <A HREF="translate.html#A144X95c8"><B>translate</B></A> modeling subroutine. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d36"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1627ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1a1"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1a2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1a3"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X953e"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71C1726ceb"></A>Setting the current matrix mode with the <A HREF="mmode.html#XhZ2370marj"><B>mmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1751ceb"></A>Getting a copy of the current transformation matrix with the <A HREF="getmatrix.html#A144X940e"><B>getmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1777ceb"></A>Loading a transformation matrix with the <A HREF="loadmatrix.html#A144X9430"><B>loadmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1802ceb"></A>Premultiplying the current transformation matrix with the <A HREF="multmatrix.html#A144X9474"><B>multmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1828ceb"></A>Pushing down the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="pushmatrix.html#A144X9540"><B>pushmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71C1853ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Working with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcoords.html#workcoords.html">Coordinate Systems</A>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A213X911af9"></A>popname Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1435" REL="I1" TITLE="popname subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1436" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1437" REL="I2" TITLE="picking and selecting"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1438" REL="I3" TITLE="popping name off name stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1439" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1440" REL="I2" TITLE="picking and selecting"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1441" REL="I3" TITLE="popname"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911afb"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71CF423ceb"></A>Pops a name off the name stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1b4"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71CF462ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF487ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911afe"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911aff"></A><B>void popname(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ad9"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911adc"></A><B>SUBROUTINE POPNAM</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b02"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71CF595ceb"></A>The <B>popname</B> subroutine removes the top name from the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06e3">name stack</A>. It is used in both 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06fa">picking</A> and 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P019">selecting</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF620ceb"></A>This subroutine is ignored outside of picking and selecting modes.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015cc4"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71CF664ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1b7"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1b8"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1b9"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b17"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71CF760ceb"></A>Putting the system in selecting mode with the <A HREF="gselect.html#A213X9118b2"><B>gselect</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF786ceb"></A>Initializing the name stack with the <A HREF="initnames.html#YlD250marj"><B>initnames</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF812ceb"></A>Loading the name on top of the name stack with the <A HREF="loadname.html#A213X9119af"><B>loadname</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF837ceb"></A>Putting the system in picking mode with the <A HREF="pick.html#h632f0nita"><B>pick</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF863ceb"></A>Pushing a new name onto the name stack with the <A HREF="pushname.html#A213X911b48"><B>pushname</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71CF888ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/picknselect.html#picknselect.html">Picking and Selecting</A> Overview.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A16C0c8c0"></A>popup.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2396" REL="I1" TITLE="popup.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2397" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2398" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2399" REL="I3" TITLE="popp menu"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2400" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2401" REL="I2" TITLE="pop-up menus"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2402" REL="I3" TITLE="example program"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1E826ttay"></A>/*
popup.c:
Demonstrates "how to write your own popup menu" routine
s.
Use LEFTMOUSE instead of RIGHTMOUSE to pop up the me
nus.
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1E983ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F131ttay"></A>#define LINE 1</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F279ttay"></A>#define POINTS 2</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F427ttay"></A>#define CIRCLE 3</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F574ttay"></A>#define RECT 4</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F721ttay"></A>#define RECTF 5</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB1F868ttay"></A>#define QUIT 6</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB20042ttay"></A>typedef struct {
  short type;
  char *text;
} popupentry;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB20260ttay"></A>popupentry mainmenu[] = {
  {LINE, "Line"},
  {POINTS, "100 points"},
  {CIRCLE, "Filled circle"},
  {RECT, "Outlined rectangle"},
  {RECTF, "Filled rectangle"},
  {QUIT, "Quit"},
  {0, 0}
};
/* mark end of menu */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB20418ttay"></A>main()
{
  long win;
  short val, command;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB20604ttay"></A>  prefposition(0,XMAXSCREEN,0,YMAXSCREEN);
  win = winopen("popup");
  ortho2(-1.0, 1.0, -1.0, 1.0);
  overlay(2);
  gconfig();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB20854ttay"></A>  drawmode(OVERDRAW);
  mapcolor(0, 0, 0, 0);        /* background only */
  mapcolor(1, 120, 120, 120);  /* popup background */
  mapcolor(2, 255, 255, 255);  /* popup text only */
  drawmode(NORMALDRAW);
  qdevice(RIGHTMOUSE);
  qdevice(LEFTMOUSE);
  tie(LEFTMOUSE, MOUSEX, MOUSEY);
  color(0);
  clear();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB21074ttay"></A>  while (TRUE) {
    switch(qread(&amp;val)) {
    case REDRAW:
      reshapeviewport();
      drawstuff(command);
      break;
    case LEFTMOUSE:
      drawstuff(command = popup(mainmenu));
    default:
      break;
    }
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB21218ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB21379ttay"></A>drawstuff(command)
short command;
{
  register i, j;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB21695ttay"></A>  color(0);
  clear();
  color(GREEN);
  switch(command) {
  case LINE:
    move2(-1.0, -1.0);
    draw2(1.0, 1.0);
    break;
  case POINTS:
    for (i =  0; i &lt; 10; i++)
      for (j = 0; j &lt; 10; j++)
        pnt2(i/20.0, j/20.0);
    break;
  case CIRCLE:
    circf(0.0, 0.0, 0.5);
    break;
  case RECT:
    rect(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    break;
  case RECTF:
    rectf(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    break;
  case QUIT:
    greset();
    gexit();
    exit(0);
  default:
    break;
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB21837ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB22160ttay"></A>popup(names)
popupentry names[];
{
  register short i, menucount;
  short menutop, menubottom, menuleft, menuright;
  short lasthighlight = -1, highlight;
  short dummy, x, y;
  menucount = 0;
  qread(&amp;x);
  qread(&amp;y);
  pushmatrix();
  drawmode(OVERDRAW);
  ortho2(-0.5, 1279.5, -0.5, 1023.5);
  while (names[menucount].type)
    menucount++;
  menutop = y + menucount*8;
  menubottom = y - menucount*8;
  if (menutop > YMAXSCREEN) {
    menutop = YMAXSCREEN;
    menubottom = menutop - menucount*16;
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB22332ttay"></A>  if (menubottom &lt; 0) {
    menubottom = 0;
    menutop = menubottom + menucount*16;
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB22517ttay"></A>  menuleft = x - 100;
  menuright = x + 100;
  if (menuleft &lt; 0) {
    menuleft = 0;
    menuright = menuleft + 200;
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB22700ttay"></A>  if (menuright > XMAXSCREEN) {
    menuright = XMAXSCREEN;
    menuleft = menuright - 200;
  }
  color(0);
  clear();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB22876ttay"></A>  color(1);                /* menu background */
  rectfi(menuleft, menubottom, menuright, menutop);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB23076ttay"></A>  color(2);                /* menu text */
  move2i(menuleft, menubottom);
  draw2i(menuleft, menutop);
  draw2i(menuright, menutop);
  draw2i(menuright, menubottom);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB23288ttay"></A>  for (i = 0; i &lt; menucount; i++) {
    move2i(menuleft, menutop - (i+1)*16);
    draw2i(menuright, menutop - (i+1)*16);
    cmov2i(menuleft + 10, menutop - 14 - i*16);
    charstr(names[i].text);
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB23629ttay"></A>  while (!qtest()) {
    x = getvaluator(MOUSEX);
    y = getvaluator(MOUSEY);
    if (menuleft &lt; x &amp;&amp; x &lt; menuright &amp;&amp; 
        menubottom &lt; y &amp;&amp; y &lt; menutop)
    {
      highlight = (menutop - y)/16;
      if (lasthighlight != -1 &amp;&amp; lasthighlight != highlight) {
        color(1);
        rectfi(menuleft+1, 
            menutop - lasthighlight*16 - 15,
            menuright-1, menutop - lasthighlight*16 - 1);
        color(2);
        cmov2i(menuleft + 10, 
            menutop - 14 - lasthighlight*16);
        charstr(names[lasthighlight].text);
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB23880ttay"></A>      if (lasthighlight != highlight) {
        color(2);
        rectfi(menuleft+1, menutop - highlight*16 - 15,
            menuright-1, menutop - highlight*16 - 1);
        color(1);
        cmov2i(menuleft + 10, 
            menutop - 14 - highlight*16);
        charstr(names[highlight].text);
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB24036ttay"></A>      lasthighlight = highlight;
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB24327ttay"></A>    else /* the cursor is outside the menu */ 
    {
      if (lasthighlight != -1)
      {
        color(1);
        rectfi(menuleft+1, 
            menutop - lasthighlight*16 - 15,
            menuright-1, menutop - lasthighlight*16 - 1);
        color(2);
        cmov2i(menuleft + 10, 
            menutop - 14 - lasthighlight*16);
        charstr(names[lasthighlight].text);
        lasthighlight = -1;
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB24471ttay"></A>    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB24614ttay"></A>  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB24856ttay"></A>  qread(&amp;dummy);
  qread(&amp;x);
  qread(&amp;y);
  color(0);
  rectfi(menuleft, menubottom, menuright, menutop);
  if (menuleft&lt;x &amp;&amp; x&lt;menuright &amp;&amp; menubottom&lt;y &amp;&amp; y&lt;menutop)
    x = (menutop - y)/16;
  else
    x = 0;
  drawmode(NORMALDRAW);
  popmatrix();
  return names[x].type;
}</PRE>
```

```html
<H2><A NAME="A213X911d3c"></A>popviewport Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1442" REL="I1" TITLE="popviewport subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1443" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1444" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1445" REL="I3" TITLE="popviewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1446" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1447" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1448" REL="I3" TITLE="popping the stack"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911d3e"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71DD062ceb"></A>Pops the viewport stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1277"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71DD103ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71DD128ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911d41"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911d42"></A><B>void popviewport(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911d1c"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911d1f"></A><B>SUBROUTINE POPVIE(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911d45"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71DD239ceb"></A>The <B>popviewport</B> subroutine pops the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A> stack, restoring the values of the viewport, 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A>, and depth range most recently saved with the <A HREF="pushviewport.html#A213X911bee"><B>pushviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d4e"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71DD284ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C127a"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C127b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C127c"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911d53"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71DD383ceb"></A>Setting the viewport depth range with the <A HREF="lsetdepth.html#naR120marj"><B>lsetdepth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71DD409ceb"></A>Pushing the viewport onto the viewport stack with the <A HREF="pushviewport.html#A213X911bee"><B>pushviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71DD439ceb"></A>Defining a rectangular 2-D clipping mask with the <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71DD465ceb"></A>Setting the area of the window used for all drawing with the <A HREF="viewport.html#qrY270marj"><B>viewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71DD491ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Using <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/useviewprts.html#useviewprts.html">Viewports and Screenmasks</A>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X9164f"></A>prefposition Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1449" REL="I1" TITLE="prefposition subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1450" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1451" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1452" REL="I3" TITLE="prefposition"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1453" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1454" REL="I2" TITLE="window sizes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1455" REL="I3" TITLE="constraining"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1456" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1457" REL="I2" TITLE="window locations"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1458" REL="I3" TITLE="constraining"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91651"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB294ceb"></A>Constrains the size of a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C131a"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB334ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB359ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91655"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b3a"></A><B>void prefposition</B>
<B>(Int32 </B><A HREF="prefposition.html#t753210marj"><I>x1</I></A><B>, Int32</B> <A HREF="prefposition.html#A2853370marj"><I>x2</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Int32 </B><A HREF="prefposition.html#J853b0marj"><I>y1</I></A><B>, Int32 </B><A HREF="prefposition.html#Y853330marj"><I>y2</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c39"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c3a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PREFPO(</B><I>x1</I><B>, </B><I>x2</I><B>, </B><I>y1</I><B>, </B><I>y2</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>x1</I><B>, </B><I>x2</I><B>, </B><I>y1</I><B>, </B><I>y2</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91657"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB476ceb"></A>The <B>prefposition </B>subroutine sets the location and constrains the size, in pixels, of a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. With the <B>prefposition</B> subroutine, the applications programmer can prevent the user from resizing a window. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB503ceb"></A>To remove constraints from a window, call the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine immediately after calling the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. Calling the <B>winconstraints</B> subroutine twice in a row also removes the constraints from the window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="ABF38A4909ttay"></A><B>Note: </B>This process nullifies all constraints, not just that of size.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<P><A NAME="E1D71EB550ceb"></A>If the <B>prefposition </B>subroutine call is followed by a call to the <B>winopen</B> subroutine, the window manager creates and maps the window immediately. A rubberband outline is not shown.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB576ceb"></A>If the <B>prefposition </B>subroutine call is followed by a call to the <B>winconstraints</B> subroutine, the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A> is resized. The resizing occurs at the time of the <B>winconstraints</B> call; the <B>prefposition </B>subroutine has no effect on the current window until that time.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB603ceb"></A>The window manager controls both how the <B>prefposition</B> subroutine parameters are interpreted and where a window is finally placed. For more information on the window manager operation, see the discussion on 
"<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#BC9D0F8612vbia">Window Placement</A>" in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f55"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91659"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="t753210marj"></A><I>x1</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I>-coordinate position (in pixels) of one corner of the window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A2853370marj"></A><I>y1</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I>-coordinate position (in pixels) of the point of one corner of the window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="J853b0marj"></A><I>x2</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I>-coordinate position (in pixels) of the opposite corner of the window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Y853330marj"></A><I>y2</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I>-coordinate position (in pixels) of the opposite corner of the window.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9165f"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB774ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="colored_c.html"><B>colored.c</B></A> uses the <B>prefposition</B> subroutine to specify a window's original location size.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159ec"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB818ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C131d"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C131e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C131f"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9166f"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71EB918ceb"></A>Specifying pixel values to be added to a window with the <A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB944ceb"></A>Obtaining the position of a window with the <A HREF="getorigin.html#A142X91f76"><B>getorigin</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB971ceb"></A>Obtaining the size of a window with the <A HREF="getsize.html#X513200marj"><B>getsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EB997ceb"></A>Constraining the size of a window with the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EC023ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EC049ceb"></A>Binding window constraints to the current window with the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EC076ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71EC102ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91671"></A>prefsize Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1459" REL="I1" TITLE="prefsize subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1460" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1461" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1462" REL="I3" TITLE="prefsize"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1463" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1464" REL="I2" TITLE="window sizes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1465" REL="I3" TITLE="constraining"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91673"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71F9375ceb"></A>Constrains the size of a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1320"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71F9415ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9440ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91677"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b59"></A><B>void prefsize(Int32 </B><A HREF="prefsize.html#yM5310marj"><I>x</I></A><B>, Int32 </B><A HREF="prefsize.html#A6N5370marj"><I>y</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c3d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c3e"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PREFSI(</B><I>x,</I> <I>y</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91679"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71F9557ceb"></A>The <B>prefsize </B>subroutine constrains the size, in pixels, of a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. With the <B>prefsize</B> subroutine, the applications programmer can prevent the user from resizing a window.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9584ceb"></A>To remove constraints from a window, call the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine immediately after calling the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. Calling <B>winconstraints</B> twice in a row also removes constraints from the window. Note that doing this nullifies all constraints, not just that of size.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9611ceb"></A>If the <B>prefsize </B>subroutine call is followed by a call to the <B>winopen</B> subroutine, the window manager displays a window outline of the suggested size, allowing the user to position the window with the cursor.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9638ceb"></A>If the <B>prefsize </B>subroutine call is followed by a call to the <B>winconstraints</B> subroutine, the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A> is resized. The resizing occurs at the time of the <B>winconstraints</B> call; the <B>prefsize </B>subroutine has no effect on the current window until that time.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f5b"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X9167b"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="yM5310marj"></A><I>x</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the width of the window in pixels.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A6N5370marj"></A><I>y</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the height of the window in pixels.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159f0"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71F9759ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1323"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1324"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1325"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91691"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D71F9859ceb"></A>Specifying pixel values to be added to a window with the <A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9886ceb"></A>Obtaining the size of the window with the <A HREF="getsize.html#X513200marj"><B>getsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9912ceb"></A>Specifying the maximum size of a window with the <A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9939ceb"></A>Specifying the minimum size of a window with the <A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9966ceb"></A>Constraining the window position and size with the <A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71F9993ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71FA019ceb"></A>Binding window constraints to the current window with the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71FA046ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D71FA073ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<H2><A NAME="A16C0c8de"></A>prompt.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2403" REL="I1" TITLE="prompt.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2404" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2405" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2406" REL="I3" TITLE="pop-up menu"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2407" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2408" REL="I2" TITLE="pop-up menus"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2409" REL="I3" TITLE="example program"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2D229ttay"></A>/*
prompt.c:</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2D429ttay"></A>This program demonstrates a standard GL prompt and a user-defined
prompt. If you choose the user-defined prompt, mouse events are
ignored until you press the Enter key.</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2D585ttay"></A>Peter Broadwell &amp; dave ratcliffe 1989
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2D748ttay"></A>#include &lt;stdio.h>
#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2D908ttay"></A>#define PROMPT        1
#define EXIT          2</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2E081ttay"></A>long menu;                /* The user-defined prompt's identifier */
char aString[40];</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2E243ttay"></A>main()
{
  Device dev;
  short val;
  long menuval;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2E628ttay"></A>  init();                 /* process events forever */
  while(TRUE) {
    dev=qread(&amp;val);
    switch(dev) {
    case ESCKEY:
      exit();
      break;
    case REDRAW:
      reshapeviewport();
      color(BLUE);
      clear();
      break;
    case RIGHTMOUSE:
      if(val) {
        menuval = dopup(menu);
        switch (menuval) {
        case PROMPT:
                          /* prompt to get file name */
          getUserString("File: ", aString, 
              sizeof(aString));
          printf("The user entered \"%s\"\n",
              aString);
          break;
        case EXIT:
          exit();
          break;
        default:
          break;
        }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2E772ttay"></A>      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2E930ttay"></A>      break;
    default:
      break;
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2F073ttay"></A>  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2F352ttay"></A>}
init()                    /* do all the basic graphics setup */
{
  long sx, sy;
  ginit();                /* Open a full size window */
  overlay(2);
  drawmode(OVERDRAW);
  mapcolor(BLACK,0,0,0);
  mapcolor(RED,255,0,0);
  drawmode(NORMALDRAW);
  gconfig();
  qdevice(ESCKEY);
  qdevice(RIGHTMOUSE);
  qenter(REDRAW, 1);
  menu = defpup("GL-style prompt %t|My Prompt|Exit");
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2F581ttay"></A>/*
Clear prompt, move to start of prompt box, and output requested 
prompt
*/
getUserString(prompt,userStr,maxlen)  /* get name of file */
char *prompt, *userStr;
int maxlen;
{
                                      /* lower left corner of prompt box */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2F729ttay"></A>  #define FILEX 5</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB2F878ttay"></A>  #define FILEY 15</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB30039ttay"></A>  #define FILEYHI (30+FILEY)          /* 30 pixels hi */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB30190ttay"></A>  #define TEXTX (FILEX+5)</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB30342ttay"></A>  #define TEXTY (FILEY+10)</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB30555ttay"></A>  #define clearprompt(aprmpt)                \
    color(RED); clear(); color(BLACK); linewidth(2);\
    recti(FILEX+2, FILEY+2, wxsize-8, FILEYHI-1);\
    linewidth(1); cmov2i(TEXTX, TEXTY); charstr(aprmpt);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB32493ttay"></A>  int cur_str_len;
  short c;
  Device dev;
  long maxwidth, maxxval;             /* max length of window's width 
                                         in pixels */
  char *str;
  char *prmpt = prompt, keyBoardWasQueued;
  long oldmode, xorig, yorig, wxsize, wysize;
  Screencoord mask1, mask2, mask3, mask4; /* Save old state to restore latter */
  pushmatrix();
  oldmode = getdrawmode();
  getscrmask(&amp;mask1, &amp;mask2, &amp;mask3, &amp;mask4);
  keyBoardWasQueued = isqueued(KEYBD);
  drawmode(OVERDRAW);                        /* Enable overlay */
                                             /* Set viewport to fill window */
  getorigin(&amp;xorig,&amp;yorig);
  getsize(&amp;wxsize,&amp;wysize);
  ortho2(-0.5,(float)wxsize, -0.5, (float)wysize);
  maxxval = wxsize + xorig;
  userStr[0] = '\0';
  maxwidth = (wxsize-11) - (FILEX + strwidth(prompt));
  scrmask(FILEX, (Screencoord)(wxsize-6), FILEY, FILEYHI);
  cur_str_len = strlen(userStr);
  clearprompt(prmpt);                        /* Display my prompt */
  qdevice(KEYBD);
                                             /* read till eof ('\n' or '\r') */
  while(dev = qread(&amp;c)) {
    if(dev != KEYBD)
      continue;         /* don't care */
    switch(c) {
    case '\027':        /* ^W sets cursor back to start */
      cur_str_len = 0;
      clearprompt(prmpt);
      break;
    case '\n':
    case '\r':
      goto done;
    case '\b':
      if(cur_str_len) {
        userStr[--cur_str_len] = '\0';
        clearprompt(prmpt);
        /* display rightmost portion */
        for(str=userStr; *str &amp;&amp; strwidth(str) > 
            maxwidth; str++);
        charstr(str);
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB32706ttay"></A>      break;
    default:
      if(cur_str_len &lt; (maxlen -1)) {
        str = &amp;userStr[cur_str_len];
        userStr[cur_str_len++] = c;
        userStr[cur_str_len] = '\0';
        charstr(str);
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB32862ttay"></A>      else {
        ringbell();
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB33010ttay"></A>      break;
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB33153ttay"></A>  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EB33372ttay"></A>done:
  if(!keyBoardWasQueued) unqdevice(KEYBD);
  scrmask(mask1, mask2, mask3, mask4);       /* restore old */
  drawmode(OVERDRAW);
  color(0);
  clear();
  drawmode(oldmode);
  popmatrix();
  userStr[maxlen] = '\0';
}</PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A201C1192"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D78B6014ceb"></A>The <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X9460" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="getdrawmode.html#A143X9482"><B>getdrawmode</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X9482" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="getscrmask.html#A213X911c47"><B>getscrmask</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A213X911c47" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="ginit.html#LDg21c0marj"><B>ginit</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="LDg21c0marj" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="isqueued.html#A143X91da"><B>isqueued</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X91da" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="linewidth.html#A3mM11b0marj"><B>linewidth</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A3mM11b0marj" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="fwN250marj" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="strwidth.html#A144X93ec"><B>strwidth</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A144X93ec" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="unqdevice.html#A143X91b8"><B>unqdevice</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X91b8" REL="PAGENUM"></A>.</P>
```

```html
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Thx220marj"></A>pushattributes Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1466" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1467" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1468" REL="I3" TITLE="pushattributes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1469" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1470" REL="I2" TITLE="attribute stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1471" REL="I3" TITLE="pushing down"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1472" REL="I1" TITLE="pushattributes subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912761"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D720B016ceb"></A>Pushes down the attribute stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1303"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D720B055ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B080ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912764"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912765"></A><B>void pushattributes(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A19C0e0fb"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A19C0e0fc"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PUSHAT</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912768"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D720B189ceb"></A>The <B>pushattributes </B>subroutine pushes down the attribute stack. That is, the record at the top of the stack is duplicated and pushed onto the stack. The following attributes reside on the stack and are thus pushable and popable:  </P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A213X91276a"></A>backbuffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912760"></A>color map number (one of 16 <I>small</I> maps)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4e8"></A>colormode (Colormap or RGB)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4e9"></A>current color</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4ea"></A>current font</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4eb"></A>current linestyle</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4ec"></A>current linestyle repeat factor</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A11C0b4ed"></A>current linewidth</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b78"></A>current pattern</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b79"></A>current writemask</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b7a"></A>drawmode (overlay, underlay, or main buffers)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b7b"></A>draw_to_z_buffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b7c"></A>frontbuffer enable (T or F)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b7d"></A>logicop function</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A44C012b7e"></A>shademodel (Flat or Gouraud)</LI></UL>


<P><A NAME="E1D720B491ceb"></A>The saved values can be restored using the <A HREF="popattributes.html#Vmx2140marj"><B>popattributes</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015c8f"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D720B536ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A77C1306"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1307"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A77C1308"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91277e"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D720B633ceb"></A>Enabling drawing in the back buffer with the <A HREF="backbuffer.html#A145X94a"><B>backbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B659ceb"></A>Setting color map mode as the current mode with the <A HREF="cmode.html#A146X93d6"><B>cmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B684ceb"></A>Setting the color index in the current mode with the <A HREF="color.html#A146X9429"><B>color</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B710ceb"></A>Specifying the target framebuffer of the drawing subroutines with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B736ceb"></A>Enabling drawing in the front buffer with the <A HREF="frontbuffer.html#A145X9a0"><B>frontbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B762ceb"></A>Specifying the line width with the <A HREF="linewidth.html#A3mM11b0marj"><B>linewidth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B788ceb"></A>Setting the repeat factor for the current linestyle with the <A HREF="lsrepeat.html#DmN1110marj"><B>lsrepeat</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B814ceb"></A>Popping the attribute stack with the <A HREF="popattributes.html#Vmx2140marj"><B>popattributes</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B839ceb"></A>Setting the current color in RGB mode with the <A HREF="RGBcolor.html#A143X9394"><B>RGBcolor</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B865ceb"></A>Granting write access to a subset of available bitplanes in RGB mode with the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B890ceb"></A>Selecting a linestyle pattern with the <A HREF="setlinestyle.html#XFM1310marj"><B>setlinestyle</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B916ceb"></A>Selecting one of 16 small color maps with the <A HREF="setmap.html#A146X9646"><B>setmap</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B942ceb"></A>Selecting a pattern for filling polygons and rectangles with the <A HREF="setpattern.html#WeM11c0marj"><B>setpattern</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B968ceb"></A>Selecting the shading model used to draw a polygon with the <A HREF="shademodel.html#A143X9ab9"><B>shademodel</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720B993ceb"></A>Granting write permission to a subset of available bitplanes in color map mode with the <A HREF="writemask.html#A143X9592"><B>writemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D720C019ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/setglattrib.html#setglattrib.html">Setting Drawing Attributes</A>, and Understanding the <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Hardware Used by GL</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X9540"></A>pushmatrix Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1473" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1474" REL="I2" TITLE="coordinate transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1475" REL="I3" TITLE="pushmatrix"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1476" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1477" REL="I2" TITLE="transformation matrix stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1478" REL="I3" TITLE="pushing down"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1479" REL="I1" TITLE="pushmatrix subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9542"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D608ceb"></A>Pushes down the transformation matrix stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1a4"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D648ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721D672ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9546"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X9126e3"></A><B>void pushmatrix(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A15C0c6f7"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A15C0c6f8"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PUSHMA</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9548"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D782ceb"></A>The <B>pushmatrix </B>subroutine pushes down the transformation 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06dd">matrix stack</A>, duplicating the current matrix. For example, if the stack contains one matrix, <I>M, </I>after a call to the <B>pushmatrix </B>subroutine, the matrix contains two copies of <I>M. </I>The top copy can be modified. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721D808ceb"></A>This subroutine is not valid when the system is in projection matrix mode (<SAMP>mmode(MPROJ);),</SAMP> because the matrix stack is not accessible in this mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9550"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D850ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="backface_c.html#A16C0c7a2"><B>backface.c</B></A> uses the <B>pushmatrix</B> subroutine to save the current transformation matrix before altering it with the <A HREF="translate.html#A144X95c8"><B>translate</B></A> modeling subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d38"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D893ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1a7"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1a8"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1a9"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X9560"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D721D991ceb"></A>Changing the matrix mode with the <A HREF="mmode.html#XhZ2370marj"><B>mmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721E017ceb"></A>Getting a copy of the current transformation matrix with the <A HREF="getmatrix.html#A144X940e"><B>getmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721E042ceb"></A>Loading a transformation matrix with the <A HREF="loadmatrix.html#A144X9430"><B>loadmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721E068ceb"></A>Premultiplying the current transformation matrix with the <A HREF="multmatrix.html#A144X9474"><B>multmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721E094ceb"></A>Popping the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="popmatrix.html#A144X951e"><B>popmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D721E120ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Working with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcoords.html#workcoords.html">Coordinate Systems</A>.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A213X911b48"></A>pushname Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1480" REL="I1" TITLE="pushname subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1481" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1482" REL="I2" TITLE="picking and selecting"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1483" REL="I3" TITLE="pushing new name onto name stack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1484" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1485" REL="I2" TITLE="picking and selecting"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1486" REL="I3" TITLE="pushname"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b4a"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B224ceb"></A>Pushes a new name onto the name stack.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1bb"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B263ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B288ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b4d"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911b4e"></A><B>void pushname(Int16 </B><A HREF="pushname.html#b8A11e0marj"><I>name</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b28"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911b2b"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PUSHNA(</B><I>name</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>name</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C1be"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this subroutine accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when invoked from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when invoked from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911b51"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B420ceb"></A>The <B>pushname</B> subroutine pushes the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06e3">name stack</A> down one level and puts a new 16-bit name on top.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B446ceb"></A>The <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06e3">name stack</A> must first have been initialized with the <A HREF="initnames.html#YlD250marj"><B>initnames</B></A> subroutine. At least one name must have been loaded onto the stack with the <A HREF="loadname.html#A213X9119af"><B>loadname</B></A> subroutine. The system stores the contents of the name stack in a buffer if a hit has occurred since the late time that the name stack was touched. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B471ceb"></A>This subroutine is ignored outside of 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06fa">picking</A> or 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P019">selecting</A> mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b43"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="b8A11e0marj"></A><I>name</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the name to add to the name stack.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C010fea"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B548ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="pick1_c.html#A13C0bd9f"><B>pick1.c</B></A> calls the <B>pushname</B> subroutine to push the name stack and put a new name on the top. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015cc6"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B592ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1bf"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1c0"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1c1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b66"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D722B690ceb"></A>Putting the system in selecting mode with the <A HREF="gselect.html#A213X9118b2"><B>gselect</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B715ceb"></A>Initializing the name stack with the <A HREF="initnames.html#YlD250marj"><B>initnames</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B741ceb"></A>Loading the name on top of the name stack with the <A HREF="loadname.html#A213X9119af"><B>loadname</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B767ceb"></A>Putting the system in picking mode with the <A HREF="pick.html#h632f0nita"><B>pick</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B793ceb"></A>Popping a name off name stack with the <A HREF="popname.html#A213X911af9"><B>popname</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D722B819ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/picknselect.html#picknselect.html">Picking and Selecting</A> Overview.</P><hr><center>
```

```html
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A213X911bee"></A>pushviewport Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1487" REL="I1" TITLE="pushviewport subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1488" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1489" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1490" REL="I3" TITLE="pushviewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1491" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1492" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1493" REL="I3" TITLE="duplicating"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911bf0"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7239571ceb"></A>Duplicates the current viewport.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C127d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7239610ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7239635ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911bf3"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911bf4"></A><B>void pushviewport(&nbsp;)</B> </PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911bce"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911bd1"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PUSHVI(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911bf7"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7239744ceb"></A>The <B>pushviewport</B> subroutine pushes down the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A> stack, duplicating the current viewport, 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A>, and depth range. These saved values can be restored using the <A HREF="popviewport.html#A213X911d3c"><B>popviewport</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7239770ceb"></A>The viewport stack is VPSTACKDEPTH levels deep. The <B>pushviewport</B> subroutine is ignored if the stack is full. The VPSTACKDEPTH symbol is defined in the <B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h&nbsp;</B>file.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d46"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7239814ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1280"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1281"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1282"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911c0d"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7239911ceb"></A>Setting the viewport depth range with the <A HREF="lsetdepth.html#naR120marj"><B>lsetdepth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7239937ceb"></A>Popping the viewport stack with the <A HREF="popviewport.html#A213X911d3c"><B>popviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7239966ceb"></A>Defining a rectangular 2-D clipping mask with the <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7239992ceb"></A>Setting the area of the window used for all drawing with the <A HREF="viewport.html#qrY270marj"><B>viewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>
```

```html
<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A257X9fc"></A>pwlcurve Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1494" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1495" REL="I2" TITLE="NURBS curves and surfaces"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1496" REL="I3" TITLE="pwlcurve"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1497" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1498" REL="I2" TITLE="curve"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1499" REL="I3" TITLE="piecewise linear trimming"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1500" REL="I1" TITLE="pwlcurve subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A257X9fe"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7247312ceb"></A>Describes a piecewise linear trimming curve for NURBS surfaces.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C134f"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7247351ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247375ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A257X9101"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A257X9102"></A><B>void pwlcurve</B>
<B>(Int32</B> <A HREF="pwlcurve.html#A257X910b"><I>count</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Float64</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="pwlcurve.html#A257X910c"><I>data_array</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Int32</B> <A HREF="pwlcurve.html#A257X910d"><I>stride</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Int32</B> <A HREF="pwlcurve.html#A257X910e"><I>type</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A257X9db"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A257X9de"></A><B>SUBROUTINE PWLCUR(</B><I>count</I><B>,</B> <I>data_array</I><B>,</B> <I>stride</I><B>,</B> <I>type</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4</B> <I>count</I><B>,</B> <I>stride</I><B>,</B> <I>type</I>
<B>REAL*8 </B><I>data_array</I><B>(*)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A257X9105"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7247490ceb"></A>The <B>pwlcurve </B>subroutine describes a piecewise linear curve, which consists of a list of coordinate pairs in the parameter space for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) surface. A piecewise linear curve can be used to describe a trimming loop. Use trimming loop definitions within surface definitions, as defined by the <A HREF="bgnsurface.html#A251X9d7"><B>bgnsurface</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247516ceb"></A>The trimming loops are closed curves that the system uses to set the boundaries of a NURBS surface. Describe a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A154P11542">trimming loop</A> by using a series of NURBS curves (as defined by the <A HREF="nurbscurve.html#A255X93ca"><B>nurbscurve</B></A> subroutine), piecewise linear curves, or both. These points are connected together with straight lines to form a path. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247543ceb"></A>If a piecewise linear curve is an approximation to a real curve, the points should be close enough together that the resulting path will appear curved at the resolution used in the application.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247569ceb"></A>Use piecewise linear curves within trimming loop definitions. A trimming loop definition is a set of oriented curve commands that describe a closed loop. To mark the beginning of a trimming loop definition, use the <A HREF="bgntrim.html#A251X98d"><B>bgntrim</B></A> subroutine. To mark the end of a trimming loop definition, use an <A HREF="bgntrim.html#A251X98d"><B>endtrim</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247596ceb"></A>The system displays the region of the NURBS surface that is to the left of the trimming curves as the parameter increases. Thus, for a counterclockwise-oriented trimming curve, the displayed region of the NURBS surface is the region inside the curve. For a clockwise-oriented trimming curve, the displayed region of the NURBS surface is the region outside the curve.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A257X910a"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A257X910b"></A><I>count</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of points on the curve.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A257X910c"></A><I>data_array</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing the curve points.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A257X910d"></A><I>stride</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the offset (in bytes) between points on the curve.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A257X910e"></A><I>type</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies a value indicating the point type. Currently, the only data type supported is N_ST, corresponding to pairs of s-t coordinates. The <I>stride</I> parameter is used in case the curve points are part of an array of larger structure elements. The <B>pwlcurve </B>subroutine searches for the <I>count</I>-th coordinate pair beginning at <I>data_array </I>+ <I>count</I> * <I>stride</I>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015da6"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7247732ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1352"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1353"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1354"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A257X9113"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7247830ceb"></A>Marking the beginning and end of a NURBS surface trimming loop with the <A HREF="bgntrim.html#A251X98d"><B>bgntrim</B> and <B>endtrim</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247856ceb"></A>Marking the beginning and end of a NURBS surface definition with the <A HREF="bgnsurface.html#A251X9d7"><B>bgnsurface </B>and <B>endsurface</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247881ceb"></A>Returning the current value of a trimmed NURBS surfaces display property with the <A HREF="getnurbsproperty.html#A252X986e"><B>getnurbsproperty</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247907ceb"></A>Controlling the shape of a NURBS trimming curve with the <A HREF="nurbscurve.html#A255X93ca"><B>nurbscurve</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247932ceb"></A>Controlling the shape of a NURBS surface with the <A HREF="nurbssurface.html#A252X98b9"><B>nurbssurface</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247959ceb"></A>Setting a property for the display of trimmed NURBS with the <A HREF="setnurbsproperty.html#A257X911b"><B>setnurbsproperty</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7247984ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Drawing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawnurbs.html#drawnurbs.html">NURBS Curves and Surfaces</A>.</P><hr><center>

 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>

 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
</center></BODY>

</HTML>
```
