<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A14k110nita"></A>tpon Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1927" REL="I1" TITLE="tpon subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1928" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1929" REL="I2" TITLE="textport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1930" REL="I3" TITLE="tpon"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1931" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1932" REL="I2" TITLE="textport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1933" REL="I3" TITLE="turning on"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9125a6"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757C791ceb"></A>Turns on the textport.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11f3"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757C830ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D757C855ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9125a9"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X9125aa"></A><B>void tpon(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010be1"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010be2"></A><B>SUBROUTINE TPON</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9125ad"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757C962ceb"></A>The <B>tpon</B> subroutine brings the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A154P11506">textport</A>, the window associated with the shell that invoked the graphics program, to the front of any windows that conceal it.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f0a"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A30C01104c"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757D024ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="tpbig_c.html#A16C0c9bd"><B>tpbig.c</B></A> uses the <B>tpon</B> subroutine to enable a textport for drawing character strings into. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d7e"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757D068ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11f6"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11f7"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11f8"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9125b6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D757D165ceb"></A>Allocating an area of the screen for the textport with the <A HREF="textport.html#A143X9cb7"><B>textport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D757D191ceb"></A>Turning off the textport with the <A HREF="tpoff.html#A143X9c2f"><B>tpoff</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D757D217ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Working with the <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/textport.html#textport.html">Textport</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X95c8"></A>translate Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1934" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1935" REL="I2" TITLE="coordinate transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1936" REL="I3" TITLE="translate"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1937" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1938" REL="I2" TITLE="graphical primitives"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1939" REL="I3" TITLE="translating"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1940" REL="I1" TITLE="translate subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95ca"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758B741ceb"></A>Translates graphical primitives.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1bd"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758B781ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758B805ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95ce"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A144X95cf"></A><B>void translate(Coord </B><A HREF="translate.html#A5QO11a0marj"><I>x</I></A><B>, Coord </B><A HREF="translate.html#WQO1120marj"><I>y</I></A><B>, Coord </B><A HREF="translate.html#QQO1260marj"><I>z</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A15C0c703"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A15C0c704"></A><B>SUBROUTINE TRANSL(</B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I><B>, </B><I>z</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>x</I><B>, </B><I>y</I><B>, </B><I>z</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95d0"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758B920ceb"></A>The<B> translate </B>subroutine moves the modeling space origin to a new point relative to the current origin. The point (x, y, z) specified by the parameters becomes the new modeling space origin. Because all drawing 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0702">primitives</A> draw relative to the origin of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06el">modeling coordinate</A> system, all primitives called after this subroutine will appear to have been translated. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758B946ceb"></A>The <B>translate </B>subroutine is a modeling routine that changes the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P021">transformation matrix</A>. All primitives drawn after this subroutine executes are translated. Use the <A HREF="pushmatrix.html#A144X9540"><B>pushmatrix</B></A> and <A HREF="popmatrix.html#A144X951e"><B>popmatrix</B></A> subroutines to preserve an untranslated modeling space.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95d2"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A5QO11a0marj"></A><I>x</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I> coordinate of a point in modeling coordinates.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="WQO1120marj"></A><I>y</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I> coordinate of a point in modeling coordinates.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="QQO1260marj"></A><I>z</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>z</I> coordinate of a point in modeling coordinates.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95d8"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758C061ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="backface_c.html#A16C0c7a2"><B>backface.c</B></A> uses the <B>translate</B> modeling subroutine and alters the current transformation matrix to model the sides of a cube using a square. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d40"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758C105ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1c0"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1c1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1c2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95e8"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D758C201ceb"></A>Popping the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="popmatrix.html#A144X951e"><B>popmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758C227ceb"></A>Pushing down the transformation matrix stack with the <A HREF="pushmatrix.html#A144X9540"><B>pushmatrix</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758C252ceb"></A>Rotating a graphical primitive (floating-point version) with the <A HREF="rot.html#A144X9562"><B>rot</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758C281ceb"></A>Rotating a graphical primitive (fixed-point version) with the <A HREF="rotate.html#A8g2120marj"><B>rotate</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758C306ceb"></A>Scaling and mirroring objects with the <A HREF="scale.html#A144X95a6"><B>scale</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D758C332ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and Working with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcoords.html#workcoords.html">Coordinate Systems</A>.</P><hr><center>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Az5O370nita"></A>underlay Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1941" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1942" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer configuration"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1943" REL="I3" TITLE="underlay"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1944" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1945" REL="I2" TITLE="underlay drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1946" REL="I3" TITLE="setting bit planes for"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1947" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1948" REL="I2" TITLE="bitplanes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1949" REL="I3" TITLE="setting number used for underlay drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1950" REL="I1" TITLE="underlay subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A213X912287"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D759A314ceb"></A>Sets the number of user-defined bitplanes used for underlay drawing.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11d2"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D759A354ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A378ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91228a"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X91228b"></A><B>void underlay(Int32 </B><A HREF="underlay.html#Wl8200marj"><I>planes</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C01071c"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01071d"></A><B>SUBROUTINE UNDERL(</B><I>planes</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>planes</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91228e"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D759A491ceb"></A>The <B>underlay</B> subroutine sets the number of user-defined bitplanes used for underlay colors to 0, 2, or 4, depending on the adapter. The underlay color appears whenever all the bits in the color bitplanes are 0 (zero). The system has either two or four bitplanes that can be allocated as either underlay or overlay. Call the <B>underlay</B> subroutine to set them as underlay bitplanes. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A526ceb"></A>The High-Performance 8-bit 3-D Color Graphics Processor can be configured with either 0 or 2 underlay planes. The 8-bit adapter has a total of 2 auxiliary planes, which can be configured into 2/0 or 0/2 overlay/underlay. For example, setting the number of underlay planes to 2 forces the number of overlay planes to 0.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A561ceb"></A>The High-Performance 24-bit 3-D Color Graphics Processor can be configured with either 0, 2, or 4 underlay planes. The 24-bit adapter has a total of 4 auxiliary planes, which can be configured into 4/0, 2/2, or 0/4 overlay/underlay. For example, setting the number of underlay planes to 4 forces the number of overlay planes to 0.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A587ceb"></A>Call the <A HREF="gconfig.html#hS4260nita"><B>gconfig</B></A> subroutine after the <B>underlay </B>subroutine to activate the underlay setting.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A612ceb"></A>When the 
drawing mode
 is UNDERDRAW, all drawing occurs in the underlay bitplanes. In UNDERDRAW mode, FLAT is the only available shading model.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="A258C01c4f7"></A>The operation of this subroutine for the Supergraphics Processor Subsystem is modified. (See <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/undergraphadapt.html#undergraphadapt.html">Understanding the Adapter</A>.)</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A258C01c4f8"></A>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a
 <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X912296"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Wl8200marj"></A><I>planes</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of bitplanes to use for underlay drawing.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016554"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D759A746ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFD69F983janb"></A>Only the Color Graphics Processor has underlay planes.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFD69F994janb"></A>The POWERgraphics GXT1000 does not support the <B>underlay</B> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C11d5"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11d6"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C11d7"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9122a4"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D759A844ceb"></A>Specifying the target frame buffer for drawing subroutines with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A870ceb"></A>Reconfiguring the system with the <A HREF="gconfig.html#hS4260nita"><B>gconfig</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A896ceb"></A>Setting the number of bitplanes used for overlay colors with the <A HREF="overlay.html#A143X950a"><B>overlay</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D759A921ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operations</A>.</P><hr><center>

</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X91b8"></A>unqdevice Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1951" REL="I1" TITLE="unqdevice subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1952" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1953" REL="I2" TITLE="queue"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1954" REL="I3" TITLE="disabling input device for event queuing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1955" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1956" REL="I2" TITLE="device"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1957" REL="I3" TITLE="disabling input device for event queuing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1958" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1959" REL="I2" TITLE="queue and device"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1960" REL="I3" TITLE="unqdevice"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91ba"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9227ceb"></A>Disables an input device for event queuing</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1194"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9267ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75A9292ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91be"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X91bf"></A><B>void unqdevice(Device </B><A HREF="unqdevice.html#A143X91c3"><I>dev</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c84"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c85"></A><B>SUBROUTINE UNQDEV(</B><I>dev</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>dev</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91c0"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9404ceb"></A>The <B>unqdevice</B> subroutine removes the specified device from the list of devices whose changes are recorded in the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0484">event queue</A>. If a device has recorded events that have not been read, they remain in the queue. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75A9430ceb"></A>Use the <B>qreset</B> subroutine to flush the event queue. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f90"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X91c2"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X91c3"></A><I>dev</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an identifier for the device to be disabled.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01106e"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9526ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="prompt_c.html#A16C0c8de"><B>prompt.c</B></A> uses the <B>unqdevice</B> subroutine to disable input from the keyboard. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016629"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9570ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91d4"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1197"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1198"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1199"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/device.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C119a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fdevice.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X91d8"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75A9707ceb"></A>Enabling an input device for event queuing with the <A HREF="qdevice.html#A143X967"><B>qdevice</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75A9732ceb"></A>Emptying the event queue with the <A HREF="qreset.html#A143X9ab"><B>qreset</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75A9758ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A> and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/cntrlques.html#cntrlques.html">Controlling Queues and Devices</A>.</P><hr><center>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B7935ceb"></A>Transfers a 2-D, 3-D, or 4-D vertex to the graphics pipe.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C125"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75B7974ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B7999ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X97aa"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP" COLSPAN="2"><A NAME="Lln12f0marj"></A><B>void v2s(Int16 </B><A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[2])</B>
</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP" COLSPAN="2"><A NAME="atn1d0marj"></A><B>void v2i(Int32 </B><A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[2])</B>
</TD></TR>
<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>

</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP" COLSPAN="2"><A NAME="Ryn1170marj"></A><B>void v3i(Int32 </B><A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[3])</B>
</TD></TR>
<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD>  void v3d(Float64 <A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[3])</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP" COLSPAN="2"><A NAME="A9Do12f0marj"></A><B>void v4s(Int16 </B><A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[4])</B>
</TD></TR>
<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD>  void v4f(Float32 <A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[4])</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP" COLSPAN="2"><A NAME="nDo1390marj"></A><B>void v4i(Int32 </B><A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[4])</B>
</TD></TR>
<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD>  void v4d(Float64 <A HREF="v.html#fVn1110marj"><I>vector</I></A><B>[4])</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A20C0e2ed"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A20C0e2ee"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V2S(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>vector</I><B>(2)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010464"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V2I(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>vector</I><B>(2)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010465"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V2F(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>vector</I>(<B>2)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010466"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V2D(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL*8 </B><I>vector</I><B>(2)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A20C0e2ef"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V3S(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>vector</I><B>(3)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010467"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V3I(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>vector</I><B>(3)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010468"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V3F(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>vector</I><B>(3)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010469"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V3D(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL*8 </B><I>vector</I><B>(3)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C01046a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V4S(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>vector</I><B>(4)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C01046b"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V4I(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>vector</I><B>(4)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C01046c"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V4F(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>vector</I><B>(4)</B></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C01046d"></A><B>SUBROUTINE V4D(</B><I>vector</I><B>)</B>
<B>DOUBLE </B><I>vector</I><B>(4)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X97ac"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75B8424ceb"></A>The <B>v</B> subroutine transfers a single 2-D (<B>v2</B>), 3-D (<B>v3</B>), or 4-D (<B>v4</B>) vertex to the 
graphics pipeline. The coordinates are passed to <B>v</B> as an array. Separate subroutines are provided for 16-bit integers (<B>s</B>), 32-bit integers limited to a signed 24-bit range (<B>i</B>), 32-bit IEEE single precision floats (<B>f</B>), and 64-bit IEEE double precision floats (<B>d</B>). The <I>z</I> coordinate defaults to 0.0 if not specified. The <I>w</I> coordinate defaults to 1.0. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8451ceb"></A>The Graphics Library subroutines <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>bgnpoint</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>endpoint</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>bgnline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>endline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>bgnclosedline</B></A>, 
<A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>endclosedline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>bgnpolygon</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>endpolygon</B></A>, <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>bgntmesh</B></A>, and <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>endtmesh</B></A> determine how the vertex is interpreted. 
For example, vertices specified between the <B>bgnpoint</B> and <B>endpoint</B> subroutines draw single pixels (points) on the screen. Likewise, those specified between the <B>bgnline </B>and <B>endline</B> subroutines draw a sequence of lines (with the line stipple continued through internal vertices). Closed lines return to the first vertex specified, producing the equivalent of an 
outlined polygon. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8478ceb"></A>Vertices specified when none of the <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>bgnpoint</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>bgnline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>bgnclosedline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>bgnpolygon</B></A>, and <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>bgntmesh</B></A> subroutines are active set the current graphics position. They do not have any effect on the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A270A984a">frame buffer</A> contents. The <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>endpoint</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>endline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>endclosedline</B></A>, <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>endpolygon</B></A>, and <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>endtmesh</B></A> subroutines have varied effects on the current graphics position.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X97ae"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="fVn1110marj"></A><I>vector</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies 2-, 3-, or 4-element array, depending on whether you call the <B>v2</B>, <B>v3</B>, or <B>v4</B> version of the routine. The elements of the array are the coordinates of the vertex (point) to transfer to the 
graphics pipe. Put the <I>x</I> coordinate in element 0, the <I>y</I> coordinate in element 1, the <I>z</I> coordinate in element 2 (for <B>v3</B> and <B>v4</B>), and the <I>w</I> coordinate in element 3 (for <B>v4</B>). </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8549ceb"></A>The nine different forms for the <B>v</B> subroutine are as follows:</P>

<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><BR></TD>

<TD><B>2-D</B></TD>

<TD><B>3-D</B></TD>

<TD><B>4-D</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>Int16</TD>

<TD>v2s</TD>

<TD>v3s</TD>

<TD>v4s</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>Int32</TD>

<TD>v2i</TD>

<TD>v3i</TD>

<TD>v4i</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>Float32</TD>

<TD>v2f</TD>

<TD>v3f</TD>

<TD>v4f</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>Float64</TD>

<TD>v2d</TD>

<TD>v3d</TD>

<TD>v4d</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8597ceb"></A>The <A HREF="v.html#A144X97aa">syntax</A> for each of the subroutine forms is the same except for the first argument.  They differ only in that<B> vi</B> expects long integer coordinates, <B>vs</B> expects short integer coordinates, <B>vf</B> expects single-precision floating point coordinates, and <B>vd</B> expects double-precision floating point coordinates. In addition, the <B>v2*</B> routines assume a 2-D point, the  <B>v3* </B>routines assume a 3-D point, and the  <B>v4*</B> routines assume a 4-D point 
(in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0623">homogeneous coordinates</A>.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X97b4"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75B8639ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="cylinder2_c.html#A16C0c87c"><B>cylinder2.c</B></A> calls the <B>v3f</B> subroutine between the <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>bgnpolygon</B></A> subroutine and the <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>endpolygon</B></A> subroutine to specify the vertices of a polygon.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d7a"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75B8682ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C128"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C129"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C12a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X97c4"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75B8780ceb"></A>Drawing closed line vertices with the <A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>bgnclosedline</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8808ceb"></A>Drawing vertex-based lines with the <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>bgnline</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8837ceb"></A>Drawing vertex-based points with the <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>bgnpoint</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8866ceb"></A>Drawing vertex-based polygons with the <A HREF="bgnpolygon.html#A144X9672"><B>bgnpolygon</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8891ceb"></A>Drawing triangle mesh vertices with the <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>bgntmesh</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8917ceb"></A>Ending a series of closed line vertices with the <A HREF="bgnclosedline.html#A144X960c"><B>endclosedline</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8946ceb"></A>Ending a series of vertex-based lines with the <A HREF="bgnline.html#A144X962e"><B>endline</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B8975ceb"></A>Ending a series of vertex-based points with the <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>endpoint</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B9004ceb"></A>Ending a vertex-based polygon with the <A HREF="bgnpoint.html#A144X9650"><B>endpolygon</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B9030ceb"></A>Ending a series of triangle mesh vertices with the <A HREF="bgntmesh.html#A144X9694"><B>endtmesh</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75B9056ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, Drawing with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/drawbeg-end.html">Begin-End Style</A> Subroutines, and Understanding the <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Hardware Used by GL</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P><hr><center>

<TITLE>viewport Subroutine
</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>
[  <a href="v.html">Previous</a>  |

 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="qrY270marj"></A>viewport Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1968" REL="I1" TITLE="viewport subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1969" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1970" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1971" REL="I3" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1972" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1973" REL="I2" TITLE="viewport"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1974" REL="I3" TITLE="setting areas"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b99"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C7723ceb"></A>Sets the area of the window used for all drawing.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C129c"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C7762ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C7786ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b9c"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911b9d"></A><B>void viewport</B>
<B>(Screencoord </B><A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba6"><I>left</I></A><B>, Screencoord</B> <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba7"><I>right</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Screencoord</B> <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba8"><I>bottom</I></A><B>, Screencoord</B> <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba9"><I>top</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911b77"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X911b7a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE VIEWPO(</B><I>left</I><B>,</B> <I>right</I><B>,</B> <I>bottom</I><B>,</B> <I>top</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>left</I><B>,</B> <I>right</I><B>,</B> <I>bottom</I><B>,</B> <I>top</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C129f"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this subroutine accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when invoked from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when invoked from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X911ba0"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C7921ceb"></A>The <B>viewport</B> subroutine specifies, in pixels, the area of the window in which all drawing occurs. The 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A> locations are specified relative to the lower left corner of the window. Specifying the viewport is the last step in mapping 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P06el">modeling coordinates</A> to 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P017">screen coordinates</A>. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C7947ceb"></A>The portion of world space that the <A HREF="window.html#A144X95ea"><B>window</B></A>, <A HREF="ortho.html#A144X9496"><B>ortho</B></A>, or <A HREF="perspective.html#A144X94da"><B>perspective</B></A> subroutines describe is mapped into the viewport. The <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba6"><I>left</I></A>, <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba7"><I>right</I></A>, <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba8"><I>bottom</I></A>, <A HREF="viewport.html#A213X911ba9"><I>top</I></A> coordinates define a rectangular area on the screen.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C7974ceb"></A>The viewport is set to the size of the window when the window is first opened (thus, a <A HREF="getviewport.html#A142X9107"><B>getviewport</B></A> would return the size of the window). However, if the window is resized, the viewport dimensions are not automatically updated (use the <A HREF="reshapeviewport.html#A7LQ3b0marj"><B>reshapeviewport</B></A> subroutine). The viewport may be much larger or much smaller than the window size. All drawing occurs inside the current viewport, but is clipped to the window.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8000ceb"></A>If the <I>left</I> parameter is greater than the <I>right</I> parameter, the displayed image will be left-right reversed. If the <I>bottom</I> parameter is greater than the <I>top</I> parameter, the displayed image will be up-down reversed.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8026ceb"></A>The viewport is the mapping from normalized device coordinates (NDC) to device coordinates (DC). The same function is provided for the z-direction with the <A HREF="lsetdepth.html#naR120marj"><B>lsetdepth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8051ceb"></A>The <B>viewport</B> subroutine also resets the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A>. The screenmask is set to be exactly the same size as the viewport.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911ba5"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911ba6"></A><I>left</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x </I>location (in pixels) of left side of viewport.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911ba7"></A><I>right</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x </I>location (in pixels) of right side of viewport.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911ba8"></A><I>bottom</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y </I>location (in pixels) of bottom of viewport.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X911ba9"></A><I>top</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y </I>location (in pixels) of top of viewport.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01100e"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C8187ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="paint_c.html#A13C0bd84"><B>paint.c</B></A> uses the <B>viewport</B> subroutine to define a viewport for displaying an image. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d44"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C8230ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C12a0"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12a1"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C12a2"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X911bbc"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75C8327ceb"></A>Defining the viewport depth with the <A HREF="lsetdepth.html#naR120marj"><B>lsetdepth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8353ceb"></A>Popping the viewport off the viewport stack with the <A HREF="popviewport.html#A213X911d3c"><B>popviewport</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8378ceb"></A>Pushing the viewport onto the viewport stack with the <A HREF="pushviewport.html#A213X911bee"><B>pushviewport</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8404ceb"></A>Changing the viewport shape with the <A HREF="reshapeviewport.html#A7LQ3b0marj"><B>reshapeviewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8432ceb"></A>Defining a rectangular 2-D clipping mask with the <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75C8458ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, Using <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/useviewprts.html#useviewprts.html">Viewports and Screenmasks</A>, and Working with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcoords.html#workcoords.html">Coordinate Systems</A>.</P><hr><center>
[  <a href="v.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="winclose.html">Next</a>  |
<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
</center></BODY>

</HTML>

<H2><A NAME="A16C0c9fd"></A>vlsi.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2488" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2489" REL="I2" TITLE="editor"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2490" REL="I3" TITLE="vlsi graphical"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2491" REL="I1" TITLE="vlsi.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2492" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2493" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2494" REL="I3" TITLE="pixel"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBBD951ttay"></A>/*
vlsi.c</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBBF463ttay"></A>A simple vlsi graphical editor.  RIGHTMOUSE clears the screen.
LEFTMOUSE picks the current color from one of 4 in the bottom
left-hand corner, and draws the rectangles.  To draw, hold down
LEFTMOUSE on the point where you want one of the four
corners of the rectangle to be, and then move the mouse to the
opposite corner of the rectangle you want to specify, BEFORE you
let go of the LEFTMOUSE.
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBBF620ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBBF765ttay"></A>main()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBBF933ttay"></A>  register i;
  Device dummy, xend, yend, xstart, ystart, type;
  short wm;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC0619ttay"></A>  prefposition(0, XMAXSCREEN-50, 0, YMAXSCREEN-50);
  winopen("vlsi");
  save_cmap();
  mapcolor(0, 255, 255, 255);    /* WHITE */
  mapcolor(1, 0, 0, 255);        /* BLUE */
  mapcolor(2, 0, 255, 0);        /* RED */
  mapcolor(3, 0, 150, 255);      /* PURPLE */
  mapcolor(4, 255, 0, 0);        /* GREEN */
  mapcolor(5, 150, 0, 255);      /* LIGHT BLUE */
  mapcolor(6, 255, 255, 0);      /* YELLOW */
  mapcolor(7, 150, 100, 0);      /* BROWN */
  for (i = 8; i &lt; 24; i++)
    mapcolor(i, 0, 0, 0);        /* BLACK */
  for (i = 24; i &lt; 32; i++)
    mapcolor(i, 255, 255, 255);  /* WHITE */
  qdevice(LEFTMOUSE);
  tie(LEFTMOUSE, MOUSEX, MOUSEY);
  qdevice(MIDDLEMOUSE);
  tie(MIDDLEMOUSE, MOUSEX, MOUSEY);
  qdevice(RIGHTMOUSE);
  qdevice(KEYBD);
  setcursor(0, 16, 16);
  restart();
  while (TRUE)
    switch (type = qread(&amp;dummy)) {
    case KEYBD:
      restore_cmap();
      greset();
      gexit();
      exit(0);
    case RIGHTMOUSE:
      qread(&amp;dummy);
      restart();
      break;
    case MIDDLEMOUSE:
    case LEFTMOUSE:
      qread(&amp;xstart);
      qread(&amp;ystart);
      if (xstart &lt; 60) {
        if (10 &lt;= xstart &amp;&amp; xstart &lt;= 50) {
          if (10 &lt;= ystart &amp;&amp; ystart &lt;= 50)
            wm = 1;
          else if (60 &lt;= ystart &amp;&amp; ystart &lt;= 100)
            wm = 2;
          else if (110 &lt;= ystart &amp;&amp; ystart &lt;= 150)
            wm = 4;
          else if (160 &lt;= ystart &amp;&amp; ystart &lt;= 200)
            wm = 8;
          writemask(wm);
          qread(&amp;dummy);
          qread(&amp;dummy);
          qread(&amp;dummy);
        }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC0873ttay"></A>      }
      else {
        qread(&amp;dummy);
        qread(&amp;xend);
        qread(&amp;yend);
        if (xend > 60) {
          if (type == LEFTMOUSE)
            color(31);           /* draw */
          else
            color(0);            /* erase */
          rectfi(xstart, ystart, xend, yend);
        }
      }
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1015ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1162ttay"></A>restart()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1400ttay"></A>  writemask(0xfff);
  color(0);
  clear();
  color(1);
  rectfi(10, 10, 50, 50);
  color(2);
  rectfi(10, 60, 50, 100);
  color(4);
  rectfi(10, 110, 50, 150);
  color(8);
  rectfi(10, 160, 50, 200);
  move2i(60, 0);
  draw2i(60, 767);
  color(31);
  writemask(0);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1543ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1719ttay"></A>/*This saves the colormap*/
#define lo_end 0
#define hi_end 255
short *CarrayR, *CarrayG, *CarrayB;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC1916ttay"></A>save_cmap()
{
  CarrayR = calloc (lo_end+hi_end,sizeof(short));
  CarrayG = calloc (lo_end+hi_end,sizeof(short));
  CarrayB = calloc (lo_end+hi_end,sizeof(short));</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC2090ttay"></A>  getmcolors ((Int16 const)lo_end,(Int16 const)hi_end,
     CarrayR, CarrayG, CarrayB);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBC2301ttay"></A>/*This restores the colormap*/
restore_cmap()
{
  mapcolors ((Int16 const)lo_end,(Int16 const)hi_end,
     CarrayR, CarrayG, CarrayB);
}
/*
  Changes:
    -  Added the restoring of the colormap
*/</PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A201C11ad"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D790D534ceb"></A>The <A HREF="greset.html#xW42e0nita"><B>greset</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="xW42e0nita" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="tie.html#A143X9196"><B>tie</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X9196" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="writemask.html#A143X9592"><B>writemask</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X9592" REL="PAGENUM"></A>.</P>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91418"></A>winclose Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1975" REL="I1" TITLE="winclose subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1976" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1977" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1978" REL="I3" TITLE="winclose"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1979" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1980" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1981" REL="I3" TITLE="closing"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9141a"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75D6393ceb"></A>Closes the identified window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1333"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75D6432ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75D6456ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9141e"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912a75"></A><B>void winclose(Int32 </B><A HREF="winclose.html#nn53350marj"><I>windowid</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A18C0dcf6"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A18C0dcf7"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINCLO(</B><I>windowid</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>windowid</I><B>;</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91420"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75D6569ceb"></A>The <B>winclose </B>subroutine closes the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A> associated with the <A HREF="winclose.html#nn53350marj"><I>windowid</I></A> parameter. The identifier for a window is the function return value from the call to the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine that created the window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="BD2FDE7354vbia"></A>If the current window is closed with the <B>winclose</B> subroutine, another window is chosen arbitrarily as the current window. All subsequent drawing is directed to this window. To avoid encountering unexpected behavior due to arbitrary window selection, use the <B>winset</B> subroutine to choose a new current window.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A318C9f30"></A>The <B>winclose</B> subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91422"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="nn53350marj"></A><I>windowid</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies which window to close.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159d2"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75D6702ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1336"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1337"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1338"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91438"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75D6799ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75D6825ceb"></A>Setting the current window with the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75D6851ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X914c1"></A>winconstraints Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1982" REL="I1" TITLE="winconstraints subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1983" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1984" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1985" REL="I3" TITLE="winconstraints"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1986" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1987" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1988" REL="I3" TITLE="binding constraints"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914c3"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E6550ceb"></A>Binds window constraints to the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1339"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E6589ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E6614ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914c7"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912a7e"></A><B>void winconstraints(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c29"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c2a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINCON</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914c9"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E6723ceb"></A>The <B>winconstraints </B>subroutine binds the specified constraints to the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>. Because this subroutine assumes the existence of a current window, the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine must be called before the <B>winconstraints </B>subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E6749ceb"></A>The values of the window constraints are set by using the following subroutines: </P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A213X912a82"></A><A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a83"></A><A HREF="iconsize.html#LA13e0marj"><B>iconsize</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a85"></A><A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a86"></A><A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a87"></A><A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a88"></A><A HREF="noborder.html#A142X91d7a"><B>noborder</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a89"></A><A HREF="noport.html#ZN13170marj"><B>noport</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a8a"></A><A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a8b"></A><A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912a8c"></A><A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A></LI></UL>


<P><A NAME="E1D75E6933ceb"></A>After binding these constraints to a window, the <B>winconstraints </B>subroutine resets the specified window constraints to their default values. Thus, to reset and bind the current constraints, call the <B>winconstraints </B>subroutine twice in a row.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E6960ceb"></A>The changes made to window attributes (whether actual constraints imposed by the <A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A> and <A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A> subroutines, or limits only suggested by the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> and <A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A> subroutines) are bound to the window and take effect immediately. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f33"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X914d1"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E7021ceb"></A>To set the current window's aspect ratio, the example C language program <A HREF="colored_c.html"><B>colored.c</B></A> calls the <B>winconstraints</B> subroutine after calling the <A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159d4"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E7065ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C133c"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C133d"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C133e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914e1"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75E7162ceb"></A>Specifying pixel values to be added to a window with the <A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7187ceb"></A>Specifying the size of a window icon with the <A HREF="iconsize.html#LA13e0marj"><B>iconsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7213ceb"></A>Specifying the aspect ratio of a window with the <A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7239ceb"></A>Specifying the maximum size of a window with the <A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7264ceb"></A>Specifying the minimum size of a window with the <A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7290ceb"></A>Removing the border from a window with the <A HREF="noborder.html#A142X91d7a"><B>noborder</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7315ceb"></A>Specifying that a program does not require a window with the <A HREF="noport.html#ZN13170marj"><B>noport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7341ceb"></A>Constraining the size of a window with the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7366ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7392ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75E7418ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>
[  <a href="winclose.html">Previous</a>  |

 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
</center></BODY>

</HTML>

 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X914e3"></A>windepth Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1989" REL="I1" TITLE="windepth subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1990" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1991" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1992" REL="I3" TITLE="windepth"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1993" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1994" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1995" REL="I3" TITLE="indicating stack order"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914e5"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75F5053ceb"></A>Indicates the stacking order of windows on the screen.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C133f"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75F5093ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D75F5117ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914e9"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912a9a"></A><B>Int32 windepth(Int32 </B><A HREF="windepth.html#A1D63190marj"><I>windowid</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A18C0dcf8"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A18C0dcf9"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINDEP(</B><I>windowid</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>windowid</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914eb"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75F5229ceb"></A>The <B>windepth </B>subroutine returns a number that can be compared against the same return value for other 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">windows</A> to indicate the stacking order of a program's windows on the screen. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X914ed"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A1D63190marj"></A><I>windowid</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies which window to test.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159d6"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D75F5308ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1342"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1343"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A144X95ea"></A>window  Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX1996" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1997" REL="I2" TITLE="coordinate transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1998" REL="I3" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX1999" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2000" REL="I2" TITLE="transformation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2001" REL="I3" TITLE="perspective projection"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2002" REL="I1" TITLE="window subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95ec"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7603847ceb"></A>Defines a perspective projection transformation in terms of x and y coordinates.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C173"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7603887ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7603911ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95f0"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X91272c"></A><B>void window</B>
<B>(Coord </B><A HREF="window.html#a7P1340marj"><I>left</I></A><B>, Coord</B> <A HREF="window.html#t7P1300marj"><I>right</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Coord</B> <A HREF="window.html#A68P1280marj"><I>bottom</I></A><B>, Coord</B> <A HREF="window.html#I8P1c0marj"><I>top</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Coord</B> <A HREF="window.html#V8P1marj"><I>near</I></A><B>, Coord</B> <A HREF="window.html#i8P12e0marj"><I>far</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A15C0c706"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A15C0c707"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINDOW(</B><I>left</I><B>, </B><I>right</I><B>, </B><I>bottom</I><B>, </B><I>top</I><B>, </B><I>near</I><B>, </B><I>far</I><B>)</B>
<B>REAL </B><I>left</I><B>, </B><I>right</I><B>, </B><I>bottom</I><B>, </B><I>top</I><B>, </B><I>near</I><B>, </B><I>far</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X95f2"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7604025ceb"></A>The <B>window </B>subroutine set the current projection transformation to be a perspective transformation. With a perspective transformation, figures do not get smaller as they recede in relation to the viewer. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604051ceb"></A>The <B>window </B>subroutine defines a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P051d">frustum</A> in eye coordinates. All figures outside this frustum are clipped and not drawn on the screen. All objects contained within this frustum are drawn on the screen in perspective. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604079ceb"></A>The front and back of the frustum are the near and far clipping planes, respectively, located at <I>near</I> and <I>far</I><B>.</B> The sides of the frustum are the projection of a rectangle in the near clipping plane. That is, given a rectangle in the near clipping plane, the sides of the frustum are given by extending from the eye (the origin) through the near clipping plane to the far clipping plane. The sides of the frustum are the left, right, bottom, and top clipping planes. The size of the rectangle on the near clipping plane is given by the parameters <I>left</I><B>, </B><I>right</I><B>, </B><I>bottom</I><B>,</B> and <I>top</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604105ceb"></A>The <B>window</B> subroutine is very similar to the <A HREF="perspective.html#A144X94da"><B>perspective</B></A> subroutine. The only difference between these two is the manner in which the arguments specify the viewing frustum.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604130ceb"></A>After the <B>window </B>subroutine completes, the eye coordinate system is set up so that x is to the right, y is up, and z is towards the viewer (out of the screen).</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604156ceb"></A>In 
single matrix mode, the <B>window </B>subroutine loads a matrix onto the matrix stack, replacing the current top matrix. In 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P036">viewing matrix mode</A> and projection matrix mode, the system replaces the current projection matrix.  </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A41C012756"></A><B>Note: </B>Do not confuse the <B>window </B>subroutine and its functions with the GL windowing subroutines, and the Enhanced X-Windows subroutines, which control the placement and size of rectangular windows on the screen.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A144X95f4"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="a7P1340marj"></A><I>left</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I> coordinate of left side of frustum.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="t7P1300marj"></A><I>right</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I> coordinate of right side of frustum.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A68P1280marj"></A><I>bottom</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I> coordinate of bottom of frustum.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="I8P1c0marj"></A><I>top</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I> coordinate of top of frustum.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="V8P1marj"></A><I>near</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>z</I> coordinate of the near clipping plane.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="i8P12e0marj"></A><I>far</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>z</I> coordinate of the far clipping plane.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A62C015d42"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7604350ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C176"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C177"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C178"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A144X960a"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7604450ceb"></A>Defining a 3-D orthographic transformation with the <A HREF="ortho.html#A144X9496"><B>ortho</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604476ceb"></A>Defining a perspective projection transformation in terms of a field of view with the <A HREF="perspective.html#A144X94da"><B>perspective</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7604501ceb"></A>Setting the area of the window used for all drawing with the <A HREF="viewport.html#qrY270marj"><B>viewport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91505"></A>winget Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2003" REL="I1" TITLE="winget subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2004" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2005" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2006" REL="I3" TITLE="winget"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2007" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2008" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2009" REL="I3" TITLE="identifying current"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2010" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2011" REL="I2" TITLE="query"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2012" REL="I3" TITLE="winget"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A142X91507"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612340ceb"></A>Returns the identifier of the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1345"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612379ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7612404ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9150b"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912aa2"></A><B>Int32 winget(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A52C0142d5"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A52C0142d6"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION WINGET</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9150d"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612513ceb"></A>The <B>winget </B>subroutine returns the identifier of the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. The <I>current</I> <I>window</I> is the window into which all drawing is directed, the window most recently selected with the <B>winset</B> subroutine, or the window most recently created with the <B>winopen</B> subroutine. The <I>window</I> <I>identifier</I> of a window is the integer returned by the <B>winopen</B> subroutine.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="C4B2E33668vbia"></A><B>Attention: </B>If the current window is closed by the <B>winclose</B> subroutine, another window is chosen arbitrarily as the current window. In such cases, use the <B>winset</B> subroutine to choose a new current window.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f38"></A><B>Note: </B>The <B>winget</B> subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91513"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612592ceb"></A>The identifier of the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159d8"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612636ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1348"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1349"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C134a"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91525"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7612733ceb"></A>Closing the identified window with the <A HREF="winclose.html#A142X91418"><B>winclose</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7612758ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7612784ceb"></A>Setting the current window with the <A HREF="winset.html#NY1320marj"><B>winset</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7612809ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X91527"></A>winmove Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2013" REL="I1" TITLE="winmove subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2014" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2015" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2016" REL="I3" TITLE="winmove"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2017" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2018" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2019" REL="I3" TITLE="moving"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91529"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7621172ceb"></A>Moves the current window by its lower-left corner.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C134b"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7621211ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621235ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9152d"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912aa9"></A><B>void winmove(Int32 </B><A HREF="winmove.html#TDO380marj"><I>originx</I></A><B>, Int32 </B><A HREF="winmove.html#XEO3380marj"><I>originy</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c2b"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c2c"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINMOV(</B><I>originx</I><B>, </B><I>originy</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>originx</I><B>, </B><I>originy</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9152f"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7621349ceb"></A>The <B>winmove </B>subroutine moves the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A> so that its origin, the lower-left corner, is at the screen coordinates specified in pixels by the <A HREF="winmove.html#TDO380marj"><I>originx</I></A> and <A HREF="winmove.html#XEO3380marj"><I>originy</I></A> parameters. The <B>winmove</B> subroutine removes the current size constraint. After the <B>winmove</B> subroutine is started, the user can interactively change the position and size of the window. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621374ceb"></A>The <B>winmove</B> subroutine does not remove the other window constraints, such as the minimum and maximum size constraints, the aspect ratio, or the stepunit.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621400ceb"></A>To keep the window size constrained, use the <B>prefposition</B> or the <B>prefsize</B> subroutines to move and resize a window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f3b"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91531"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="TDO380marj"></A><I>originx</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I> coordinate of the lower-left corner of the new location for the current window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="XEO3380marj"></A><I>originy</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I> coordinate of the lower-left corner of the new location for the current window.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159da"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7621517ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C134e"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C134f"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1350"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91547"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7621614ceb"></A>Binding window constraints to the current window with the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621639ceb"></A>Raising the current window on top of all other windows with the <A HREF="winpop.html#A142X9156b"><B>winpop</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621664ceb"></A>Changing the current location and size of a window with the <A HREF="winposition.html#A142X9158d"><B>winposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621690ceb"></A>Lowering the current window beneath all other windows with the <A HREF="winpush.html#A4X13320marj"><B>winpush</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7621715ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<H2><A NAME="A142X91549"></A>winopen Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2020" REL="I1" TITLE="winopen subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2021" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2022" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2023" REL="I3" TITLE="winopen"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2024" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2025" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2026" REL="I3" TITLE="creating"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9154b"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D762F824ceb"></A>Creates a window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1351"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D762F863ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D762F888ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9154f"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912ab1"></A><B>Int32 winopen(Char8 *</B><A HREF="winopen.html#EPP380marj"><I>name</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A18C0dcfa"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A18C0dcfb"></A><B>INTEGER*4 FUNCTION WINOPE(</B><A HREF="winopen.html#EPP380marj"><I>name</I></A><B>,</B> <A HREF="winopen.html#qPP32a0marj"><I>length</I></A><B>)</B>
<B>CHARACTER*(*) </B><I>name</I>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>length</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91551"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7630000ceb"></A>The <B>winopen </B>subroutine creates a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A> as defined by the current values of the window constraints. This new window becomes the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>. If this is the first time that a program has called the <B>winopen</B> subroutine, the system also initializes the graphics system.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630026ceb"></A>The returned value for this function is the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A> identifier (gwid) for the window just created. Use this value to identify the window to other graphics functions. If no additional windows are available, this function returns -1 (negative one). </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630052ceb"></A>If called before the <B>winopen</B> subroutine, the following subroutines change the default window constraints:</P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A213X912ab8"></A><A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912ab9"></A><A HREF="iconsize.html#LA13e0marj"><B>iconsize</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912abb"></A><A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912abc"></A><A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912abd"></A><A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912abe"></A><A HREF="noborder.html#A142X91d7a"><B>noborder</B></A> </LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912abf"></A><A HREF="noport.html#ZN13170marj"><B>noport</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912ac0"></A><A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912ac1"></A><A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A></LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X912ac2"></A><A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> </LI></UL>


<P><A NAME="E1D7630235ceb"></A>If a window's size and location are left unconstrained, the system allows the user to place and size the window. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630262ceb"></A>All drawing (lines, polygons, and NURBS) is done in the current window. Lighting, depth-cueing, and z-buffering all apply to the current window. Every window has an independent set of stacks: matrix stack, name stack, attribute stack, and viewport stack, and all stack manipulation routines such as matrix multiplies are directed at the current window. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630288ceb"></A>The only attributes that are shared across windows are those defined with the <A HREF="defcursor.html#A150X9444"><B>defcursor</B></A>, <A HREF="deflinestyle.html#A143X9b1f"><B>deflinestyle</B></A>, <A HREF="defpattern.html#A143X9b41"><B>defpattern</B></A>, <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A>, <A HREF="lmdef.html#rgZ2250marj"><B>lmdef</B></A>, <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A>, and <A HREF="makeobj.html#A142X912d"><B>makeobj</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630314ceb"></A>The <B>winopen</B> subroutine examines the environment variable DISPLAY to determine to which AIXwindows server to make a connection. The default DISPLAY value is <SAMP>unix:0</SAMP>. Only local sessions are currently supported. A GL session can only run on an AIXwindows server that has extensions to support GL. Not all AIXwindows servers support GL.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630340ceb"></A>The<B> winopen </B>subroutine queues the 
INPUTCHANGE
 and 
REDRAW
 pseudo devices. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f3e"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91553"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="EPP380marj"></A><I>name</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the window title displayed on the left hand side of the title bar. A zero-length string displays no title. </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="qPP32a0marj"></A><I>length</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the length of the string in the <I>name</I> parameter. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91559"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7630455ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="colored_c.html"><B>colored.c</B></A> uses the <B>winopen</B> subroutine to create a window with characteristics previously defined in the program.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159dc"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7630498ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1354"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1355"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1356"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91569"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7630595ceb"></A>Specifying pixel values to be added to a window with the <A HREF="fudge.html#A142X917a6"><B>fudge</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630621ceb"></A>Giving a program the entire screen as a window with the <A HREF="fullscrn.html#Qga140marj"><B>fullscrn</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630646ceb"></A>Obtaining the position of a window with the <A HREF="getorigin.html#A142X91f76"><B>getorigin</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630672ceb"></A>Obtaining the size of the window with the <A HREF="getsize.html#X513200marj"><B>getsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630698ceb"></A>Specifying the size of a window icon with the <A HREF="iconsize.html#LA13e0marj"><B>iconsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630723ceb"></A>Specifying the title of a window icon with the <A HREF="icontitle.html#sH13240marj"><B>icontitle</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630748ceb"></A>Specifying the aspect ratio of a window with the <A HREF="keepaspect.html#A142X91896"><B>keepaspect</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630774ceb"></A>Specifying the maximum size of a window with the <A HREF="maxsize.html#A142X916d6"><B>maxsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630799ceb"></A>Specifying the minimum size of a window with the <A HREF="minsize.html#MJ13260marj"><B>minsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630825ceb"></A>Removing the border from a window with the <A HREF="noborder.html#A142X91d7a"><B>noborder</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630850ceb"></A>Specifying that a program does not require a window with the <A HREF="noport.html#ZN13170marj"><B>noport</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630876ceb"></A>Constraining the window position and size with the <A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630901ceb"></A>Constraining the size of a window with the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630927ceb"></A>Specifying a window size change in discrete steps with the <A HREF="stepunit.html#A142X91bd2"><B>stepunit</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630952ceb"></A>Creating a restricted subwindow with the <A HREF="swinopen.html#A2T741b0nita"><B>swinopen</B></A> subroutines.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7630978ceb"></A>Closing the identified window with the <A HREF="winclose.html#A142X91418"><B>winclose</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7631004ceb"></A>Binding window constraints to the current window with the <A HREF="winconstraints.html#A142X914c1"><B>winconstraints</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7631029ceb"></A>Adding a title bar to the current window with the <A HREF="wintitle.html#A142X915f3"><B>wintitle</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X9156b"></A>winpop Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2027" REL="I1" TITLE="winpop subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2028" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2029" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2030" REL="I3" TITLE="winpop"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2031" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2032" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2033" REL="I3" TITLE="raising to top"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A142X9156d"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D763E881ceb"></A>Raises the current window on top of all other windows.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A3CFD7A6214janb"></A><B>Note: </B>The GL window management routines are built on top the X11 Window System library. Because X11 is asynchronous in nature, there is no guarantee that windowing commands and drawing commands will be performed in the order issued. In particular, do <I>not</I> assume that the current window will be on top when the <B>winpop</B> subroutine returns (it will be moved to the top eventually but asynchronously from the subroutine call). When using the <B>winpop()</B> subroutine, wait for a REDRAW event for the associated window before drawing into it. Otherwise, early drawing (drawing before the window has been moved to the top) will be clipped to the old window boundaries. </BLOCKQUOTE>


<P>Use the <B>gflush()</B> subroutine to ensure drawing is complete. Unless this is done, window pushes and pops may be scheduled and completed before drawing is complete. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1357"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D763E920ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D763E944ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91571"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912ad7"></A><B>void winpop(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c2d"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c2e"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINPOP</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91573"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D763F052ceb"></A>The <B>winpop </B>subroutine raises the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A> from anywhere in the stack of windows to the top position. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f41"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A61C0159de"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D763F114ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C135a"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C135b"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A190C1151"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9158b"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D763F211ceb"></A>Lowering the current window beneath all other windows with the <A HREF="winpush.html#A4X13320marj"><B>winpush</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D763F237ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>
