<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X9158d"></A>winposition Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2034" REL="I1" TITLE="winposition subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2035" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2036" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2037" REL="I3" TITLE="winposition"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2038" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2039" REL="I2" TITLE="window sizes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2040" REL="I3" TITLE="changing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2041" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2042" REL="I2" TITLE="window locations"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2043" REL="I3" TITLE="changing"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9158f"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D764D523ceb"></A>Changes the size and position of the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A190C1152"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D764D562ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764D586ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912ade"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912adf"></A><B>void winposition</B>
<B>(Int32 </B><A HREF="winposition.html#A5XQ32e0marj"><I>x1</I></A><B>, Int32</B> <A HREF="winposition.html#kZQ33a0marj"><I>x2</I></A><B>,</B>
<B>Int32</B> <A HREF="winposition.html#A3bQ33a0marj"><I>y1</I></A><B>, Int32</B> <A HREF="winposition.html#EbQ3260marj"><I>y2</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c2f"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c30"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINPOS(</B><I>x1</I><B>, </B><I>x2</I><B>, </B><I>y1</I><B>, </B><I>y2</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>x1</I><B>, </B><I>x2</I><B>, </B><I>y1</I><B>, </B><I>y2</I><B>;</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91595"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D764D700ceb"></A>The <B>winposition </B>subroutine repositions and resizes the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>. The window is positioned at the new location as soon as the system receives the <B>winposition</B> subroutine call; the reposition is not deferred to a later time. If no window is open, this subroutine has no effect.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764D726ceb"></A>The <B>winposition</B> subroutine removes the current size constraint. After the <B>winposition</B> subroutine has been started, the user can interactively change the position and size of the window.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764D751ceb"></A>The <B>winposition</B> subroutine does not remove the other window constraints, such as the minimum and maximum size constraints, the aspect ratio, or the stepunit.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764D777ceb"></A>To keep the window size constrained, use the <B>prefposition</B> or the <B>prefsize</B> subroutines to move and resize a window.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f43"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X91597"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A5XQ32e0marj"></A><I>x1</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the<I> x</I>-pixel screen coordinate of the first corner of the new location for the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>. The first corner is diagonally opposite the second corner.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="kZQ33a0marj"></A><I>x2</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>x</I><B>-</B>pixel screen coordinate of the second corner of the new location for the current window. The second corner is diagonally opposite the first corner.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A3bQ33a0marj"></A><I>y1</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I>-pixel screen coordinate of the first corner of the new location for the current window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="EbQ3260marj"></A><I>y2</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the <I>y</I>-pixel screen coordinate of the second corner of the new location for the current window.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159e0"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D764D945ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A190C1155"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A190C1156"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A190C1157"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X915ad"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D764E041ceb"></A>Constraining the window position and size with the <A HREF="prefposition.html#A142X9164f"><B>prefposition</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764E067ceb"></A>Constraining the window size with the <A HREF="prefsize.html#A142X91671"><B>prefsize</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764E095ceb"></A>Moving the current window by its lower-left corner with the <A HREF="winmove.html#A142X91527"><B>winmove</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764E121ceb"></A>Raising the current window on top of all other windows with the <A HREF="winpop.html#A142X9156b"><B>winpop</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764E146ceb"></A>Lowering the current window beneath all other windows with the <A HREF="winpush.html#A4X13320marj"><B>winpush</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D764E172ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A4X13320marj"></A>winpush Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2044" REL="I1" TITLE="winpush subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2045" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2046" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2047" REL="I3" TITLE="winpush"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2048" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2049" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2050" REL="I3" TITLE="lowering to bottom"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912ae7"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D765B989ceb"></A>Lowers the current window beneath all other windows.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A190C1158"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D765C028ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D765C052ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912aea"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912aeb"></A><B>void winpush(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c31"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c32"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINPUSH</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912aee"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D765C161ceb"></A>The <B>winpush </B>subroutine lowers the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A> from anywhere in the stack of windows to the bottom position. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f46"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A61C0159e2"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D765C224ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A190C115c"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A190C115d"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A190C115e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912af6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D765C320ceb"></A>Raising the current window on top of all other windows with the <A HREF="winpop.html#A142X9156b"><B>winpop</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D765C347ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="NY1320marj"></A>winset Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2051" REL="I1" TITLE="winset subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2052" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2053" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2054" REL="I3" TITLE="winset"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2055" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2056" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2057" REL="I3" TITLE="setting current"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b04"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D766A792ceb"></A>Sets the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1369"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D766A831ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766A856ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b07"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b08"></A><B>void winset(Int32 </B><A HREF="winset.html#pqQ3260marj"><I>windowid</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A18C0dcfc"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A18C0dcfd"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINSET(</B><I>windowid</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>windowid</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b0b"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D766A967ceb"></A>The <B>winset </B>subroutine takes the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A> associated with the <A HREF="winset.html#pqQ3260marj"><I>windowid</I></A> parameter and makes it the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766A993ceb"></A>All drawing (lines, polygons, and NURBS) is done in the current window. Lighting, depth-cueing, and z-buffering all apply to the current window. Every window has an independent set of stacks: matrix stack, name stack, attribute stack, and viewport stack, and all stack manipulation routines such as matrix multiplies are directed at the current window. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766B019ceb"></A>The only attributes that are shared across windows are those defined with the <A HREF="defcursor.html#A150X9444"><B>defcursor</B></A>, <A HREF="deflinestyle.html#A143X9b1f"><B>deflinestyle</B></A>, <A HREF="defpattern.html#A143X9b41"><B>defpattern</B></A>, <A HREF="defrasterfont.html#A143X9d3f"><B>defrasterfont</B></A>, <A HREF="lmdef.html#rgZ2250marj"><B>lmdef</B></A>, <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A>, and <A HREF="makeobj.html#A142X912d"><B>makeobj</B></A> subroutines. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766B045ceb"></A>The <B>winset </B>subroutine is the only subroutine that switches graphics servers.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766B070ceb"></A>The <B>winset</B> subroutine does <I>not</I> raise the indicated window to the top position. Use the <A HREF="winpop.html#A142X9156b"><B>winpop</B></A> subroutine to raise a window to the top.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f49"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X912b10"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="pqQ3260marj"></A><I>windowid</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies which window to set as current. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159e4"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D766B169ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C136c"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C136d"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C136e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912b16"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D766B267ceb"></A>Returning the identifier of the current window with the <A HREF="winget.html#A142X91505"><B>winget</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766B292ceb"></A>Creating a new window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D766B318ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X915f3"></A>wintitle Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2058" REL="I1" TITLE="wintitle subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2059" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2060" REL="I2" TITLE="window"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2061" REL="I3" TITLE="wintitle"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2062" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2063" REL="I2" TITLE="windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2064" REL="I3" TITLE="adding title bar"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X915f5"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7678982ceb"></A>Adds a title bar to the current window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C136f"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7679021ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7679045ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X915f9"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X912b20"></A><B>void wintitle(Char8 *</B><A HREF="wintitle.html#A4DR3180marj"><I>name</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010c35"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010c36"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WINTIT(</B><A HREF="wintitle.html#A4DR3180marj"><I>name</I></A><B>,</B> <A HREF="wintitle.html#UDR3260marj"><I>length</I></A><B>)</B>
<B>CHARACTER*(*) </B><I>name</I>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>length</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X915fb"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7679157ceb"></A>The <B>wintitle </B>subroutine adds a title to the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A60P0189">current window</A>. Use <SAMP>wintitle("")</SAMP> to clear the title. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A318C9f4f"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X915fd"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A4DR3180marj"></A><I>name</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies title to display in the title bar of the current window.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="UDR3260marj"></A><I>length</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of characters in the name string.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159e8"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7679274ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1372"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1373"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1374"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X91613"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7679371ceb"></A>Specifying the title of a window icon with the <A HREF="icontitle.html#sH13240marj"><B>icontitle</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7679397ceb"></A>Creating a window with the <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7679422ceb"></A>Creating and Managing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/managewinds.html#managewinds.html">Windows</A>.</P><hr><center>

</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>

<a href="wmpack.html">Next</a>  |
<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A114C163"></A>winX Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2065" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2066" REL="I2" TITLE="Windows"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2067" REL="I3" TITLE="winX"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2068" REL="I1" TITLE="winX subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A114C164"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7688364ceb"></A>Converts an Enhanced X-Windows window into a GL window.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A114C166"></A>Library</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7688403ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7688427ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A114C169"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A114C16a"></A><B>short winX (Display</B> <B>*</B><A HREF="winX.html#A1lk340nita"><I>dpy</I></A><B>, Window </B><A HREF="winX.html#Qlk20nita"><I>xid</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A114C16b"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A114C16c"></A><B>INTEGER *2 FUNCTION WINX(</B><I>dpy</I>, <I>xid</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER *4 </B><I>dpy</I><B>,</B> <I>xid</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A114C16d"></A>Description</H3>

<P><A NAME="E1D7688567ceb"></A>The <B>winX</B> subroutine converts the specified Enhanced X-Windows 
window into a GL 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A13791dc4">window</A>. 
The Enhanced X-Windows window must be created with the <B>XCreateWindow</B> subroutine from 
the Enhanced X-Windows library. The Enhanced X-Windows window can be mapped before or after 
conversion to a GL window, and can subsequently be unmapped or remapped.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7688592ceb"></A>Not all possible combinations of GL and Enhanced X-Windows calls result in defined behavior, however. In particular, avoid the following usages:</P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A114C172"></A>Do not use Enhanced X-Windows drawing routines to draw into a GL window. The screen results are undefined. Use Enhanced X-Windows drawing routines to draw into Enhanced X-Windows only.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A140C15f7"></A>Use only the GL <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A> subroutine to load X fonts for use with the GL <A HREF="charstr.html#A143X9cfb"><B>charstr</B></A> subroutine. Use the <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="../x11tr/pdf/XLoadFont.pdf.html"><B>XLoadFont</B></A> or <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="../x11tr/pdf/XLoadFont.pdf.html"><B>XLoadQueryFont</B></A> subroutine only if you plan to use X text-rendering routines to draw into an Enhanced X-Windows window.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A114C175"></A>Do not change, modify, or delete GL internal properties associated with GL windows. Doing so causes unpredictable behavior.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A114C176"></A>Do not grab or ungrab pointers, keyboards, or the server while in GL fullscreen mode. Doing so causes unpredictable behavior.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A140C15f8"></A>Events associated with GL windows can be obtained through the Enhanced X-Windows 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0484">event queue</A>. 
However, if you choose to obtain events in this manner, do not also use the GL event queue. Doing so 
causes unpredictable results. An application can use both the GL and Enhanced X-Windows event queues 
within the same executable if the GL queue is used only for GL events and the Enhanced X-Windows event 
queue is used only for Enhanced X-Windows events.</LI></UL>


<P><A NAME="E1D7688741ceb"></A>The previous brief restrictions are explained more fully in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/exhwindcalls.html#exhwindcalls.html">"Using Enhanced X-Windows Calls with GL Subroutines"</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7688767ceb"></A>To use the <B>winX</B> subroutine correctly, the Enhanced X-Windows window must have been created with the <B>XCreateWindow</B> subroutine. The following conditions must also be met within the <B>XCreateWindow</B> attributes:</P>

<UL><LI><A NAME="A161C129f"></A>The visual specified with this subroutine <I>must</I> be the largest available PseudoColor visual. Failure to use the largest possible PseudoColor visual results in unpredictable behavior.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A161C12a0"></A>The window depth must match the depth of the visual. If it does not, a BadMatch event error is generated.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A161C12a1"></A>The window attributes must include a color map that was created with this large visual. Specifying a color map of the wrong size causes a BadMatch event error to be generated. Failure to specify a color map that has been created with the large visual results in unpredictable behavior.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A161C12a2"></A>Do not use the default attributes for the border_pixel and the back_pixel attributes, because the default CopyFromParent does not have the correct visual for the border and background pixel maps. Using the incorrect border and back attributes generates a BadMatch event error. It is acceptable to specify <SAMP>None</SAMP> for these attributes. Please refer to example programs in the <B>/usr/lpp/GL/examples</B> directory for usage.</LI></UL>


<P><A NAME="E1D7688874ceb"></A>If only the Enhanced X-Windows ID of a GL window is needed, use the <A HREF="getXdpy.html#A114C13c"><B>getXdpy</B></A> and <A HREF="getXdpy.html#A114C13c"><B>getXwid</B></A> subroutines.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7688920ceb"></A>A window <I>must</I> be converted to a DirectAccess window (with either the <B>winX</B> or <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine) before any GL drawing can occur in it. DirectAccess allows the GL drawing library to write rendering commands directly, without intervening layers, to the MicroChannel address space of the graphics adapter. Thus, a Direct Access client <I>must</I> execute locally; that is, a GL program must execute on the machine containing the display adapter. Currently, a GL program cannot be operated over a network.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A144C1ca4"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A1lk340nita"></A><I>dpy</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the Enhanced X-Windows connection (as returned by the <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="http://inetsd01.boulder.ibm.com/x11tr/pdf/XOpDsply.pdf"><B>XOpenDisplay</B></A> subroutine).</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Qlk20nita"></A><I>xid</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the Enhanced X-Windows window ID (as returned by the <B>XCreateWindow</B> subroutine) of the window to be converted into a GL window.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="BD9BBA8672vbia"></A>Return Value</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7689021ceb"></A>The GL window identifier.</P>

<H3><A NAME="BD9BBA9317vbia"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7689063ceb"></A>An example program showing the usage of the <B>winX</B> subroutine can be found in the <B>/usr/lpp/GL/examples</B> directory.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A114C181"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7689106ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFD813317janb"></A>Because the windowing design on the GXT1000 has changed from that supported on previous graphics adapters, the rules for using <B>winX</B> have changed. The <B>gconfig</B> subroutine cannot be used to change the mode (color index mode to RGB mode) of a window created with <B>winX</B> on the GXT1000. The X11 window must be created in advance with the appropriate visual type that is desired by the application. Choose a PseudoColor visual if color-index mode GL rendering is desired; choose a DirectColor visual if RGB mode operation is desired.</P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFD813358janb"></A>The GLC_CREATE_OVERLAY token on the <B>glcompat</B> subroutine modifies the operation of the <B>winX</B> routine. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A114C183"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A114C184"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A114C185"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A140C15f9"></A><B>/usr/include/X11/Xlib.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for version X11 of Enhanced X-Windows.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A114C18a"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7689223ceb"></A>The <A HREF="charstr.html#A143X9cfb"><B>charstr</B></A> subroutine, <A HREF="getXdpy.html#A114C13c"><B>getXdpy</B></A> subroutine, <A HREF="getXdpy.html#A114C13c"><B>getXwid</B></A> subroutine, <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A> subroutine, <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7689268ceb"></A>The <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="http://inetsd01.boulder.ibm.com/x11tr/pdf/XOpDsply.pdf"><B>XOpenDisplay</B></A> subroutine, <B>XCreateWindow</B> subroutine, <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="../x11tr/pdf/XLoadFont.pdf.html"><B>XLoadFont</B></A> subroutine, <!--:libs:x11tr:--><A HREF="../x11tr/pdf/XLoadFont.pdf.html"><B>XLoadQueryFont</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7689297ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/exhwindcalls.html#exhwindcalls.html">Using Enhanced X-Windows Calls with GL Subroutines</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I>.</P><hr><center>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>

 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X9570"></A>wmpack Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2069" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2070" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer update control"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2071" REL="I3" TITLE="wmpack"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2072" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2073" REL="I2" TITLE="writemask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2074" REL="I3" TITLE="RGBA"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2075" REL="I1" TITLE="wmpack subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9572"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7697490ceb"></A>Specifies RGBA writemask with a single packed integer.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1204"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7697530ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7697554ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9576"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9577"></A><B>void wmpack(Uint32 </B><A HREF="wmpack.html#A143X957b"><I>pack</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C010779"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01077a"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WMPACK(</B><I>pack</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>pack</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9578"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7697666ceb"></A>The <B>wmpack </B>subroutine changes the current 
RGBA writemask. Bytes 0, 1, 2, and 3 are alpha, blue, green, and red, respectively (red is the least significant byte in the packed integer, then green, blue, and alpha). Components must range from 0 through 255.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7697688ceb"></A>For example,</P>
<PRE><A NAME="A54C014a0a"></A>wmpack(0xFF004080); </PRE>

<P><A NAME="E1D7697730ceb"></A>sets red mask to 0x80, green mask to 0x40, blue mask to 0, and alpha mask to 0xFF.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A213X9122b5"></A><B>Note: </B>You can load alpha values only if the graphics adapter has alpha bitplanes.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<P><A NAME="E1D7697775ceb"></A>You can also use the <B>wmpack</B> subroutine in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e3">color map mode</A> to specify 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A3C0F2A4599mhay">writemasks</A> of more than 12 bits. This is useful for certain 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A154P1160a">z-buffer</A> and 
smoothline
 applications.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X957a"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X957b"></A><I>pack</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies a packed integer containing the 
RGBA writemask.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165d7"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7697854ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7697880ceb"></A>The POWER GXT1000 adapter supports only on/off control of individual R, G, and B bitplanes. Individual bits cannot be masked in the color planes.</P>


<H3><A NAME="A78C1207"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1208"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1209"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9590"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7697979ceb"></A>Returning the current writemask with the <A HREF="getwritemask.html#A143X94c6"><B>getwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7698005ceb"></A>Returning the current RGB writemask with the <A HREF="gRGBmask.html#A143X94e8"><B>gRGBmask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7698030ceb"></A>Granting write access to a subset of available bitplanes with the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7698056ceb"></A>Granting write permission to a subset of available bitplanes with the <A HREF="writemask.html#A143X9592"><B>writemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7698083ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, Removing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/remhidden.html#remhidden.html">Hidden Surfaces</A>, and Smoothing Jagged Lines with <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/smjaglines.html#smjaglines.html">Antialiasing</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7698109ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operations</A>
 and Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

        w->orientation=op->opts[0];
        break;
      default:
        w->orientation=op->opts[
                        (int)(ranf()*(float)op->nopts)];
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD6517ttay"></A>      x+=xinc[w->orientation];
      y+=yinc[w->orientation];
      if (!Wrap||x!=last||y!=bottom) {
        pushmatrix();
        translate((float)x,(float)y,0.0);
        if(bigblox)
          scale(2.0,2.0,1.0);
        putsegment(flavor[n%6],segobj[n%6]);
        popmatrix();
      }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD6676ttay"></A>      ref[w->ypos[h]=y][w->xpos[h]=x]++;
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD6819ttay"></A>  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD6961ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD7109ttay"></A>checkmouse()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD7266ttay"></A>  short dev, val;
  static int upcount;    </PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD7588ttay"></A>  if(upcount++ != 20)
    return;
  if(slowmode)
    sleep(2);
  upcount = 0;
  gsync();
  while(qtest()) {
    dev = qread(&amp;val);
    switch(dev) {
    case RIGHTMOUSE: 
      m1 = val;
      coffset++;
      break;
    case MIDDLEMOUSE: 
      m2 = val;
      if(val)
        slowmode = 1-slowmode;
      break;
    case LEFTMOUSE: 
      m3 = val;
      if(val)
        bigblox = 1-bigblox;
      break;
    case REDRAW:
      reshapeviewport();
      makeframe();
      break;
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD7749ttay"></A>    if(m1 &amp;&amp; m3) {
      color(0);
      clear();
    }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD7892ttay"></A>  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8034ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8197ttay"></A>float ranf() {
  return ((rand()>>1) % 10000)/10000.0;
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8355ttay"></A>putfield()
{
  color(3);
  callobj(SEG0);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8527ttay"></A>putsegment(col,obj)
int col;
int obj;
{
  color((col+coffset)%8);
  callobj(obj);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8682ttay"></A>puttrail()
{
  callobj(TRAIL_OBJ);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD8956ttay"></A>makeobjects()
{
  makeobj(SEG0);
  rectf(-INCREMENT/3.0, -INCREMENT/3.0, INCREMENT/3.0, 
      INCREMENT/3.0);
  closeobj();    
  makeobj(SEG1);
  rectf(-INCREMENT/3.0, -INCREMENT/3.0, INCREMENT/3.0, 
      INCREMENT/3.0);
  closeobj();    
  makeobj(TRAIL_OBJ);
  color(7);
  rectf(-INCREMENT/3.0, -INCREMENT/3.0, INCREMENT/3.0, 
      INCREMENT/3.0);
  closeobj();
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBD9136ttay"></A>makeframe()
{
  color(0);
  clear();
  ortho2(-1.5,CO+0.5,-1.5,LI+0.5);
  color(7);
  recti(-1,-1,CO,LI);
}</PRE>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X9592"></A>writemask Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2076" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2077" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer update control"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2078" REL="I3" TITLE="writemask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2079" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2080" REL="I2" TITLE="bitplanes"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2081" REL="I3" TITLE="granting write permission to in color map mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2082" REL="I1" TITLE="writemask subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A143X9594"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA053ceb"></A>Grants write permission to available bitplanes.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C120b"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA093ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA117ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9598"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X9599"></A><B>void writemask(Colorindex </B><A HREF="writemask.html#A143X959d"><I>writem</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C01077b"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01077c"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WRITEM(</B><I>writem</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>writem</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X959a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA230ceb"></A>The <B>writemask</B> subroutine sets the bitplane writemask in color map mode. Writemasks are used to shield portions of the frame buffer from being written into. A writemask is a small set of bits (8 bits or 12 bits, depending on the frame buffer configuration), one bit for each bitplane of the frame buffer. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA256ceb"></A>If a bit is set (1), the corresponding bitplane is enabled for writing, and any routine that draws into the frame buffer will be able to write into that bitplane. If a bit is reset (0), the corresponding bitplane is marked as read only, and the values stored in that bitplane are not changed.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA282ceb"></A>Note that the writemask protects planes in the color frame buffer. Thus, writemasks essentially prevent certain colors from being written into the frame buffer. Colors that are drawn while a writemask is enabled appear different, depending on the color, the writemask, and the color value currently stored in the frame buffer (at a given pixel).</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA307ceb"></A>Writemasks are useful for emulating overlay/underlay planes.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A213X9122c2"></A><B>Note: </B>This subroutine is intended for use only in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e3">color map mode</A>. To set the writemask in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0743">RGB mode</A>, use the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X959c"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X959d"></A><I>writem</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the mask that controls which bitplanes are available for drawing and which are read only. The mask contains one bit per available bitplane. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A30C01100c"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA403ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="vlsi_c.html#A16C0c9fd"><B>vlsi.c</B></A> uses the <B>writemask</B> subroutine to draw a rectangle in one of four colors by enabling writing into only one of four bitplanes. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA429ceb"></A>The example C language program <A HREF="circuit_c.html#Ua32d0nita"><B>circuit.c</B></A> uses the <B>writemask</B> subroutine to draw power circuitry into several bitplanes.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165da"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA472ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C120f"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1210"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1211"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X95b2"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76AA569ceb"></A>Specifying the target frame buffer for drawing subroutines with the <A HREF="drawmode.html#A143X9460"><B>drawmode</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA595ceb"></A>Returning the current writemask with the <A HREF="getwritemask.html#A143X94c6"><B>getwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA620ceb"></A>Granting write access to a subset of available bitplanes with the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA646ceb"></A>Specifying the RGBA writemask with a single packed integer with the <A HREF="wmpack.html#A143X9570"><B>wmpack</B></A> subroutine. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA671ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76AA697ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operations</A>, and Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X9e62"></A>writepixels Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2083" REL="I1" TITLE="writepixels subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2084" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2085" REL="I2" TITLE="pixel block transfer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2086" REL="I3" TITLE="painting pixel row on screen in color map mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2087" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2088" REL="I2" TITLE="pixel block transfer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2089" REL="I3" TITLE="writepixels"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9e64"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76B9133ceb"></A>Paints a row of pixels on the screen in color map mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1fc"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76B9173ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9197ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9e66"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A142X9e67"></A><B>void writepixels(Int16 </B><A HREF="writepixels.html#A142X9e6d"><I>number</I></A><B>, Colorindex</B> <A HREF="writepixels.html#A142X9e6e"><I>colors</I></A><B>[&nbsp;])</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A27C010423"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A27C010424"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WRITEP(</B><I>number</I><B>, </B><I>colors</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>number</I>
<B>INTEGER*2 </B><I>colors</I><B>(</B><I>number</I><B>)</B></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C1ff"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this subroutine accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when invoked from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when invoked from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A142X9e6a"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76B9330ceb"></A>The <B>writepixels</B> subroutine paints a row of pixels on the screen in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e3">color map mode</A>.The system reads elements from the <A HREF="writepixels.html#A142X9e6e"><I>colors</I></A> array and writes a pixel of the appropriate color for each. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9357ceb"></A>The starting location for the row of pixels is the current character position. The system updates the current character position to one pixel to the right of the last painted pixel. The system paints pixels from left to right, and clips to the current
 <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A>. The current character position becomes undefined if the new position is outside the
  <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9383ceb"></A>The <B>writepixels</B> subroutine does not automatically wrap from one line to the next. It can be used in both 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P01c">single</A> and 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0474">double buffer modes</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9409ceb"></A>The <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>rectwrite</B></A> subroutine provides significantly better performance for pixel block transfers. Even when only one row of pixels needs to be read, use the <B>rectwrite</B> subroutine. </P>

<OL><LI><A NAME="A318C9dd1"></A>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A213X9120c7"></A>The use of this subroutine is deprecated. Do not use the <B>writepixels </B>subroutine in new development.</LI></OL>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9e6c"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A142X9e6d"></A><I>number</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of pixels to paint.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A142X9e6e"></A><I>colors</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array of color indexes.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A61C0159c9"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76B9561ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1100"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1101"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C1102"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A142X9e82"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76B9657ceb"></A>Returning the value of specific pixels in color map mode with the <A HREF="readpixels.html#A142X91059"><B>readpixels</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9682ceb"></A>Copying a rectangle of pixels with an optional zoom with the <A HREF="rectcopy.html#A142X9d04"><B>rectcopy</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9708ceb"></A>Reading a rectangular array of pixels into host memory with the <A HREF="rectread.html#A142X9c7c"><B>rectread</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9733ceb"></A>Drawing a rectangular array of pixels into the frame buffer with the <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>rectwrite</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9759ceb"></A>Painting a row of pixels on the screen in RGB mode with the <A HREF="writeRGB.html#A142X9ff2"><B>writeRGB</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76B9785ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/animatescene.html#animatescene.html">Creating Animated Scenes</A>, Reading and Writing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/rwpixels.html#rwpixels.html">Pixels</A>, Using <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/useviewprts.html#useviewprts.html">Viewports and Screenmasks</A>, and Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A142X9ff2"></A>writeRGB Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2090" REL="I1" TITLE="writeRGB subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2091" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2092" REL="I2" TITLE="pixel block transfer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2093" REL="I3" TITLE="painting pixel row on screen in RGB mode"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2094" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2095" REL="I2" TITLE="pixel block transfer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2096" REL="I3" TITLE="writeRGB"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9120d2"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76CA100ceb"></A>Paints a row of pixels on the screen in RGB mode.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C1108"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76CA139ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA163ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9120d5"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X9120d6"></A><B>void writeRGB</B>
<B>(Int16 </B><A HREF="writeRGB.html#A7QR2350marj"><I>number</I></A><B>, </B>
<B>RGBvalue</B> <A HREF="writeRGB.html#QQR270marj"><I>red</I></A><B>[&nbsp;], RGBvalue </B><A HREF="writeRGB.html#bQR2d0marj"><I>green</I></A><B>[&nbsp;], RGBvalue</B> <A HREF="writeRGB.html#A2RR2110marj"><I>blue</I></A><B>[&nbsp;])</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010b3f"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010b40"></A><B>SUBROUTINE WRITER(</B><I>number</I><B>,</B><I> red</I><B>,</B><I> green</I><B>,</B><I> blue</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>number</I>
<B>CHARACTER*(*) </B><I>red</I><B>,</B><I> green</I><B>,</B><I> blue</I></PRE>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A79C110b"></A><B>Note: </B>For FORTRAN users, this subroutine accepts long integer parameters (INTEGER*4) when invoked from a FORTRAN program, although it accepts short integers when invoked from a C program. The C and FORTRAN syntax shown here reflect this difference.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X9120d9"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76CA297ceb"></A>The <B>writeRGB</B> subroutine paints a row of pixels on the screen in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0743">RGB mode</A>.The system reads elements from the arrays specified in the <A HREF="writeRGB.html#QQR270marj"><I>red</I></A>, <A HREF="writeRGB.html#bQR2d0marj"><I>green</I></A>, and <A HREF="writeRGB.html#A2RR2110marj"><I>blue</I></A> parameters and writes a pixel of the appropriate color for each.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA323ceb"></A>The starting location for the row of pixels is the current character position. The system updates the current character position to one pixel to the right of the last painted pixel. The system paints pixels from left to right and clips to the current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P018">screenmask</A>. The current character position becomes undefined if the new position is outside the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA349ceb"></A>The <B>writeRGB</B> subroutine does not automatically wrap from one line to the next. It supplies a 24-bit RGB value (8 bits for each color) for each pixel. This value is written directly into the bitplanes.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A336C95bd8"></A><B>Note: </B>When there are only 12 color bitplanes available, the lower 4 bits of each color are ignored.</BLOCKQUOTE>


<P><A NAME="E1D76CA394ceb"></A>The <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>rectwrite</B></A> subroutine provides significantly better performance for pixel block transfers. Even when only one row of pixels needs to be read, use the <B>rectwrite</B> subroutine. </P>

<OL><LI><A NAME="A336C95bd4"></A>This subroutine is available only in 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0743">RGB mode</A>.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A336C95bd5"></A>This subroutine cannot be used to add to a 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0473">display list</A>.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A81C12b"></A>The use of this subroutine is deprecated. Do not use the <B>writeRGB </B>subroutine in new development.</LI></OL>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9120de"></A>Parameters</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A7QR2350marj"></A><I>number</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies the number of pixels to paint.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="QQR270marj"></A><I>red</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing red values for each pixel to paint.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="bQR2d0marj"></A><I>green</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing green values for pixel to paint.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A2RR2110marj"></A><I>blue</I></TD>
<TD>  Specifies an array containing blue values for each pixel to paint.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A336C95bd7"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76CA606ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C110c"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C110d"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C110e"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X9120ea"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76CA703ceb"></A>Returning the value of specific pixels in RGB mode with the <A HREF="readRGB.html#A142X9107b"><B>readRGB</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA729ceb"></A>Copying a rectangle of pixels with an optional zoom with the <A HREF="rectcopy.html#A142X9d04"><B>rectcopy</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA754ceb"></A>Reading a rectangular array of pixels into host memory with the <A HREF="rectread.html#A142X9c7c"><B>rectread</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA779ceb"></A>Drawing a rectangular array of pixels into the frame buffer with the <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>rectwrite</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA805ceb"></A>Painting a row of pixels on the screen in color map mode with the <A HREF="writepixels.html#A142X9e62"><B>writepixels</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76CA831ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, Reading and Writing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/rwpixels.html#rwpixels.html">Pixels</A>, 
Using <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/useviewprts.html#useviewprts.html">Viewports and Screenmasks</A>, 
and Working in <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/workcolor.html#workcolor.html">Color Map and RGB Modes</A>.</P><hr><center>

<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="Up45120nita"></A>xfonts.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2508" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2509" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2510" REL="I3" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2511" REL="I1" TITLE="xfonts.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2512" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2513" REL="I2" TITLE="text"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2514" REL="I3" TITLE="Enhanced X-Windows fonts"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2515" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2516" REL="I2" TITLE="fonts"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2517" REL="I3" TITLE="Windows"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC1882ttay"></A>/*
xfonts.c</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC2053ttay"></A>This program demonstrates how to use Enhanced X-Windows
fonts in a
GL application
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC2217ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;X11/Xlib.h>
#include &lt;stdio.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC2467ttay"></A>main()
{
  Int32 wid;                   /* the GL window ID */
  Display *dpy;                /* structure describing X session*/
  int num_fonts;               /* number of fonts X server found */
  char **fontlist;             /* array of strings
                                  (available font names) */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC2637ttay"></A>  prefsize (150,150);
  wid = winopen ("xfonts");
  color (BLACK);
  clear();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC2818ttay"></A>  /* get the connection to X */
  /* Normally, the default display is unix:0 */
  dpy = XOpenDisplay ("unix:0");</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3020ttay"></A>   /* Get the names of all fonts that might be Helvetica fonts */
   /* (have "helv" appearing in their font name) */
  fontlist = XListFonts (dpy, "*helv*", 1000, &amp;num_fonts);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3230ttay"></A>   /* other useful X font subroutines are:
    * XListFonts
    * XListFontsWithInfo
    * XFreeFontNames
    * XFreeFontInfo
    * XSetFontPath
    * XGetFontPath
    * XFreeFontPath
    */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3435ttay"></A>  /* We have decided, by some criteria, to use the fifth
   * available Helvetica font (assuming that at least five
   * Helvetica fonts are found). We will give it an id of 433.
   */</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3614ttay"></A>  if ( num_fonts &lt; 4 ) {
    fprintf (stderr,"Not enough fonts found!!!\n");
    exit (-1);
  }</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3766ttay"></A>  loadXfont (433, fontlist[4]);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC3932ttay"></A>   /* get rid of the font name list */
  XFreeFontNames (fontlist);</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC4130ttay"></A>   /* we want to use this font to draw a string */
  font (433);   /* do it */
  cmov2 (43.0, 56.0);
  color (RED);
  charstr ("Hello, World");   
  sleep (5);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EAC4302ttay"></A>/*
  Changes: 
     -  from wid = winopen "xfonts"); to wid = winopen ("xfonts");
*/</PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A201C117f"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D792B137ceb"></A>The <A HREF="loadXfont.html#vUO390nita"><B>loadXfont</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="vUO390nita" REL="PAGENUM"></A> loads an Enhanced X-Windows font into the font table.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D792B164ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/textchars.html#Qi62180nita">Fonts</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I> describes font assignment in GL, and discusses relevant subroutines.</P>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X97b1"></A>zbuffer Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2097" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2098" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer configuration"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2099" REL="I3" TITLE="zbuffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2100" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2101" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2102" REL="I3" TITLE="zbuffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2103" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2104" REL="I2" TITLE="z buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2105" REL="I3" TITLE="enabling or disabling"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2106" REL="I1" TITLE="zbuffer subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97b3"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9024ceb"></A>Enables or disables the z-buffer for storing depth information.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C122d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9064ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9088ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97b7"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X97b8"></A><B>void zbuffer(Int32 </B><A HREF="zbuffer.html#A143X97bc"><I>bool</I></A><B>&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C010786"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C010787"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZBUFFE(</B><I>bool</I><B>)</B>
<B>LOGICAL </B><I>bool</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97b9"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9200ceb"></A>The <B>zbuffer</B> subroutine enables or disables the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A154P1160a">z-buffer</A> for storing depth information. Each pixel has an associated <I>z</I> value. To draw a pixel, the system compares the new <I>z</I> value with the existing one. If the new value is less than or equal to the existing value, the <B>zbuffer</B> subroutine stores a new color and <I>z</I> value in the bitplanes.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9228ceb"></A>Drawing to the z-buffer with the <A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X97f5"><B>zdraw</B></A> subroutine must be disabled in order for the z-buffer to be enabled.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97bb"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X97bc"></A><I>bool</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies a value for the state of drawing to the z-buffer. The settings for the <I>bool</I> parameter are:</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A258C01c527"></A></TD>
<TD>  True = drawing to the 
z-buffer
 is enabled.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A258C01c528"></A></TD>
<TD>  False = drawing to the z-buffer is disabled.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97c1"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9350ceb"></A>The example C language programs <A HREF="zbuffer1_c.html#A16C0ca2c"><B>zbuffer1.c</B></A> and <A HREF="zbuffer2_c.html#MYO10nita"><B>zbuffer2.c</B></A> enable z-buffering with the <B>zbuffer</B> subroutine to disable the display of hidden surfaces.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165e2"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9394ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9420ceb"></A>The POWER Gt4,
and 
POWER Gt4x, and POWER GXT1000
 adapters do not support hidden-line and hidden-surface removal when rendering into the overlay planes. The z-buffer is automatically disabled when drawmode (OVERDRAW) is specified. The z-buffer is automatically enabled when drawmode (NORMALDRAW) is specified.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1231"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1232"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1233"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97d1"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76D9520ceb"></A>Determining whether z-buffering is on or off with the <A HREF="getzbuffer.html#A9SR350marj"><B>getzbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9546ceb"></A>Setting a depth range with the <A HREF="lsetdepth.html#naR120marj"><B>lsetdepth</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9574ceb"></A>Clearing the z-buffer with the <A HREF="zclear.html#A143X97d3"><B>zclear</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9603ceb"></A>Enabling drawing to the z-buffer with the <A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X97f5"><B>zdraw</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9628ceb"></A>Specifying the function used for depth comparison with the <A HREF="zfunction.html#A22f0MARJ"><B>zfunction</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9654ceb"></A>Selecting depth or color as the source for <I>z</I> comparisons with the <A HREF="zsource.html#A143X96d6"><B>zsource</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9682ceb"></A>Specifying which bits of the z-buffer are written during normal z-buffer operation with the <A HREF="zwritemask.html#A143X9817"><B>zwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76D9708ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring the Frame Buffer</A>, and Removing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/remhidden.html#remhidden.html">Hidden Surfaces</A>.</P><hr><center>
[  <a href="writeRGB.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="zclear.html">Next</a>  |

 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
</center></BODY>

</HTML>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A16C0ca2c"></A>zbuffer1.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2518" REL="I1" TITLE="zbuffer1.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2519" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2520" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2521" REL="I3" TITLE="frame buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2522" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2523" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2524" REL="I3" TITLE="example program"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE3145ttay"></A>/*
zbuffer1.c:</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE3309ttay"></A>A zbuffer() demo program that draws two intersecting planes.</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE3467ttay"></A>This program requires the z-buffer option.
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE3624ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE3840ttay"></A>main()
{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Device dev;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;short val;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;initialize();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;while (TRUE)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (qtest())
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dev = qread(&amp;val);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (dev == ESCKEY)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zbuffer(FALSE);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gexit();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;exit(0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4013ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;else if (dev == REDRAW)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;reshapeviewport();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawpolys();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4159ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4303ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4445ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4593ttay"></A>initialize()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE4746ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int gid;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;float xmax,ymax;   </PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE5015ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;prefposition(XMAXSCREEN/4, XMAXSCREEN*3/4, YMAXSCREEN/4, 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;    YMAXSCREEN*3/4);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gid = winopen("zbuffer1");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;winset(gid);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;winconstraints();   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;perspective(900, 1.34, 1.01, 500.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;lookat(-150.0, 90.0, 250.0, 50.0, 50.0, 0.0, 0);   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;lsetdepth(0xC00000,0x3FFFFF);   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice(ESCKEY);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice(REDRAW);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qenter(REDRAW,gid);   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zbuffer(TRUE);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE5163ttay"></A>drawpolys()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE5413ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zclear();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;color(BLACK);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;clear();   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;color(YELLOW);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pmv(0.0, 0.0, 100.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(100.0, 0.0, 100.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(100.0, 100.0, 100.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(0.0, 100.0, 100.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pclos();   
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;color(RED);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pmv(0.0, 0.0, 50.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(100.0, 0.0, 50.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(100.0, 100.0, 200.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pdr(0.0, 100.0, 200.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pclos();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBE5557ttay"></A>}</PRE>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">

<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="MYO10nita"></A>zbuffer2.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2525" REL="I1" TITLE="zbuffer2.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2526" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2527" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2528" REL="I3" TITLE="frame buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2529" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2530" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2531" REL="I3" TITLE="example program"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBEF837ttay"></A>/* Example: zbuffer2.c */
/*
This program illustrates z buffering. It draws three parallel
pipeds rotating through each other.</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF0003ttay"></A>This program requires a 24-bit adapter and the z buffer option.
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF0160ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/gl.h>
#include &lt;gl/device.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF0396ttay"></A>float v0[3] = {-1.0, -1.0, -1.0} ;
float v1[3] = { -1.0, -1.0, 1.0};
float v2[3] = { -1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
float v3[3] = { -1.0, 1.0, -1.0};
float v4[3] = { 1.0, -1.0, -1.0};
float v5[3] = { 1.0, -1.0, 1.0};
float v6[3] = { 1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
float v7[3] = { 1.0, 1.0, -1.0};</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF0545ttay"></A>Int32 delaycount;</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF1141ttay"></A>main(argc, argv)
int     argc;
char    *argv[];
{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Int32 xrot, yrot, zrot;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xrot = yrot = zrot = 0;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (argc == 1)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delaycount = 0;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;else
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delaycount = 1;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keepaspect(1, 1);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;prefposition (0,800,0,800);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;winopen("zbuffer");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RGBmode();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (delaycount == 0)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;doublebuffer();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gconfig();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ortho(-4.0, 4.0, -4.0, 4.0, -4.0, 4.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;while (1) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(xrot, 'x');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(yrot, 'y');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(zrot, 'z');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xrot += 11;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;yrot += 15;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (xrot + yrot > 3500) zrot += 23;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (xrot > 3600) xrot -= 3600;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (yrot > 3600) yrot -= 3600;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (zrot > 3600) zrot -= 3600;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;clear();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (getbutton(LEFTMOUSE)) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zbuffer(TRUE);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zclear();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;else
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;zbuffer(FALSE);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scale(1.2, 1.2, 1.2);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;translate(.3, .2, .2);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (getbutton(MIDDLEMOUSE)) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;reshapeviewport();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawcube();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(450+zrot, 'x');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(300-xrot, 'y');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scale(1.8, .8, .8);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawcube();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(500+yrot, 'z');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(-zrot, 'x');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;translate(-.3, -.2, .6);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scale(1.4, 1.2, .7);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawcube();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (delaycount == 0)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;swapbuffers();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF1284ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF1438ttay"></A>delay()
{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(delaycount);
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF3031ttay"></A>drawcube()
{
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xff);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v0); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v1); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v2); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v3);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xff00);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v0); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v4); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v5); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v1);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xff0000);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v4); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v7); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v6); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v5);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xffff);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v3); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v7); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v6); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v2);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xff00ff);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v5); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v1); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v2); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v6);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cpack(0xffff00);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bgnpolygon();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v0); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v4); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v7); 
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v3f(v3);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;endpolygon();
}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBF3210ttay"></A>/*
  Changes:
     - Adding reshapeviewport when middlemouse
     - Added a prefposition(0,800,0,800);
*/</PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A201C11b6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7944648ceb"></A>The <A HREF="zbuffer.html#A143X97b1"><B>zbuffer</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X97b1" REL="PAGENUM"></A>, <A HREF="zclear.html#A143X97d3"><B>zclear</B></A> subroutine<A HREF="A143X97d3" REL="PAGENUM"></A>.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7944674ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/Z-Buffering.html">Zbuffering</A> in<I> GL3.2 Version 4 for AIX: Programming Concepts</I> introduces basic concepts about displaying objects closest to the viewer.</P>

<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X97d3"></A>zclear Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2107" REL="I1" TITLE="zclear subroutine (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2108" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2109" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2110" REL="I3" TITLE="zclear"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2111" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2112" REL="I2" TITLE="initializing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2113" REL="I3" TITLE="z buffer"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97d5"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76E9642ceb"></A>Initializes the z-buffer.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11e3"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76E9682ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76E9706ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97d9"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X97da"></A><B>void zclear(&nbsp;)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A29C010bc7"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A29C010bc8"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZCLEAR</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97db"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76E9817ceb"></A>The <B>zclear</B> subroutine loads the z-buffer with the largest possible positive integer. If the default value of the z comparison function is used (set by the <A HREF="zfunction.html#A22f0MARJ"><B>zfunction</B></A> subroutine), the zbuffer, when cleared to the largest possible value, can be used for basic z-buffering.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76E9846ceb"></A>Only the z-buffer behind the area inside the current screenmask is cleared. The screenmask cannot be made larger than the window. Note that by default the screenmask is exactly the same size as the window.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76E9871ceb"></A>The <A HREF="scrmask.html#fwN250marj"><B>scrmsk</B></A> subroutine can be used to change the size of the screenmask. Note also that the <A HREF="viewport.html#qrY270marj"><B>viewport</B></A> subroutine resets the screenmask to be precisely the same size as the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A27P039">viewport</A>.</P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A258C01c837"></A><B>Note: </B>The operation of this subroutine for the Model 730 
Supergraphics Processor is modified. (See 
"<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/powerstation730.html#NITAXIO">Hardware Considerations</A>".)</BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A143X97e3"></A>Example</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76E9932ceb"></A>The example C language programs <A HREF="zbuffer1_c.html#A16C0ca2c"><B>zbuffer1.c</B></A> and <A HREF="zbuffer2_c.html#MYO10nita"><B>zbuffer2.c</B></A> use the <B>zclear</B> subroutine to initialize the z-buffer.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A64C016600"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76E9976ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A79C11e6"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11e7"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A79C11e8"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97f3"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76EA076ceb"></A>Clearing the z-buffer and the color bitplanes simultaneously with the <A HREF="czclear.html#A143X92c8"><B>czclear</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76EA102ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/remhidden.html#remhidden.html">Removing Hidden Surfaces</A>.
</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76EA128ceb"></A>
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/glintro.html#A8G44310marj">Understanding the Hardware</A> 
Used by GL, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/clrrstintgl.html#clrrstintgl.html">Clearing, Resetting, and 
Initializing GL</A>, and <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/configframebuf.html#configframebuf.html">Configuring 
the Frame Buffer</A>.
</P><hr><center>

<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 3.2//EN">
<HTML>
<HEAD>
