<TITLE>zdraw Subroutine
</TITLE>
</HEAD>

<body bgcolor="#fcfbf0">
<center>
[  <a href="zclear.html">Previous</a>  |
<a href="zfunction.html">Next</a>  |
<A href="toc.html" TARGET="_parent">Contents</A>  
 <A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html">| Glossary</A>  
 <A HREF="../topnav/topnav.html" TARGET="_top"></A>  
 <A HREF="/cgi-bin/ds_form?config=/usr/share/man/info/en_US/a_doc_lib/data/base.cfg" TARGET="_top"></A>  ]
<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X97f5"></A>zdraw Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2114" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2115" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer configuration"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2116" REL="I3" TITLE="zdraw"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2117" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2118" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2119" REL="I3" TITLE="zdraw"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2120" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2121" REL="I2" TITLE="z buffer"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2122" REL="I3" TITLE="enabling or disabling drawing into"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2123" REL="I1" TITLE="zdraw subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A143X97f7"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76F8779ceb"></A>Enables or prohibits drawing to the z-buffer.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1234"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76F8818ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76F8842ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97fb"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X97fc"></A><B>void zdraw(Int32 </B><A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X9800"><I>bool</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C01078a"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C01078b"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZDRAW(</B><I>bool</I><B>)</B>
<B>LOGICAL</B> <I>bool</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97fd"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76F8954ceb"></A>The <B>zdraw </B>subroutine allows or prohibits drawing into the 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A154P1160a">z-buffer</A>. The current 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A25P03e3">color mode</A> (either 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A31996bc">color map</A> or 
<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/specialterms.html#A26P0743">RGB</A>) applies. All current drawing attributes apply as well (color or RGBcolor, writemask or RGBwritemask, pattern, linestyle). However, if you enable drawing to the z-buffer with the <B>zdraw </B>subroutine, you must turn z-buffer mode off with the <A HREF="zbuffer.html#A143X97b1"><B>zbuffer</B></A> subroutine. By default, drawing into the z-buffer is prohibited.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76F8979ceb"></A>Calling the <A HREF="gconfig.html#hS4260nita"><B>gconfig</B></A> subroutine disables drawing to the z-buffer.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X97ff"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X9800"></A><I>bool</I></TD>
<TD>  Returns the state of drawing into the z-buffer. The settings for the <I>bool</I> parameter are:</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A109C01a55b"></A></TD>
<TD>  True = drawing into the z-buffer is enabled.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A109C01a55c"></A></TD>
<TD>  False = drawing into the z-buffer is disabled.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165e8"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76F9102ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76F9131ceb"></A>On the 3-D Color Graphics Processor and on the POWER Gt4, POWER Gt4x, and POWERgraphics GTO, and POWER GXT1000 adapters, calling the <B>zdraw</B> subroutine with a value of True affects only the <A HREF="writepixels.html#A142X9e62"><B>writepixels</B></A>, <A HREF="writeRGB.html#A142X9ff2"><B>writeRGB</B></A>, <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>rectwrite</B></A>, <A HREF="rectwrite.html#A142X9c9e"><B>lrectwrite</B></A>, and <A HREF="rectcopy.html#A142X9d04"><B>rectcopy</B></A> pixel writing subroutines. If drawing into the z-buffer is enabled when other drawing subroutines (such as those for polygons or lines) are issued, the drawing subroutines draw as normal into the color bitplanes and write 
depth values
 into the z-buffer. </P>

<P><A NAME="A3CFD8B1351janb"></A>BLITs to and from the z-buffer are currently inoperational on the POWER GXT1000 adapter.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76F9160ceb"></A>On the 3-D Color Graphics Processor, calling the <A HREF="frontbuffer.html#A145X9a0"><B>frontbuffer</B></A> subroutine with a value of True also prohibits drawing to the z-buffer. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1237"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1238"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1239"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9815"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D76F9258ceb"></A>Enabling drawing to the back buffer with the <A HREF="backbuffer.html#A145X94a"><B>backbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D76F9283ceb"></A>Enabling drawing to the front buffer with the <A HREF="frontbuffer.html#A145X9a0"><B>frontbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<hr>
<font color="#a62a2a" size="+2">
<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A22f0MARJ"></A>zfunction Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2124" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2125" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer update control"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2126" REL="I3" TITLE="zfunction"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2127" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2128" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2129" REL="I3" TITLE="zfunction"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2130" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2131" REL="I2" TITLE="depth comparison"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2132" REL="I3" TITLE="specifying function used for"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2133" REL="I1" TITLE="zfunction subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91237b"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7707970ceb"></A>Specifies the function used for depth comparison.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C123d"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7708009ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7708034ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91237e"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X91237f"></A><B>void zfunction(Int32</B> <A HREF="zfunction.html#Bon2370marj"><I>func</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X91235c"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A213X91235f"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZFUNCT(</B><I>func</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>func</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912382"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7708146ceb"></A>The <B>zfunction </B>subroutine compares the <I>z</I> value of the current contents (destination value) of a pixel against the <I>z</I> value for the contents that you want to write to that pixel (source, or incoming, value). </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7708172ceb"></A>For example, if the <I>func</I> parameter is ZF_LESS and if the source <I>z</I> is less than the destination <I>z</I>, the system overwrites the destination pixel value with the source pixel value.  </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><A NAME="A258C01c535"></A><B>Note: </B>The operation of this subroutine for the Supergraphics Processor Subsystem is modified. 
(See "<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/powerstation730.html#NITAXIO">Hardware Considerations</A>".) </BLOCKQUOTE>


<H3><A NAME="A213X912387"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="Bon2370marj"></A><I>func</I></TD>
<TD>  Expects one of eight possible flags used when comparing <I>z</I> values.  The available flags are: 


<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Description</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_NEVER</TD>

<TD>ZFNEVE</TD>

<TD>Never overwrite the destination pixel value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_LESS</TD>

<TD>ZFLESS</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the <I>z</I> of the source pixel value is less than the z of destination value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_EQUAL</TD>

<TD>ZFEQUA</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the <I>z </I>of the source pixel value is equal to the z of destination value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_LEQUAL</TD>

<TD>ZFLEQU</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the z of the source pixel value is less than or equal to the z of destination value.  (This is the default value.)</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_GREATER</TD>

<TD>ZFGREA</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the z of the source pixel value is greater than the z of destination value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_NOTEQUAL</TD>

<TD>ZFNOTE</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the z of the source pixel value is not equal to the z of destination value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_GEQUAL</TD>

<TD>ZFGEQU</TD>

<TD>Overwrite the destination pixel value if the z of the source pixel value is greater than or equal to the z of destination value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZF_ALWAYS</TD>

<TD>ZFALWA</TD>

<TD>Always overwrite the destination pixel value.</TD></TR></TABLE></TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165ea"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7708308ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1240"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1241"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1242"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A213X912394"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7708408ceb"></A>Clearing the color bitplanes and the z-buffer simultaneously with the <A HREF="czclear.html#A143X92c8"><B>czclear</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7708437ceb"></A>Initiating z-buffer mode with the <A HREF="zbuffer.html#A143X97b1"><B>zbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7708462ceb"></A>Selecting depth or color as the source for <B>z</B> comparisons with the <A HREF="zsource.html#A143X96d6"><B>zsource</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/remhidden.html#remhidden.html">Hidden Surfaces</A>.</P><hr><center>

<H2><A NAME="A16C0ca3f"></A>zoing.c Example C Language Program
</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2532" REL="I1" TITLE="zoing.c example program (GL)"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2533" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2534" REL="I2" TITLE="example programs"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2535" REL="I3" TITLE="drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2536" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2537" REL="I2" TITLE="circles"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2538" REL="I3" TITLE="drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2539" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2540" REL="I2" TITLE="spiral"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2541" REL="I3" TITLE="drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2542" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2543" REL="I2" TITLE="drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2544" REL="I3" TITLE="circle"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2545" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2546" REL="I2" TITLE="drawing"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2547" REL="I3" TITLE="spiral"></A>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFE292ttay"></A>/*
zoing.c
Make a spiral out of circles.</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFE443ttay"></A>Paul Haeberli - 1984
*/</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFE600ttay"></A>#include &lt;gl/device.h>
#include &lt;gl/gl.h></PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFE745ttay"></A>main()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFE893ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;short dev,val;    </PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF134ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keepaspect(1,1);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;prefposition(XMAXSCREEN/4,XMAXSCREEN*3/4,YMAXSCREEN/4,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;    YMAXSCREEN*3/4);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;winopen("zoing");
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;qdevice(ESCKEY);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawit();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;while(1) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if((dev = qread(&amp;val)) == REDRAW)
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;drawit();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;else if (dev == ESCKEY) {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gexit();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;exit();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF276ttay"></A>}</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF422ttay"></A>drawit()
{</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF571ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;register int i;    </PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF818ttay"></A>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;reshapeviewport();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;color(7);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;clear();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ortho2(-1.0,1.0,-1.0,1.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;color(0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;translate(-0.1,0.0,0.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for(i=0; i&lt;200; i++)  {
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rotate(170,'z');
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scale(0.96,0.96,0.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pushmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;translate(0.10,0.0,0.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;circ(0.0,0.0,1.0);
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;popmatrix();</PRE>
<PRE><A NAME="A64EBFF961ttay"></A>}</PRE>

<i>GL3.2 for AIX: Graphics Library (GL) Technical Reference</i></font>
</center>
<hr size=3 noshade>
<H2><A NAME="A143X96d6"></A>zsource Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2134" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2135" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer update control"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2136" REL="I3" TITLE="zsource"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2137" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2138" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2139" REL="I3" TITLE="zsource"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2140" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2141" REL="I2" TITLE="z comparisons"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2142" REL="I3" TITLE="specifying depth or color for"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2143" REL="I1" TITLE="zsource subroutine (GL)"></A>
<H3><A NAME="A143X96d8"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7718626ceb"></A>Selects either depth or color as the source for <I>z</I> comparisons.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A74C1ea"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7718665ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7718689ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X96dc"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X96dd"></A><B>void zsource(Int32 </B><A HREF="zsource.html#A143X96e1"><I>source</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C010782"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C010783"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZSOURC(</B><I>source</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>source</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X96de"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7718801ceb"></A>The <B>zsource</B> subroutine selects either depth or color as the source for 
<I>z</I> comparisons
. After a call to the <A HREF="gbegin.html#JS4380nita"><B>gbegin</B></A>, <A HREF="ginit.html#LDg21c0marj"><B>ginit</B></A>, <A HREF="greset.html#xW42e0nita"><B>greset</B></A>, or <A HREF="winopen.html#A142X91549"><B>winopen</B></A> subroutine, the default z-buffering is done with depth (z) values. In certain cases, it is desirable to buffer with respect to color values, especially the color index values generated by the smoothline hardware. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7718827ceb"></A>When the <A HREF="zsource.html#A143X96e1"><I>source</I></A> parameter is ZSRC_DEPTH, the z-buffer operation is normal. When the <I>source</I> parameter is ZSRC_COLOR, however, source and destination color values are compared to determine which pixels the system draws. </P>

<BLOCKQUOTE><B>Notes: </B>
<OL><LI><A NAME="A143X96b1"></A>The Supergraphics Processor and the POWER GXT1000 adapter support only the ZSRC_DEPTH setting. The ZSRC_COLOR setting has no effect and is ignored.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A74C1ed"></A>This subroutine is not supported on the POWER Gt4 and POWER Gt4x adapters. On these adapters, the function provided by this subroutine is superseded by the LO_MIN and LO_MAX values of the <A HREF="logicop.html#iM521a0marj"><B>logicops</B></A> subroutine.</LI>

<LI><A NAME="A3CFD8F1382janb"></A>The POWERgraphics GXT1000 does not support the <B>zsource</B> subroutine.</LI></OL></BLOCKQUOTE>


<P><A NAME="E1D7718910ceb"></A>The <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/figures/gl32p88.jpg">Z-Source Diagram</A> shows the implementation of the z-source function.</P>


<H3><A NAME="A143X96e0"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X96e1"></A><I>source</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies one of two possible flags: 


<TABLE BORDER="2"><TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD><B>C</B></TD>

<TD><B>FORTRAN</B></TD>

<TD><B>Description</B></TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZSRC_COLOR</TD>

<TD>ZSRCCO</TD>

<TD>Buffering done by color value.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP" ALIGN="LEFT"><TD>ZSRC_DEPTH</TD>

<TD>ZSRCDE</TD>

<TD>Buffering done by <I>z</I> value.</TD></TR></TABLE></TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165de"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7719002ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A74C1ee"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A74C1ef"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A74C1f0"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X96f6"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D7719099ceb"></A>Specifying logical, arithmetic, or comparison operations for pixel updates with the <A HREF="logicop.html#iM521a0marj"><B>logicops</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7719127ceb"></A>Initiating z-buffer mode with the <A HREF="zbuffer.html#A143X97b1"><B>zbuffer</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7719156ceb"></A>Enabling or disabling drawing to the z-buffer with the <A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X97f5"><B>zdraw</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D7719182ceb"></A>Specifying the function used for depth comparison with the <A HREF="zfunction.html#A22f0MARJ"><B>zfunction</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<H2><A NAME="A143X9817"></A>zwritemask Subroutine</H2>
<A NAME="INDEX2144" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2145" REL="I2" TITLE="frame buffer update control"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2146" REL="I3" TITLE="zwritemask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2147" REL="I1" TITLE="GL subroutines"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2148" REL="I2" TITLE="hidden surface"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2149" REL="I3" TITLE="zwritemask"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2150" REL="I1" TITLE="GL"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2151" REL="I2" TITLE="z buffer operation"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2152" REL="I3" TITLE="specifying which bits are drawn during"></A>
<A NAME="INDEX2153" REL="I1" TITLE="zwritemask subroutine (GL)"></A>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9819"></A>Purpose</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D772B329ceb"></A>Specifies the z-buffer writemask. </P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1243"></A>Libraries</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D772B369ceb"></A>Graphics Library</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B393ceb"></A>C (<B>libgl.a</B>)</P>

<P>FORTRAN (<B>libfgl.a</B>)</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X981d"></A>C Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A143X981e"></A><B>void zwritemask(Int32 </B><A HREF="zwritemask.html#A143X9822"><I>mask</I></A><B>)</B></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A28C010784"></A>FORTRAN Syntax</H3>
<PRE><A NAME="A28C010785"></A><B>SUBROUTINE ZWRITE(</B><I>mask</I><B>)</B>
<B>INTEGER*4 </B><I>mask</I></PRE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X981f"></A>Description</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D772B505ceb"></A>The <B>zwritemask</B> subroutine specifies a write-enable mask on the z-buffer. If a bit in the mask is set (1), the corresponding bitplane is enabled for reading and writing, and any subroutine that updates the z-buffer can update that bitplane. If a bit in the mask is reset (0), the corresponding bitplane is marked as read-only, and the values stored in that bitplane are not updated.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9821"></A>Parameter</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A143X9822"></A><I>mask</I> </TD>
<TD>  Specifies the mask indicating which 
z-buffer bits
 are read only and which can be overwritten. The following rules apply: </TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X91230e"></A></TD>
<TD>  If a bit of the mask is set to 0, the corresponding bits are read-only.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A213X91230f"></A></TD>
<TD>  If a bit of the mask is set to 1, the corresponding z-buffer bits can be overwritten. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A64C0165e0"></A>Implementation Specifics</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D772B622ceb"></A>This subroutine is part of GL in the AIXwindows Environment/6000 Version 1, Release 2 with AIXwindows/3D Feature.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B650ceb"></A>On the 3-D Color Graphics Processor, the z-buffer writemask is ignored when drawing is performed directly into the z-buffer; that is, when the value of the <A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X97f5"><B>zdraw</B></A> subroutine is True. Instead, the color-planes writemask is applied. </P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B679ceb"></A>The 3-D Color Graphics Processor,
and 
the Supergraphics Processor Subsystem, and the POWER GXT1000 adapter
 support only two values for the z-buffer writemask: 0x000000 and 0xffffff. All other values are ignored.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B705ceb"></A>The POWER Gt4 and POWER Gt4x adapters support a z-buffer writemask in banks of 8 bitplanes. The eight supported values for the writemask are 0x000000, 0x0000ff, 0x00ff00, 0xff0000, 0x00ffff, 0xffff00, 0xff00ff, and 0xffffff. All other values are ignored.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B731ceb"></A>If an unsupported writemask is specified with this subroutine, it is ignored, and the current writemask is not changed.</P>

<H3><A NAME="A78C1246"></A>Files</H3>
<TABLE><TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1247"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/gl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains C language constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR>

<TR VALIGN="TOP"><TD NOWRAP="NOWRAP"><A NAME="A78C1248"></A><B>/usr/include/gl/fgl.h</B></TD>
<TD>  Contains FORTRAN constant and variable type definitions for GL.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<H3><A NAME="A143X9837"></A>Related Information</H3>
<P><A NAME="E1D772B828ceb"></A>Granting write access to a subset of available bitplanes with the <A HREF="RGBwritemask.html#A143X93fa"><B>RGBwritemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B856ceb"></A>Enabling drawing to the z-buffer with the <A HREF="zdraw.html#A143X97f5"><B>zdraw</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B881ceb"></A>Specifying an RGBA writemask with a single, packed integer with the <A HREF="wmpack.html#A143X9570"><B>wmpack</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B907ceb"></A>Granting write permission to available bitplanes with the <A HREF="writemask.html#A143X9592"><B>writemask</B></A> subroutine.</P>

<P><A NAME="E1D772B933ceb"></A><!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/gloverview.html#gloverview.html">AIX Graphics Library Overview</A>, <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/writemasks.html#writemasks.html">Writemasks and Logical Operations</A>, and Removing <!--gl32prgd:--><A HREF="../gl32prgd/remhidden.html#remhidden.html">Hidden Surfaces</A>.</P><hr><center>
